Yolk sac tumor elements present in all cases; lymphovascular invasion in 51%. Age ≥12 years and higher pT stage independently predicted relapse events. Excellent 5-year survival (>98%) with clear prognostic stratification.

pmid-35611429.summary_ja: カルラリーノ症候群の仙尾部奇形腫内のPNET初症例。19ヶ月女児。仙尾部腫瘤の約33%が奇形腫。悪性転化リスクが示唆され、完全病理学的評価と治療計画が重要。
pmid-35611429.summary_en: First reported case of primitive neuroectodermal tumor (PNET) arising within presacral teratoma in 19-month-old with Currarino syndrome. Currarino syndrome features anorectal malformation, presacral mass, and sacral deformation; teratoma accounts for ~33% of presacral masses. This case demonstrates malignant transformation risk in extragonadal teratomas requiring thorough pathological examination.

pmid-35612406.summary_ja: 転移性GCT診断におけるi12p FISH検査の有用性を示唆。胚細胞癌、卵黄囊腫瘍、体細胞型悪性腫瘍の3症例。細胞ブロックでのFISHは異常細胞形態を持つ転移性腫瘍のGCT由来性確認に高感度。
pmid-35612406.summary_en: Study demonstrates utility of fluorescent in-situ hybridization (FISH) detection of iso-chromosome 12p (i12p) abnormality for diagnosing metastatic germ cell tumors. Three cases included embryonal carcinoma, yolk sac tumor, and somatic-type malignancy from GCT. i12p FISH on cytology cell blocks provides high sensitivity for establishing germ cell origin with unusual cytomorphology.

pmid-35615154.summary_ja: 若年女性の副腎成熟奇形腫症例。CT88×79×69mmの腫瘤が確認され、成熟奇形腫と病理診断。1952年以来49症例の文献レビュー。AFP測定と定期画像による厳密な追跡管理が必要。
pmid-35615154.summary_en: Case report of primary adrenal mature teratoma in a young female with right flank pain. CT showed 88×79×69 mm mass; histopathology confirmed maturity. Literature review identified 49 adrenal teratoma cases since 1952. Strict follow-up with AFP monitoring and regular imaging recommended for management of this rare extragonadal GCT.

pmid-35615156.summary_ja: 7229例中22例の卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫悪性転化分析。50歳以上が多く、扁平上皮癌59.1%で最多。外科的減量術と化学療法で5年無再発生存率54.5%、全生存率81.8%。進行期は予後不良。
pmid-35615156.summary_en: 30-year retrospective study of 22 malignant transformations from 7,229 ovarian mature cystic teratomas (0.30% rate). Most patients >50 years; squamous cell carcinoma (59.1%) most common malignancy. Patients underwent debulking surgery and chemotherapy with 5-year RFS 54.5% and OS 81.8%. FIGO stage I associated with best outcomes.

pmid-35620742.summary_ja: 卵巣皮様囊胞由来の稀な単一胚葉型奇形腫の悪性転化症例。濾胞癌への変化と転移を示した40歳女性。290症例レビューで52.94%の転移率。悪性例では積極的な手術と長期監視が必要。
pmid-35620742.summary_en: Case report and literature review of malignant transformation of struma ovarii, a rare monodermal ovarian teratoma. Patient presented with recurrent mass and metastases; histology showed papillary follicular carcinoma. Review of 290 cases revealed 52.94% metastatic rate. Aggressive surgical management recommended for malignant cases with monitoring for hyperthyroidism complications.

pmid-35633247.summary_ja: 妊娠26週で再発性転移性妊娠性絨毛癌の症例。脳転移を伴う。化学療法によりβ-hCGが正常化し症状改善。迅速な診断と管理の重要性を示唆。
pmid-35633247.summary_en: Case of 18-year-old at 26 weeks gestation with recurrent metastatic gestational choriocarcinoma and brain metastasis, with prior treatment 2 years earlier. Treated with etoposide-cisplatin and EMA/CO regimens. Beta-hCG normalized with successful symptom resolution.

pmid-35637815.summary_ja: 呼吸器症状と左精巣欠損を呈した22歳男性の原発性縦隔混合型胚細胞腫瘍の症例。画像で大きな前縦隔腫瘤が確認された。生検で主としてセミノーマ成分からなる混合型胚細胞腫瘍と診断された。腫瘍の侵攻性と早期診断の必要性が考察されている。
pmid-35637815.summary_en: Case of 22-year-old with primary mediastinal mixed germ cell tumor presenting with respiratory symptoms and absent left testis. Large anterior mediastinal mass confirmed on imaging. Biopsy revealed mixed GCT with predominant seminoma component. Discusses aggressive nature and need for early diagnosis.

pmid-35637940.summary_ja: 原発性縦隔GCT既往患者が急性肥満細胞白血病を発症した症例。遺伝子変異はTP53、FLT3、SETBP1、JAK3だが、KITなし。GCTと二次性MCLの共通の幹細胞起源の可能性を論考。
pmid-35637940.summary_en: Case of 30-year-old with history of primary mediastinal GCT (treated with surgery and chemotherapy) who subsequently developed acute mast cell leukemia. Genetic sequencing showed TP53, FLT3, SETBP1, and JAK3 mutations but not KIT. Patient died 2.4 months after MCL diagnosis.

pmid-35638085.summary_ja: ステージ1精巣GCT患者の監視強度削減の長期研究（1981-2021年）。画像検査と通院の大幅削減にもかかわらず、再発率と疾病の程度は変わらず。低強度監視スケジュールは安全。
pmid-35638085.summary_en: Long-term study examining effects of decreased surveillance intensity for clinical stage I testicular GCTs from 1981-2021. Despite significant reductions in imaging and follow-up visits, relapse rates, disease extent, and cancer deaths remained stable for seminoma and NSGCT. Current reduced-intensity surveillance appears safe.

pmid-35640517.summary_ja: COVID-19パンデミック前後の精巣GCT患者の比較。パンデミック期間中に症状期間と診断から手術までの期間が延長。ステージ1腫瘍での潜在転移リスク増加。早期治療の重要性を強調。
pmid-35640517.summary_en: Retrospective study comparing testicular GCT patients diagnosed before and during COVID-19 pandemic. Pandemic group showed significantly longer symptom duration, delayed diagnosis-to-surgery interval, and increased risk of occult metastasis in stage 1 tumors. Emphasizes importance of timely treatment.

pmid-35642065.summary_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫内に良好に分化した小脳を認めた稀な症例。20歳女性で左卵巣嚢腫摘出術を施行。病理では不成熟成分なし。徹底的なサンプリングの重要性を強調。
pmid-35642065.summary_en: Case of 20-year-old with ovarian mature cystic teratoma containing well-differentiated cerebellum—an extremely rare finding with only 22 previously reported cases. Left ovarian cystectomy performed; pathology showed mature tissues without immature components. Emphasizes importance of thorough sampling.

pmid-35646599.summary_ja: 57歳の腹腔内精巣セミノーマの症例。左側腹部痛で発症。CT で骨盤腫瘤と後腹膜腫瘤を認め、左水腎症を伴う。手術切除で診断確定。
pmid-35646599.summary_en: Case of 57-year-old with intra-abdominal testicular seminoma presenting with left flank pain. CT imaging revealed large pelvic mass with associated retroperitoneal mass causing left hydronephrosis. Surgical excision performed with histopathologic confirmation of seminoma.

pmid-35646601.summary_ja: 精巣非セミノーマ腫瘍の症例。鼠径部腫瘤で発症し、睾丸摘出術を施行。化学療法後、軟組織に残存奇形腫を認めた。GCT播種と非典型的再発について文献レビュー。
pmid-35646601.summary_en: Case of 29-year-old with mixed nonseminomatous GCT presenting with painful inguinal mass. Initial inguinal orchiectomy removed testicle with tumor violation. After BEPx3 chemotherapy with normalized markers, residual soft tissue masses containing teratoma were discovered at follow-up.

pmid-35647392.summary_ja: 胸腺および松果体に並存したセミノーマ/ジャーミノーマに伴う傍腫瘍症候群として両側ぶどう膜炎を呈した18歳男性の症例。胸腺のセミノーマは外科的に切除され、組織学的に確認された。松果体のジャーミノーマは生検で診断され、化学療法と放射線療法が行われた。眼症状は消失した。
pmid-35647392.summary_en: Case of 18-year-old male with bilateral uveitis as paraneoplastic syndrome from concurrent seminoma/germinoma in thymus and pineal glands. Thymic seminoma was surgically resected and histologically confirmed; pineal germinoma diagnosed by biopsy followed by chemotherapy and radiotherapy. Ocular symptoms resolved.

pmid-35649078.summary_ja: 57名の精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者を対象とした後方視的研究で、化学療法後後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受けた。病理では奇形腫49%、線維化・壊死26%、生存腫瘍25%であった。修正片側定型アプローチは有効かつ安全で、合併症発生率は35%であった。
pmid-35649078.summary_en: Retrospective study of 57 testicular GCT patients undergoing post-chemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph node dissection. Pathology showed teratoma in 49%, fibrosis/necrosis in 26%, and viable tumor in 25%. Modified unilateral template approach was effective and safe with 35% complication rate.

pmid-35650620.summary_ja: 消化器症状を呈した絨毛癌の腸管転移患者4例の症例集積である。3例は外科的切除を受け、1例は診断から22か月後に死亡し、3例は経過観察中である。絨毛癌の腸管転移に関する利用可能なデータは限られており、外科的切除と化学療法の併用が一般に行われている。
pmid-35650620.summary_en: Case series of four choriocarcinoma patients with intestinal metastases presenting with gastrointestinal symptoms. Three patients underwent surgical resection; one died 22 months after diagnosis, three remain in follow-up. Limited data available on treatment of intestinal metastases from choriocarcinoma.

pmid-35651446.summary_ja: 10年間の290例の女性悪性GCT患者の後方視的研究。セミノーマが最も一般的。有効な補助療法と保存的手術で10年全生存率は20%以上。15.9%の死亡率と44.4%の無病生存率。
pmid-35651446.summary_en: Institutional retrospective study of 290 female patients with malignant GCTs over 10 years. Most common diagnosis was seminoma. Overall survival exceeded 20% at 10 years with effective adjuvant therapy and conservative surgery. Study found 15.9% mortality and 44.4% disease-free survival.

pmid-35651803.summary_ja: 卵巣奇形腫に関連する傍腫瘍性神経症候群について、特に抗NMDAR脳炎を中心に包括的にレビューした論文である。辺縁系脳炎、脳脊髄炎、小脳症候群、オプソクローヌス・ミオクローヌス症候群などの臨床像を扱っている。大半の患者は腫瘍切除と免疫療法の併用により良好な反応を示した。
pmid-35651803.summary_en: Comprehensive review of paraneoplastic neurological syndromes associated with ovarian teratoma, particularly anti-NMDAR encephalitis. Discusses clinical manifestations including limbic encephalitis, encephalomyelitis, cerebellar syndrome, and opsoclonus-myoclonus syndrome. Most patients showed good response to tumor resection combined with immunotherapy.

pmid-35655916.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛癌細胞におけるCBR3-AS1の役割を調査。CBR3-AS1はSETD4 mRNAを安定化させることで細胞増殖を促進。ノックダウンにより増殖抑制とアポトーシス促進を認めた。
pmid-35655916.summary_en: Investigates the role of lncRNA CBR3-AS1 in gestational choriocarcinoma cell proliferation. CBR3-AS1 was upregulated in GC cells and promoted proliferation via stabilization of SETD4 mRNA through interaction with PTBP1. Downregulation suppressed proliferation and promoted apoptosis.

pmid-35656123.summary_ja: 46,XX正常核型を持つ9歳女児における卵巣ゴナドブラストーマと精上皮腫の稀な症例。男性化徴候を呈し、組織学的に精上皮腫の浸潤を確認。ゴナドブラストーマにおける悪性成分の検出の重要性を強調。
pmid-35656123.summary_en: Reports a rare case of ovarian gonadoblastoma with associated dysgerminoma in a 9-year-old girl with normal 46,XX karyotype presenting with virilization. Histopathology confirmed dysgerminoma overgrowth. The case highlights the need to screen for malignant components in gonadoblastoma.

pmid-35656387.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍のセルフリーDNA応用の系統的レビュー。感度は腫瘍マーカーより高いがmiR-371a-3pより低い。メチル化解析は奇形腫検出に有用。低変異負荷と低cfDNA量が課題。次世代シーケンシング最適化と特にメチル化解析が臨床応用の鍵。
pmid-35656387.summary_en: This systematic review evaluated cfDNA as a biomarker in testicular GCT (TGCT) management based on 6 studies. cfDNA sensitivity was higher than serum tumor markers but lower than miR-371a-3p, with comparable specificity. cfDNA methylation successfully detected teratoma. Challenges include TGCT's low mutational burden.

pmid-35658319.summary_ja: 67歳男性の大型精巣類表皮嚢胞。幼児型奇形腫に分類される良性腫瘍。病理学的には線維膜に囲まれた嚢胞、周囲精巣実質にGCN無し。良性だが悪性腫瘍との鑑別が重要。不要な除睾手術を避けるため正確な診断が必須。
pmid-35658319.summary_en: This case report describes a 67-year-old man with a large testicular epidermoid cyst (10×7×5 cm), classified as a prepubertal-type teratoma. Histopathology showed a well-defined cyst with fibrous membrane and no skin appendages or germ cell neoplasm in adjacent parenchyma. TECs must be distinguished from malignant tumors.

pmid-35659276.summary_ja: 53歳女性の巨大な成熟卵巣奇形腫が扁平上皮癌へ悪性転化した症例を報告する。成熟奇形腫は1〜2%の症例で悪性転化しうる。患者は外科的切除と完全な病期分類を受け、9年間の経過観察で再発は認められなかった。
pmid-35659276.summary_en: This case describes a 53-year-old woman with a giant mature ovarian teratoma (MCTO) that underwent malignant transformation to squamous cell carcinoma (SCC). Mature teratomas can undergo malignant transformation in 1-2% of cases. The patient underwent surgical resection with complete staging; 9-year follow-up showed no recurrence.

pmid-35660795.summary_ja: 縦隔混合胚細胞腫瘍20例の軟骨成分のIDH1/2変異を分析。変異検出率は15%と骨軟部腫瘍の54%より低い。IDH2 R172のみで、IDH1 R132はなし。胚細胞腫瘍由来軟骨の腫瘍形成機序が体細胞由来軟骨肉腫と異なることを示唆。
pmid-35660795.summary_en: This study analyzed IDH1/2 mutations in cartilaginous lesions from 20 primary mediastinal mixed GCTs. IDH1/2 mutations were identified in only 15% of cases (vs. 54% in somatic chondroid tumors). Mutations were exclusively IDH2 R172, with notably absent IDH1 R132. Results suggest different oncogenic mechanisms than somatic chondrosarcomas.

pmid-35661496.summary_ja: 54歳男性が腹部腫瘤で受診。後腹膜転移巣からセミノーマ診断。精巣超音波でGCNISを伴う消失型セミノーマを確認。腹部腫瘤男性患者の診断における精巣検査の重要性を示す教訓的症例。
pmid-35661496.summary_en: A 54-year-old male presented with retroperitoneal lymphadenopathy showing seminoma on biopsy. Testicular ultrasound revealed a focal hypoechoic region with germ cell neoplasia in situ in the right testis, consistent with burned-out seminoma. This case illustrates the importance of routine scrotal examination in men presenting with abdominal masses.

pmid-35663054.summary_ja: 以前に未熟卵巣奇形腫を有していた53歳女性が、初回手術と化学療法から25年後にgrowing teratoma syndrome(GTS)を発症した症例である。肝臓と腹膜に充実性腫瘤が出現した。外科的切除により成熟奇形腫と診断された。GTSは化学療法中または治療後に未熟奇形腫が成熟奇形腫へ変化する現象として特徴づけられる。
pmid-35663054.summary_en: A 53-year-old woman with prior immature ovarian teratoma developed growing teratoma syndrome (GTS) 25 years after initial surgery and chemotherapy. Multiple solid masses appeared in liver and peritoneum. Surgical resection revealed mature teratoma. GTS is characterized by conversion of immature to mature teratoma during/after chemotherapy.

pmid-35669228.summary_ja: 42歳男性の巨大後腹膜成熟奇形腫。精巣内に生存可能なセミノーマと線維化疤痕内にGCNISを認め、消失型混合胚細胞腫瘍と診断。後腹膜腫瘍を認めた際の精巣検索の重要性を示す教訓的症例。
pmid-35669228.summary_en: A 42-year-old male presented with a massive retroperitoneal mass diagnosed as mature cystic teratoma. Further investigation revealed a multifocal right testicular mass with pure seminoma and fibrous scar containing germ cell neoplasia in situ, representing a 'burned-out' mixed GCT. This case emphasizes importance of thorough gonadal evaluation.

pmid-35669771.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍におけるRFPL3Sは腫瘍抑制因子。健常組織より発現低下し、TNM進行度と疾患無増悪期間に負相関。低メチル化と遺伝子コピー数低下は予後不良と関連。CD8+ T細胞やB細胞浸潤と正相関し、免疫療法反応予測マーカーとしての可能性を示唆。
pmid-35669771.summary_en: This bioinformatics study identified RFPL3S as a tumor suppressor lncRNA in testicular GCT (TGCT). RFPL3S expression was significantly reduced in TGCT compared to normal tissue and correlated with TNM stage, disease-free interval, and progression-free interval. Hypermethylation and low copy number were associated with poor outcomes.

pmid-35674780.summary_ja: 一次化学療法後に完全奏効を得た転移性非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍367例を後方視的に解析した。追跡期間中央値4.97年で94%が疾患のない状態を維持した。推定2年PFSは91%、2年OSは98%であった。再発した20例は外科的切除または化学療法により救済された。経過観察による管理は適切な選択肢である。
pmid-35674780.summary_en: This retrospective study of 367 metastatic NSGCT patients who achieved complete response after first-line chemotherapy found 94% remained disease-free at latest follow-up (median 4.97 years). Two-year PFS and OS were 91% and 98% respectively. All 20 patients who relapsed were salvaged with surgery/chemotherapy, supporting surveillance as appropriate management.

pmid-35675585.summary_ja: 一次RPLNDを受けた病理学的病期II NSGCT患者97例(pN1 41例、pN2 46例、pN3 10例)を解析した。補助化学療法なしで2年RFSは80.3%、5年RFSは79%であった。リンパ節病期の間でRFSに有意差は認められなかった。再発した20例は全例、一次化学療法により無病の状態となった。
pmid-35675585.summary_en: This study analyzed 97 patients with pathologic stage II NSGCT following primary RPLND (41 pN1, 46 pN2, 10 pN3). Without adjuvant chemotherapy, 2-year and 5-year RFS were 80.3% and 79% respectively. No significant RFS differences were observed between nodal stages. All 20 recurrent patients achieved disease-free status with first-line chemotherapy.

pmid-35676718.summary_ja: 新生児期のDES曝露により、II型胚細胞腫瘍様の所見がマウス精巣に誘導されることを示したモデル研究。GCNIS様細胞ががん幹細胞マーカーであるCD166を発現していた。全体的な低メチル化とインプリンティング遺伝子の発現変化を伴い、PTENやEzh2の発現低下がみられた。組織常在性VSELsがエピゲノム変化を起こし、悪性転化するという仮説を支持する結果であった。
pmid-35676718.summary_en: This mouse model study demonstrates neonatal DES exposure induces type II GCT-like features with GCNIS-like cells expressing cancer stem cell markers (CD166+). Global hypomethylation and altered imprinted gene expression (Igf2-H19, Dlk-Meg3) accompany reduced PTEN and Ezh2. Results support the hypothesis that tissue-resident VSELs undergo epigenetic changes and malignant transformation.

pmid-35678876.summary_ja: 精巣外胚細胞腫瘍302例から神経膠腫瘍15例を抽出。グリオーマ9例はIDH変異なし、ETMR 6例はLin28やC19MC異常なし。中枢神経系腫瘍と異なる分子特性を示し、胚細胞腫瘍由来の神経膠分化は独立した腫瘍形成機序を持つことを示唆。
pmid-35678876.summary_en: This study examined 302 GCTs from extra-gynecological sites, identifying neuroglial tumors in 15 cases (9 gliomas, 6 ETMRs). Unlike CNS gliomas, none showed IDH mutations. ETMR cases lacked Lin28 expression and C19MC amplification. Findings indicate neuroglial differentiation in GCT-derived teratomas has distinct genotypes and pathogenesis compared to CNS counterparts.

pmid-35680425.summary_ja: 卵巣奇形腫が抗NMDAR脳炎の自己抗体産生の中心地として機能。腫瘍内に機能的な胚中枢構造を有し、高度に変異したIgA産生B細胞クローンが拡大。頸部リンパ節からのNR1-IgG産生も確認。腫瘍が神経免疫学的病態に直接関与する新知見。
pmid-35680425.summary_en: This study demonstrates ovarian teratomas function as active germinal centers producing NMDAR-specific autoantibodies in NMDAR-antibody encephalitis. Teratoma tissue contains tertiary lymphoid structures with germinal center markers, expanded IgA-secreting B cells, and NR1-reactive clones. Cervical lymph nodes from affected patients also showed NR1-IgG production, establishing peripheral immune activation.

pmid-35681761.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍（GTN）に対する免疫療法の応用を検討したレビュー。GTN組織ではPD-1/PD-L1が発現している。ペムブロリズマブやアベルマブは化学療法抵抗性の症例で有望な結果を示したが、多剤併用化学療法に抵抗性の患者ではアベルマブは重篤な毒性のため中止された。カムレリズマブとアパチニブの併用は、難治例に対する治療の可能性を示している。
pmid-35681761.summary_en: This review examines immunotherapy applications in gestational trophoblastic neoplasia (GTN). PD-1/PD-L1 inhibitors show expression in GTN tissue. Pembrolizumab and Avelumab demonstrate promising results in chemoresistant cases, though severe toxicity limited Avelumab use in multiagent chemotherapy-resistant patients. Combination approaches with Camrelizumab and Apatinib show potential for refractory GTN.

pmid-35684123.summary_ja: オレウロペインは精巣内外のセミノーマ細胞の増殖を抑制し、アポトーシスを誘導。NF-κB経路の阻害、p21/cyclin-D1の制御、TGFβ-1の低下を通じて細胞周期停止と遊走能低下を実現。新規抗腫瘍薬開発の可能性を示唆する基礎研究。
pmid-35684123.summary_en: This study demonstrates that oleuropein (OLE), a polyphenol from olive leaf extract, reduces viability of both intra- and extragonadal seminoma cells dose-dependently. OLE induces apoptosis, reduces NF-κB expression, inhibits cell cycle progression via p21/cyclin-D1 regulation, and decreases migration through TGFβ-1 downregulation, suggesting potential therapeutic applications.

pmid-35686158.summary_ja: 妊娠関連絨毛癌の超高リスク症例。口腔転移で初期診断が困難。免疫チェックポイント阻害剤と化学療法の組み合わせを試みたが、最終的に患者死亡。β-HCGの測定と組織診断の重要性と、超高リスク症例の治療戦略の改善が課題。
pmid-35686158.summary_en: A 46-year-old woman with ultra high-risk gestational choriocarcinoma presented with oral and pulmonary metastases. Initial immunotherapy plus chemotherapy showed favorable response before CC diagnosis via elevated β-HCG. Standard multiagent regimen was subsequently applied, but patient ultimately died despite treatment, highlighting clinical challenges in managing ultra-high-risk disease.

pmid-35689468.summary_ja: 子宮外妊娠性滋養膜疾患のPD-L1検出に7種類抗体を検証。22C3が病理医間一致度と特異性が最良。抗PD-L1免疫療法の対象患者選別に重要。抗体間の発現検出の大きなばらつきと標準化の必要性を示唆。
pmid-35689468.summary_en: Study validating seven PD-L1 antibodies for detecting PD-L1-expressing cells in gestational trophoblastic disease (complete hydatidiform moles and choriocarcinomas). Important for identifying GTD patients eligible for anti-PD-L1 immunotherapy. 22C3 showed best intraclass correlation and uniformity for GTD PD-L1 assessment.

pmid-35694937.summary_ja: 新生児の胃奇形腫による黒色便初発。出生前診断された腹部腫瘤。消化管出血の非典型的原因として報告。胃奇形腫の胚葉学的説明と稀な性腺外発生部位を強調。
pmid-35694937.summary_en: Case report of gastric teratoma (germ cell tumor) presenting with melena in newborn. Significant upper GI bleeding with antenatally diagnosed abdominal mass. First reported case of massive GI bleeding from gastric teratoma. Highlights unusual anatomical presentation and proposes embryological explanation for gastric teratoma occurrence.

pmid-35700037.summary_ja: 273個のタグSNP（28のDNAメチル化関連遺伝子由来）と精巣胚細胞腫瘍リスクとの関連を、経路に着目したGWASで検討した。10,156例の症例と179,683例の対照を解析した。MTHFR、MECP2、ZBTB4が上位のTGCT関連遺伝子として同定された。MTHFRの変異はセミノーマと関連していたが、非セミノーマとは関連していなかった。
pmid-35700037.summary_en: Pathway-focused GWAS examining DNA methylation-related genes (273 tag SNPs from 28 genes) and testicular germ cell tumor (TGCT) risk. Analysis of 10,156 TGCT cases and 179,683 controls. MTHFR, MECP2, and ZBTB4 identified as top TGCT-associated genes. MTHFR variants associated with seminoma but not nonseminoma.

pmid-35700701.summary_ja: 傍腫瘍性脱髄炎症性神経障害で発見された後腹膜転移性セミノーマの症例。ギラン・バレー症候群と初期誤診。シスプラチン化学療法で完全寛解。4年間無病生存を達成。神経症状も改善。
pmid-35700701.summary_en: Case of 36-year-old male with paraneoplastic demyelinating inflammatory neuropathy revealing retroperitoneal metastatic seminoma (testicular germ cell tumor). Initially suspected Guillain-Barré syndrome. PET identified retroperitoneal mass; elevated hCG confirmed seminoma. No primary testicular tumor. Cisplatin-etoposide-bleomycin regimen achieved complete response; disease-free 4 years.

pmid-35701334.summary_ja: 精巣がん生存者69名を対象にテストステロン置換療法の効果をランダム化比較検討。軽度ライディッヒ細胞機能不全において脂肪量減少を認めるも、血糖および代謝症候群改善は認めず。
pmid-35701334.summary_en: Randomized double-blind trial of testosterone replacement therapy (TRT) versus placebo in testicular cancer (TC) survivors with mild Leydig cell insufficiency. 69 patients (35 TRT, 34 placebo) followed 12 months. Primary outcome: change in 2-hour glucose via oral tolerance test. TRT showed decreased fat mass but no significant metabolic improvement.

pmid-35701820.summary_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に由来する甲状腺型癌である卵巣の高分化濾胞癌（HDFCO）の症例。38歳女性で、再発性の卵巣嚢胞が3回の再発の経過で、HDFCOへと進行した。生殖細胞系列のFGFR4 Gly388Arg多型が悪性転化を促進する可能性がある。根治的手術と放射性ヨウ素アブレーションが行われた。
pmid-35701820.summary_en: Case of highly differentiated follicular carcinoma of ovary (HDFCO), a thyroid-type carcinoma arising from ovarian mature cystic teratoma (OMCT). 38-year-old female with recurrent ovarian cysts showing progression to HDFCO over three relapses. Germline FGFR4 Gly388Arg polymorphism potentially accelerates malignant transformation. Radical surgery with radioactive iodine ablation.

pmid-35710558.summary_ja: 精巣絨毛癌の消化管出血による非典型的初発例。2か月の下血で内視鏡検査陰性。CT画像で肺・肝・空腸転移を確認。病理学的に精巣絨毛癌を確認。化学療法への良好な反応を示す稀な症例。
pmid-35710558.summary_en: Rare case of testicular choriocarcinoma (non-spermatogonial germ cell tumor) presenting with gastrointestinal bleeding as first diagnosis in 28-year-old male. Two-month melena history; no endoscopic bleeding foci. CT imaging revealed lung, liver, upper jejunum lesions. Pathology confirmed testicular choriocarcinoma. Treated with PIC chemotherapy.

pmid-35711487.summary_ja: 精巣がん転移例が血尿と側腹部痛で発症。後腹膜腫瘤により尿管浸潤を認めた。精巣摘除と尿管ステント留置後、化学療法の第1サイクル後に良好な反応。3年間の無病生存を達成した症例。
pmid-35711487.summary_en: Case of 25-year-old male with metastatic testicular cancer (germ cell tumor) presenting atypically with hematuria and flank pain mimicking renal colic. Retroperitoneal mass infiltrating ureter. Post-orchiectomy, double-J stent placement; excellent response to first chemotherapy cycle. Retroperitoneal lymph node dissection performed. Disease-free after 3-year follow-up.

pmid-35713077.summary_ja: 高度の腹部膨満を呈した17歳女児で、成熟嚢胞性奇形腫（胚細胞腫瘍）と診断された症例。成熟奇形腫は三胚葉から構成され、最も頻度の高い奇形腫の型である。嚢胞成分と充実成分により画像所見はさまざまである。外科的切除が標準的な治療方針である。
pmid-35713077.summary_en: Case of 17-year-old girl with massive abdominal distension diagnosed with mature cystic teratoma (germ cell tumor). Mature teratomas comprise three germ layers; represent most common teratoma type. Radiological presentation varies due to cystic and solid components. Surgical resection remains standard treatment approach.

pmid-35715158.summary_ja: 胞状奇胎および絨毛性腫瘍性疾患の病理学的分類が形態学的認識から分子遺伝学的分類へ転換。予後層別化が可能に。従来の組織学的特徴と鑑別診断、臨床的意義を包括的に総括。
pmid-35715158.summary_en: Contemporary pathological review of gestational trophoblastic disease (GTD) including hydatidiform moles and gestational trophoblastic neoplasms. Major paradigm shift from morphology-based to molecular genetic classification enabling prognostic stratification. Discusses traditional gross and histomorphologic features, differential diagnoses, and clinical implications.

pmid-35715940.summary_ja: 絨毛癌と胎盤部位栄養膜腫瘍の混合型を示す子宮外妊娠性滋養膜疾患の稀な症例。頭皮転移で発症し、脳硬膜転移を伴うも肺転移なし。化学療法による寛解を達成。原発巣不明の非典型的な臨床経過を呈した。
pmid-35715940.summary_en: Rare case of combined gestational trophoblastic neoplasia (choriocarcinoma and placental site trophoblastic tumor) presenting as scalp skin lesion in 41-year-old female. Elevated beta-hCG, dural-based intracranial extension without lung metastases. Successful treatment with transcranial lesion resection and EMA chemotherapy. Unusual presentation without identifiable intrauterine primary.

pmid-35720238.summary_ja: ラトビアにおけるスウェイヤー症候群患者37名の分析で、性腺切除例の58.3%でジスジェルミノーマまたはゴナドブラストーマが確認。若年での悪性化リスクのため早期診断と性腺摘除の時間的遅延の最小化が重要。
pmid-35720238.summary_en: Retrospective study of 37 Latvian patients with complete gonadal dysgenesis (Swyer syndrome, 46,XY karyotype). Dysgerminoma and gonadoblastoma identified in 58.3% of 12 gonadectomy cases. Average diagnosis age 15.4 years. Early diagnosis critical due to malignancy risk in young patients. Study emphasizes need for timely gonadectomy.

pmid-35723132.summary_ja: 精巣がん生存者698人を対象に症状認識と診断段階の関連を分析。痛み、ホットフラッシュ、無症状が進行期診断と統計的に関連。形状変化は早期診断と負の関連。非典型症状と典型症状の組み合わせによる早期診断促進の重要性を示唆。
pmid-35723132.summary_en: Cross-sectional study of 698 testicular cancer survivors examining symptom recognition and diagnosis stage. Pain, hot flashes, and absent symptoms predicted advanced-stage diagnosis. Change in testicular shape associated with earlier diagnosis. Findings suggest atypical symptoms should be considered with typical signs to improve early detection.

pmid-35723941.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍に伴う、体細胞型の二次性悪性腫瘍を伴う21歳男性の症例。奇形腫は1%で、横紋筋肉腫と軟骨肉腫の成分が認められた。AFPのみが上昇していた。根治的精巣摘除術の後、後腹膜リンパ節郭清が行われ、24個中1個のリンパ節に類似の体細胞型悪性腫瘍が認められた。
pmid-35723941.summary_en: 21-year-old male with testicular germ cell tumor containing 1% teratoma with extensive secondary somatic-type malignancy (rhabdomyosarcoma and chondrosarcoma). Serum markers elevated AFP with normal LDH and hCG. Radical orchiectomy followed by retroperitoneal lymph node dissection revealed similar somatic-type malignancy in 1 of 24 nodes.

pmid-35729018.summary_ja: TGCT患者96例と対照31例で循環遊離腫瘍DNA（cfDNA）を評価した研究。TGCTでは、特に病勢進行時にcfDNA濃度が高かった。360 bpの長い断片は腫瘍と病勢進行例のみで検出され、TGCTのモニタリングにおける新たな潜在的マーカーとして示唆された。
pmid-35729018.summary_en: Study evaluates circulating free tumor DNA (cfDNA) in 96 testicular germ cell tumor (TGCT) patients versus 31 controls. Higher cfDNA concentrations found in TGCT, particularly at disease progression. Longer 360 bp fragments exclusively detected in tumors and disease progression cases, suggesting novel potential marker for TGCT monitoring.

pmid-35730020.summary_ja: 39歳女性の卵巣卵黄嚢腫瘍で、非典型的な濾胞構造がストルマオバリのような甲状腺様組織に類似。高いAFP値（1000 IU/ml以上）と免疫組織化学所見により診断確定。YSTの多様な組織像を示す貴重な症例報告。
pmid-35730020.summary_en: Post-pubertal ovarian yolk sac tumor (YST) in 39-year-old woman with elevated AFP (>1000 IU/ml). Histologically unusual microfollicular pattern resembling thyroid tissue (struma ovarii), confirmed by immunohistochemistry positive for AFP and Glypican-3. Case illustrates YST's variable morphologic presentations requiring careful differential diagnosis.

pmid-35730347.summary_ja: 純粋性腺形成不全症患者における性腺ジスジェルミノーマの発症リスク管理と、ホルモン治療なしでのタナー5期の乳房発達を報告する症例。46,XY核型患者の悪性腫瘍リスク評価と早期診断、継続的な監視の重要性を強調している。
pmid-35730347.summary_en: Pure gonadal dysgenesis (46,XY karyotype) presents high malignancy risk, particularly for dysgerminoma development. This case describes a 27-year-old patient with gonadal dysgenesis history, prior dysgerminoma diagnosis, and complete Tanner stage V breast development despite no hormone replacement therapy. Early recognition and management of malignancy risk is essential for disease surveillance.

pmid-35733597.summary_ja: 異所性部位に生じた乳児奇形腫の2例を報告する。1例は生後6か月の女児で、副腎の成熟奇形腫が腹部腫瘤として認められた。もう1例は生後4か月の男児で、腸間膜の未熟奇形腫であった。乳児の副腎新生物では神経芽腫が最も多いが、嚢胞性の副腎病変では奇形腫も考慮すべきである。腸間膜奇形腫はリンパ管腫と類似しうるが、悪性転化のリスクがあるため、長期フォローアップのために正確な診断が不可欠であることを示している。
pmid-35733597.summary_en: Two cases of infantile teratomas in unusual sites: (1) 6-month-old girl with mature adrenal teratoma presenting as abdominal mass, and (2) 4-month-old boy with immature mesenteric teratoma. Demonstrates that while neuroblastoma is most common adrenal neoplasm in infants, teratomas must be considered for cystic adrenal lesions. Mesenteric teratoma can mimic lymphangioma but accurate diagnosis essential for long-term follow-up given malignant transformation risk.

pmid-35733602.summary_ja: 膣出血で発症した5ヶ月齢の子宮頸部卵黄嚢腫瘍の症例。化学療法単独で完全寛解を達成し、手術を回避。12ヶ月以上の追跡調査で合併症なし。若年患者の選別された頸部卵黄嚢腫瘍では手術回避の可能性と化学療法への優れた反応を示した。
pmid-35733602.summary_en: Case of 5-month-old with yolk sac tumor of uterine cervix presenting with vaginal bleeding. Achieved complete remission with chemotherapy alone, avoiding surgery. Followed for >12 months without complications. Demonstrates feasibility of avoiding surgery in selected young patients with cervical yolk sac tumors and excellent response to chemotherapy.

pmid-35734360.summary_ja: 肺転移と膣転移を伴う妊娠絨毛癌患者の症例。閉塞性黄疸を合併（FIGO第III期、WHOスコア14）。hCG値は361,131 mIU/ml。肝機能障害のためドキソルビシン単剤療法で開始、その後EMACO療法に変更し6サイクル実施、さらに2サイクルの維持療法を追加。
pmid-35734360.summary_en: Case of 26-year-old with gestational choriocarcinoma presenting with lung and vaginal metastases with obstructive jaundice (FIGO stage III, WHO score 14). Beta-hCG was 361,131 mIU/ml. Initially treated with single-agent doxorubicin due to hepatic dysfunction, then transitioned to EMACO regimen for 6 cycles with 2 additional maintenance cycles.

pmid-35734746.summary_ja: 極度に上昇したCA 19-9レベルを呈した成熟嚢胞性卵巣奇形腫の症例報告。卵巣嚢胞摘出後、CA 19-9は正常化。良性奇形腫でのCA 19-9異常高値が不要な医学的介入と患者不安につながる可能性を論じている。良性奇形腫でも極度の上昇が起こることの重要性を示した。
pmid-35734746.summary_en: Case report of mature cystic teratoma with extremely elevated CA 19-9 levels. After ovarian cystectomy, CA 19-9 levels normalized. Discusses how abnormally elevated CA 19-9 in benign teratomas can lead to unnecessary medical interventions and patient anxiety. Demonstrates importance of recognizing that extreme elevation of this marker can occur in benign teratomas without complications.

pmid-35735440.summary_ja: 成熟・未熟奇形腫の混合型を有する38歳患者が、腫瘍マーカー正常化後に補助化学療法を受けたにもかかわらず腹膜腫瘤を生じた。PET/CTでは転移が示唆されたが、外科的切除によりGTSとサルコイドーシスの混合病理と確認された。推定される再発に対する治療前には組織診断が重要であることを示す症例である。
pmid-35735440.summary_en: Case of 38-year-old with mixed mature and immature teratomas who developed peritoneal masses after adjuvant chemotherapy despite normalized tumor markers. PET/CT showed hypermetabolic lymphadenopathy suggesting metastatic disease. Surgical resection revealed mixed pathology: growing teratoma syndrome and sarcoidosis. Demonstrates importance of tissue diagnosis before retreating presumed recurrence.

pmid-35741221.summary_ja: ストルマ卵巣内に生じた高分化濾胞癌が脊椎転移で発症した症例。以前の「増殖型」ストルマ卵巣は組織学的には良性だったが、現在広範囲転移を発症。組織学的に良性でも転移の可能性があり、ストルマの予測不可能な振る舞いを示した。多学際的アプローチと長期監視の必要性を強調。
pmid-35741221.summary_en: Case of well-differentiated follicular carcinoma arising in struma ovarii with vertebral metastasis. Patient had prior 'proliferative' struma ovarii (histologically benign); now developed widespread metastases. Demonstrates unpredictable behavior of struma ovarii; even histologically benign cases can metastasize. Emphasizes need for multidisciplinary approach and long-term surveillance.

pmid-35750503.summary_ja: 小児卵巣悪性GCT患者60例を対象に術中冷凍切片と最終パラフィン切片診断の一致性を検討。冷凍切片は38.3%で不正確であり、中央病理検査は23.7%で追加的なGCT成分を同定。術中診断は小児卵巣GCTの手術範囲決定に信頼性が低い。
pmid-35750503.summary_en: Review of 60 pediatric/adolescent patients with malignant ovarian germ cell tumors assessing concordance between intraoperative frozen section and final paraffin diagnosis. Frozen section diagnosis was incorrect in 38.3%; central expert pathology review identified additional GCT components in 23.7%. Demonstrates frozen section is unreliable for guiding surgical staging extent in pediatric ovarian GCTs.

pmid-35751357.summary_ja: 肺転移を伴う妊娠絨毛癌患者の症例。3回の流産歴。咳嗽と著明に上昇したhCG（361,131 mIU/ml）で発症。FIGO第III期、高リスク。肝機能障害のためドキソルビシンで開始後、EMACO療法に変更。化学療法感受性と適切な管理時の良好な予後を示した。
pmid-35751357.summary_en: Case of 34-year-old woman with gestational choriocarcinoma and pulmonary metastasis presenting with cough and markedly elevated beta-hCG (361,131 mIU/ml). FIGO stage III with high prognostic score. Initiated chemotherapy with doxorubicin due to deranged liver function, then transitioned to EMACO regimen. Demonstrates chemosensitivity and good prognosis when appropriately managed.

pmid-35756620.summary_ja: テスティキュラーGCTの診断と監視用の信頼性の高いバイオマーカーであるhsa-miR-371a-3pを液体生検で定量するドロップレットデジタルPCRベースのパイプライン（DigiMir）を確立。107例の血漿サンプルで検証され感度94%特異度100%を達成。古典的血清腫瘍マーカー感度61.5%を上回った。
pmid-35756620.summary_en: Study establishes droplet digital PCR (ddPCR)-based pipeline (DigiMir) for quantifying hsa-miR-371a-3p, a reliable biomarker for testicular GCT diagnosis and monitoring in liquid biopsies. Validated on 107 plasma samples; achieved 94% sensitivity and 100% specificity, outperforming combined sensitivity of classical serum tumor markers (61.5%). Promises improved clinical implementation.

pmid-35756636.summary_ja: 転移性睾丸GCT患者における炎症性バイオマーカーの予後的有用性に関する総説。GCTは若年成人男性の最も一般的な悪性腫瘍でプラチナ製剤化学療法後の治癒率は80%超。しかし20-30%が再発する。全身炎症と癌進展の関連性を論じ、治療応答を予測する分子バイオマーカーの必要性を強調。
pmid-35756636.summary_en: Review of inflammatory biomarkers' prognostic utility in metastatic testicular germ cell tumors. GCTs are most common malignancy in young adult males with >80% cure rate after platinum-based chemotherapy. However, 20-30% of patients relapse. Discusses association between systemic inflammation and cancer progression, highlighting need for validated molecular biomarkers to predict chemotherapy response.

pmid-35759134.summary_ja: 再発難治性GCT患者19例を対象としたASP1650（CLDN6標的抗体）の第II相試験。推奨用量1500 mg/m²（2週毎）を確立。奏効なく第1段階で中止。15/16例でCLDN6陽性。診断バイオマーカーおよび治療標的として将来の研究に適している。
pmid-35759134.summary_en: Phase II trial of ASP1650 (CLDN6-targeted antibody) in 19 male patients with relapsed/refractory GCTs, establishing recommended dose of 1500 mg/m² every 2 weeks. No partial or complete responses observed; trial stopped at stage I. CLDN6 expression was positive in 15/16 evaluable tissues, identified as potential biomarker and therapeutic target for future investigations.

pmid-35761185.summary_ja: 妊娠29週で診断された急速増殖する卵巣未熟奇形腫の症例。1週間で9.7cmから25cmに増大。33週で帝王切開および段階手術を実施、BEP化学療法4サイクルを施行。18ヶ月の追跡で再発なし。妊産婦と胎児の利益を勘案した多学際的管理の成功を示した。
pmid-35761185.summary_en: Case of rapidly growing immature ovarian teratoma diagnosed at 29 weeks pregnancy, enlarging from 9.7 cm to 25 cm within one week. Cesarean section at 33 weeks followed by complete staging and four cycles of BEP chemotherapy. Eighteen-month follow-up showed no recurrence, demonstrating successful multidisciplinary management balancing maternal and fetal interests.

pmid-35763178.summary_ja: 複数回再発した難治性睾丸GCT患者12例を対象としたジスルフィラムとシスプラチン併用療法の第II相試験。客観的奏効なく第1段階で中止。疾患安定化は16.7%、中央値全生存期間は2.9ヶ月。良好な忍容性にもかかわらず、限定的な有効性を示した。
pmid-35763178.summary_en: Phase II trial evaluating disulfiram (ALDH inhibitor) combined with cisplatin in 12 patients with multiply relapsed/refractory testicular GCTs. No objective responses achieved; study terminated at first stage. Disease stabilization occurred in 16.7%; median OS 2.9 months. Despite good tolerability, limited efficacy suggests disulfiram does not restore cisplatin sensitivity in these resistant tumors.

pmid-35765923.summary_ja: 卵巣奇形腫内に生じた甲状腺がん（MSO）の臨床研究。NCDB患者158例とSEER患者95例を分析し、転移、卵巣外進展、リンパ節転移を用いたリスク分類を提案した。高リスク患者は全生存期間が有意に短縮。放射性ヨウ素療法の使用パターンは施設間で一貫性を欠いていた。
pmid-35765923.summary_en: Study of malignant struma ovarii (MSO), thyroid cancer arising in ovarian teratomas. Analyzed 158 NCDB and 95 SEER patients proposing risk stratification system using metastasis, extraovarian extension, and lymph node status. High-risk patients had significantly decreased overall survival. Radioactive iodine therapy patterns were inconsistent across institutions and warrant further investigation.

pmid-35773697.summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞と絨毛癌幹細胞様細胞におけるVEGF-BとAhRの発現と機能を研究。VEGF-B阻害またはAhR拮抗薬はCSLCの増殖、遊走、浸潤を低下。VEGF-Bが絨毛癌の新規治療標的となる可能性を示唆。
pmid-35773697.summary_en: Study of VEGF-B and aryl hydrocarbon receptor (AhR) expression in human choriocarcinoma cells and choriocarcinoma stem-like cells (CSLCs). VEGF-B knockdown or AhR antagonism decreased proliferation, migration, and invasion of CSLCs. AhR enhanced VEGF-B transcriptional activity, suggesting VEGF-B targeting may provide novel therapeutic opportunity for choriocarcinoma.

pmid-35774118.summary_ja: 男性不妊と睾丸GCT発症の共有メカニズムを検討するレビュー。TEX101とそのインタラクトームに焦点。TEX101低下が両状態に関連し、複数のインタラクトーム構成員が生殖能力とGCTリスクの両方に関連する可能性を示唆。
pmid-35774118.summary_en: Review article examining shared mechanisms between male subfertility and testicular GCT development, focusing on TEX101 (testis-expressed 101) and its interactome. TEX101 downregulation implicated in both conditions. Multiple interactome members associated with fertility and/or TGCT risk, suggesting common molecular pathways link these conditions.

pmid-35774527.summary_ja: 1973-2015年の小児泌尿生殖器腫瘍4,576例のSEER登録データ分析。GCTが睾丸腫瘍の71.0%を占め、10年生存率96%。腎腫瘍が全体の80.3%、睾丸12.3%。小児泌尿生殖器悪性腫瘍の疫学プロフィールと生存転帰を提供。
pmid-35774527.summary_en: Population-based SEER study of 4,576 pediatric genitourinary tumors (1973-2015). GCTs comprised 71.0% of testicular tumors with 96% 10-year overall survival. Kidney tumors were most common overall (80.3%), followed by testis (12.3%). Study provides epidemiologic profile of pediatric genitourinary malignancies and contemporary survival outcomes.

pmid-35775317.summary_ja: 完全奇胎由来の妊娠性腹膜原発絨毛癌の症例報告。STR多型解析で妊娠性と非妊娠性の鑑別と原因妊娠の同定が可能。9例の類似症例レビューで、遺伝子解析が予後と治療選択に重要であることを示唆。
pmid-35775317.summary_en: Case report of primary peritoneal choriocarcinoma genetically confirmed as gestational origin from complete hydatidiform mole. STR polymorphism analysis essential for distinguishing gestational from non-gestational choriocarcinoma and identifying causative pregnancy. Review of 9 similar cases highlights importance of genetic analysis for prognosis and treatment selection.

pmid-35775522.summary_ja: 5ヶ月児の口腔咽頭奇形腫の症例報告。脱出性腫瘤として提示。3つの胚葉由来の真の腫瘍であり、通常は仙尾部、性腺、後腹膜に見られ、口腔咽頭部は稀な部位。口腔咽頭腫瘤の鑑別診断に奇形腫を考慮することの重要性を強調。
pmid-35775522.summary_en: Case report of oropharyngeal teratoma in 5-month-old infant presenting with prolapsing mass. Teratomas are true neoplasms derived from three germ layers and rare tumors, more commonly found in sacrococcygeal region, gonads, and retroperitoneum. Case highlights importance of considering teratoma in differential diagnosis of oropharyngeal masses.

pmid-35776192.summary_ja: セミノーマ88例のラジカル精巣摘出術標本における詳細なサンプリングの病理学的影響を検討。精巣上体浸潤とリンパ管侵襲が転移を予測。詳細なサンプリングは段階分類精度を改善しず、標準的サンプリングが十分である可能性を示唆。
pmid-35776192.summary_en: Study of 88 radical orchiectomy specimens for pure seminoma examining impact of extensive sampling on staging and prognostic parameters. Epididymal infiltration and lymphovascular invasion predicted metastasis (ROC-AUC 0.778). Extensive sampling did not improve staging accuracy, suggesting current sampling methods are sufficient for risk stratification.

pmid-35777113.summary_ja: 卵巣ダーモイド腫瘍24,270例の国家患者サンプル分析。0.21%がanti-NMDAR脳炎を合併。若年と黒人種族が危険因子。脳炎群は有意に長期入院と高コストを示す。卵巣奇形腫の稀だが重篤な自己免疫合併症を示唆。
pmid-35777113.summary_en: National inpatient sample analysis of 24,270 patients with ovarian dermoid tumors (mature teratomas), identifying 50 (0.21%) with anti-NMDAR encephalitis. Younger age and Black race were risk factors. Anti-NMDAR encephalitis group had significantly longer hospitalization and higher costs. Study highlights rare but serious autoimmune complication of ovarian teratomas.

pmid-35779927.summary_ja: 妊娠中に診断された妊娠性卵巣絨毛癌の症例報告。STR遺伝子型解析で完全奇胎由来を確認。手術、中絶、化学療法で寛解達成。STR解析は妊娠性と非妊娠性の鑑別と予後予測に有用。
pmid-35779927.summary_en: Case report of gestational primary ovarian choriocarcinoma concurrent with intrauterine pregnancy. STR genotyping confirmed gestational etiology originating from hydatidiform mole. Patient treated with salpingo-oophorectomy, abortion, and 8 cycles of chemotherapy with complete remission. STR analysis useful for distinguishing gestational from non-gestational choriocarcinoma.

pmid-35781237.summary_ja: 小児仙尾部GCT 38例の臨床病理学的評価。組織型は成熟奇形腫25例、未熟奇形腫8例、卵黄嚢腫瘍5例。ほぼ全例がAFP高値で、多学科的アプローチで優れた予後を達成(37例生存)。出生前診断と定期経過観察の重要性を強調。
pmid-35781237.summary_en: Single-center series of 38 pediatric sacrococcygeal GCTs (mean age 8.5 years). Histology: 25 mature teratomas, 8 immature teratomas, 5 yolk sac tumors. Type 4 tumors most common (15 cases). Most detected prenatally or presented with constipation. AFP elevated in 28 cases. Excellent prognosis with multidisciplinary approach: 37/38 survived.

pmid-35783027.summary_ja: 縦隔嚢胞32例の手術管理の症例集。胸痛が最も一般的な症状。成熟嚢胞奇形腫を含む複数の組織型が認められた。VAT Sが最も一般的な手術アプローチで、死亡率なし、完全切除後の予後は良好。
pmid-35783027.summary_en: Case series of 32 mediastinal cysts managed surgically. Most common symptom was chest pain. Histologic subtypes included mature cystic teratomas (among other benign cysts: bronchogenic, esophageal, neuroenteric, pericardial, thymic). Video-assisted thoracic surgery was most common approach. No mortality and low morbidity, with excellent prognosis after complete excision.

pmid-35789023.summary_ja: 睾丸癌診断と治療が男性の男らしさ感覚に及ぼす影響を検討した24論文の系統的レビュー。治療後に男らしさの喪失感を経験する患者もいるが、標準化評価尺度の研究は限定的。長期生存者支援の心理社会的研究が必要。
pmid-35789023.summary_en: Systematic review of 24 articles (10 quantitative, 14 qualitative) examining impact of testicular cancer diagnosis and treatment on men's perception of masculinity. Some men experience reduced masculinity sense post-treatment, particularly if single/childless. Limited research using validated masculinity measures highlights need for further psychosocial investigation to support survivorship.

pmid-35790231.summary_ja: COVID-19パンデミック中のアルバータ州における精巣胚細胞腫瘍の病期移行を調べた後方視的コホート研究である。病期IIIの割合はパンデミック前の7.8%からパンデミック中の15.4%に増加し、病期IIは減少した。診断の遅れにより、受診時の疾患負荷が増大したことが示唆された。研究者らは、パンデミック下でもTGCTの管理を優先し続ける必要性を強調している。
pmid-35790231.summary_en: Retrospective cohort study examining stage migration in testicular GCTs in Alberta during COVID-19 pandemic. Stage III disease increased from 7.8% pre-pandemic to 15.4% during pandemic, while stage II decreased. Findings suggest delayed diagnoses led to higher disease burden at presentation, emphasizing need for continued prioritization of TGCT management.

pmid-35792284.summary_ja: 睾丸胚細胞癌NT2/D1細胞におけるエストロゲン受容体(ESR1、ESR2)の発現と機能を研究。ESR1/ESR2活性化は異なる細胞周期経路を介して増殖を促進し、治療標的となる可能性を示唆。
pmid-35792284.summary_en: Study of estrogen receptor expression and function in human testicular embryonal carcinoma NT2/D1 cells. Activation of ESR1 and ESR2 increased cell proliferation through distinct cell cycle pathways. E2 treatment enhanced cell viability through estrogen receptor signaling, suggesting potential therapeutic targets in embryonal carcinoma.

pmid-35793507.summary_ja: 月経前少女における両側成熟卵巣奇形腫の同時発症例。右卵巣捻転による急性腹症で右卵巣摘出術を実施。左卵巣は保存的手術を施行。小児患者における悪性化リスク、生殖能温存、捻転予防のバランス検討。
pmid-35793507.summary_en: Case of 10-year-old girl with bilateral synchronous mature ovarian teratomas presenting with acute abdomen due to right ovarian torsion. Right oophorectomy was necessary due to necrosis, while left ovary was preserved with cystectomy. Discusses balancing malignancy risk, fertility preservation, and torsion prevention in pediatric patients.

pmid-35794360.summary_ja: 出生前超音波で嚢胞性病変として検出された先天性眼窩奇形腫の症例。出生前・出生後MRIで奇形腫の特徴的な画像変化を認め、出生前診断と周産期管理計画に有用。
pmid-35794360.summary_en: Case report of congenital orbital teratoma detected prenatally as a cystic lesion. Prenatal and postnatal MRI demonstrated characteristic evolution of teratoma imaging features. Knowledge of these radiologic appearances aids in prenatal diagnosis and postnatal management planning.

pmid-35795064.summary_ja: 貧困リスクGCT患者90名における絨毛癌症候群(CS)発症の危険因子を同定。10%の患者がCSを発症し、ARDSにより数日以内に全員死亡。ECOG PS≥2と肺転移≥50%がCS発症の独立した予測因子。
pmid-35795064.summary_en: Retrospective study of 90 poor-risk GCT patients identifying factors associated with choriocarcinoma syndrome (CS), a rare but highly fatal complication causing ARDS. Nine patients (10%) developed CS with 100% mortality within days. ECOG performance status ≥2 and lung metastases ≥50% independently predicted CS development.

pmid-35798646.summary_ja: 転移性生殖細胞腫瘍患者95名の後腹膜リンパ節郭清手術前後の筋肉量を測定。より低い筋肉指数が術後合併症と関連し、栄養状態の評価が手術転帰を改善する可能性を示唆。
pmid-35798646.summary_en: Study of 95 testicular cancer patients undergoing post-chemotherapy retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy for metastatic GCTs. Decreased psoas muscle mass, measured by cross-sectional imaging, predicted post-operative morbidity. Patients with advanced disease had lower pre-operative muscle mass, suggesting nutritional status assessment may improve surgical outcomes.

pmid-35800110.summary_ja: 汎血球減少症を呈した非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者の症例報告である。広範な化学療法と救援治療が行われたにもかかわらず、骨髄穿刺により骨髄浸潤が判明した。本症例は、腫瘍マーカーが持続的に高値の胚細胞腫瘍患者では、骨髄転移を鑑別診断として考慮すべきであることを示している。
pmid-35800110.summary_en: Case report of bone marrow metastases in a non-seminomatous testicular germ cell tumor patient presenting with pancytopenia. Despite extensive chemotherapy and salvage treatments, bone marrow involvement was discovered via aspirate. The case highlights that bone marrow metastasis should be considered in differential diagnoses of GCT patients with persistent tumor markers.

pmid-35801305.summary_ja: 精巣がん生存者455例を対象とした縦断研究である。化学療法前のVAT対SAT比が高いと、BMIが30 kg/m2以上の患者において心代謝疾患のリスクが高かった。化学療法後の体重増加は主に内臓脂肪で生じていた。研究では、シスプラチン併用化学療法後の中心性肥満と心代謝リスクとの関連が示されている。
pmid-35801305.summary_en: Longitudinal study of 455 testicular cancer survivors post-cisplatin chemotherapy. Higher prechemotherapy visceral-to-subcutaneous adipose ratio predicted cardiometabolic disease risk in obese patients (BMI≥30). Weight gain post-chemotherapy predominantly in visceral compartment.

pmid-35803413.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍における体細胞型悪性腫瘍の総説である。SMは主に奇形腫または卵黄嚢腫瘍に由来し、肉腫、癌腫、胚性神経外胚葉性腫瘍などの多様な組織型を示す。12p染色体のアイソクロモソームは鑑別診断に有用である。転移巣で生じたSMは予後不良と関連する。SMはシスプラチン併用化学療法に反応しにくいが、外科的切除は有効である。
pmid-35803413.summary_en: Review of somatic-type malignancy development in testicular GCT, mostly from teratomas or yolk sac tumors. SMs demonstrate varied histology: sarcoma, carcinoma, embryonic neuroectodermal tumor, nephroblastoma-like tumor, hematologic malignancy. Isochromosome 12p useful in diagnosis.

pmid-35804952.summary_ja: 小児の精巣および精巣傍腫瘍の画像所見をまとめた絵画的総説である。思春期前腫瘍の多くは良性で奇形腫が最も多く、思春期後腫瘍は成人と類似し悪性の可能性が高い。良性病変は境界明瞭でドプラ血流が低下し、悪性病変は不均一で内部血流を伴うことが特徴である。画像所見は、臨床データや腫瘍マーカーと併せて解釈すべきである。
pmid-35804952.summary_en: Pictorial review of pediatric testicular and para-testicular tumors. Pre-pubertal tumors mostly benign (teratomas most frequent), post-pubertal similar to adults (more malignant). Describes imaging features: benign lesions well-circumscribed with decreased Doppler flow; malignancy appears inhomogeneous with internal blood flow.

pmid-35805018.summary_ja: 小児膣がん26例に対する画像誘導小線源治療の後方視的研究である。内訳は横紋筋肉腫69%、悪性胚細胞腫瘍27%、明細胞腺癌4%であった。局所制御率は96%、グレード2以上の晩期毒性は23%であった。PDR-BTは、従来の低線量率法と比較して良好な成績を示した。
pmid-35805018.summary_en: Retrospective study of image-guided brachytherapy for 26 pediatric vaginal cancers: rhabdomyosarcoma (69%), malignant germ cell tumor (27%), clear cell adenocarcinoma (4%). Median age 25 months. Local control rate 96%, late grade ≥2 toxicity 23%. PDR-BT improved outcomes versus historical LDR technique.

pmid-35809127.summary_ja: 44例の卵巣皮様嚢腫（成熟嚢胞性奇形腫）を後方視的に検討し、捻転を有する20例と有さない24例を比較した。捻転例はEDを受診し急性疼痛を呈することが多く、皮様嚢腫が大きく（中央値9.0 cm対6.0 cm）、前方変位や同側付属器の液体貯留を伴っていた。
pmid-35809127.summary_en: Retrospective study of 44 patients with ovarian dermoids (mature cystic teratomas), comparing 20 with adnexal torsion to 24 without. Torsion cases presented to ED with acute pain, had larger dermoids (median 9.0 vs 6.0 cm), anterior displacement, and ipsilateral adnexal fluid.

pmid-35809856.summary_ja: KLHL 11抗体関連傍腫瘍神経症候群（2019年初報告）の総説。精巣胚細胞腫瘍（特にセミノーマ）との強い関連性。菱形脳炎で脳幹・小脳障害。免疫療法・化学療法への反応不良で予後不良。
pmid-35809856.summary_en: Review of KLHL 11-antibody-associated paraneoplastic neurological syndrome (first identified 2019) strongly correlated with testicular germ cell tumors, predominantly seminoma. Characterized by rhombencephalitis with brainstem/cerebellar involvement. Most patients responded poorly to immunotherapy and chemotherapy.

pmid-35812677.summary_ja: 卵巣奇形腫に関連する抗NMDAR脳炎の患者6例の症例集積と、2014〜2019年に報告された155例の文献レビューである。6例中5例は完全に回復し、1例は若干の欠損を残した。腫瘍の外科的切除と早期の免疫療法により転帰が改善した。
pmid-35812677.summary_en: Case series of 6 patients with ovarian teratoma-associated anti-NMDAR encephalitis and systematic review of 155 published cases (130 reports, 2014-2019). Five of 6 patients achieved full recovery, one with residual deficits. Surgical tumor removal and early immunotherapy improved outcomes significantly.

pmid-35813785.summary_ja: 2019-2020年の胎児気道確保術（EXIT）5例の後ろ向き報告。リンパ管奇形4例、子宮内未熟奇形腫1例。4例が気道確保成功、1例がDICで死亡。出生前診断と多職種協働の重要性を強調。
pmid-35813785.summary_en: Review of EXIT procedures at a tertiary center 2019-2020. Five cases performed: four lymphatic malformations, one immature teratoma with cervical-thoracic compression. Four successful airway management outcomes; one death from DIC post-EXIT. Emphasizes importance of prenatal diagnosis.

pmid-35814432.summary_ja: 進行期卵巣未熟奇形腫の後方視的研究。46例のうち38例が妊孕性温存手術、8例が根治的手術を受けた。5年無病生存率は69.1%、全生存率は89.9%。減量手術が不十分であることが独立した再発危険因子であった。妊孕性を温存したい患者にFSSは実施可能である。
pmid-35814432.summary_en: Retrospective study of 46 advanced-stage ovarian immature teratoma patients: 38 underwent fertility-sparing surgery, 8 radical surgery. 5-year disease-free survival 69.1%, overall survival 89.9%. Suboptimal cytoreduction was independent recurrence risk factor. FSS is feasible for fertility-preserving patients.

pmid-35815298.summary_ja: 44歳の患者で、右精巣セミノーマに不妊症と両側精巣萎縮を合併した症例。精巣がんが腫瘤ではなく萎縮として現れる病態を報告。資源が限られた環境では、早期発見のために経陰嚢超音波検査が重要であることを強調している。
pmid-35815298.summary_en: Case of 44-year-old with right testicular seminoma complicated by infertility and bilateral testicular atrophy. Describes presentation of testicular cancer as atrophy rather than mass. Emphasizes importance of transscrotal ultrasound for early detection in resource-limited settings.

pmid-35817140.summary_ja: 精巣GCT患者45例を対象に、精巣摘除術前に術前化学療法を受けた症例を検討。精巣に純粋奇形腫が残存した例は51%、残存腫瘍なしは29%、混合型GCTは11%であった。転移巣では卵黄嚢腫瘍(27%)と奇形腫(24%)が最も多かった。精巣に残存病変がないことは予後良好を示唆した。
pmid-35817140.summary_en: Study of 45 patients with testicular GCT receiving neoadjuvant chemotherapy before orchiectomy. Found residual pure teratoma in 51%, no residual tumor in 29%, and mixed GCT in 11%. Metastases most commonly contained yolk sac tumor (27%) and teratoma (24%). Absence of residual disease predicted better prognosis.

pmid-35818265.summary_ja: 18歳患者の前縦隔セミノーマと平滑筋肉腫の混合腫瘍の稀症例。部分切除後に化学療法と分子標的薬を投与。BRAF、TP53、MTOR、FLCNの遺伝子変異を同定し集学的治療が有効。
pmid-35818265.summary_en: Case report of primary mediastinal seminoma mixed with leiomyosarcoma in an 18-year-old. After partial excision, patient received chemotherapy and targeted therapy. Identified genetic mutations including BRAF, TP53, MTOR, and FLCN. Benefits from combined treatment approach.

pmid-35821265.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の精巣温存手術285例の系統的レビュー。隣接するGCNIS 43%、術後性腺機能低下27%、不妊18%。補助放射線療法は局所再発を50%から2%に減少させたが性腺機能低下を40%に増加。
pmid-35821265.summary_en: Systematic review of 285 cases of testicular GCT treated with testis-sparing surgery. Found 43% had adjacent GCNIS, 27% developed hypogonadism, and 18% experienced infertility. Adjuvant radiotherapy reduced local recurrence from 50% to 2% but increased hypogonadism to 40%.

pmid-35821272.summary_ja: 小児腹部固形腫瘍手術後の術後合併症を検討した後方視的研究。性腺外胚細胞腫瘍で合併症発生率が35%と最も高かった。208例を対象に、Clavien-Dindo分類を用いて合併症を分類し、複数の因子が転帰に影響することを示した。
pmid-35821272.summary_en: Retrospective study of postoperative complications in pediatric abdominal solid tumor surgery. Extragonadal germ cell tumors had the highest complication rate at 35%. Among 208 patients, complications were classified using Clavian-Dindo system, with multiple factors influencing outcomes.

pmid-35831038.summary_ja: 抗NMDA受容体脳炎を伴う卵巣奇形腫患者2例の全身麻酔下手術例。レミマゾラムとレミフェンタニルを用いた麻酔管理。1例は術後改善も1ヶ月後に死亡、1例は段階的に改善した。
pmid-35831038.summary_en: Two female patients with anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis and ovarian teratomas underwent successful teratoma resection under general anesthesia using remimazolam and remifentanil. One patient improved post-surgery but died one month later; the other progressively improved.

pmid-35832044.summary_ja: 閉経後女性における卵黄嚢腫瘍の稀症例。子宮内膜原発で結腸腫瘍として発症。異常子宮出血と腫瘍マーカー上昇が診断に有用。閉経後女性における発症が極めて稀である点を強調。
pmid-35832044.summary_en: Yolk sac tumor from endometrial origin presenting in a post-menopausal woman with colonic mass. Discusses clinical presentation with abnormal uterine bleeding and elevated tumor markers, highlighting the rarity of yolk sac tumors in post-menopausal women.

pmid-35835482.summary_ja: 血痰で発症した肺内成熟奇形腫の症例。胸腔開下に腫瘍切除を施行。初回手術後20年の長期追跡観察で良好な経過。資源が限定された地域における管理戦略について述べた稀な疾患の報告。
pmid-35835482.summary_en: A teenage girl presented with hemoptysis from an intrapulmonary mature teratoma. Thoracotomy and resection were performed. Twenty-year follow-up after surgery showed successful management in a low-resource setting.

pmid-35836509.summary_ja: 65歳男性の肺原発絨毛癌の稀症例。胸腔鏡下左上葉切除と縦隔リンパ節郭清を施行。病理診断は悪性栄養膜腫瘍でTP53、NRAS、FGFR1遺伝子変異を認めた。手術と化学療法・放射線療法の集学的治療が予後改善に有効。
pmid-35836509.summary_en: A 65-year-old male with primary pulmonary choriocarcinoma underwent thoracoscopic resection. Pathology confirmed malignant trophoblastic tumor with mutations in TP53, NRAS, and FGFR1. Comprehensive treatment including surgery and chemotherapy/radiotherapy improved patient survival.

pmid-35844345.summary_ja: 精巣混合型胚細胞腫瘍の症例報告。10年後に腺癌の体細胞型悪性腫瘍を伴う再発。後期再発における体細胞転化と予後について論じている。
pmid-35844345.summary_en: Case report of 44-year-old male with mixed testicular GCT stage IIA treated with orchiectomy who developed GCT relapse 10 years later with adenocarcinoma (somatic-type malignancy). Discusses rare phenomenon of somatic transformation in late-relapsing GCT and variable prognosis based on timing and histology.

pmid-35845975.summary_ja: 部分胞状奇胎が卵管外妊娠として発症した22歳女性の症例報告。卵管胞状奇胎は約200例の報告のみ。病理標本検査と絨毛癌のリスクに対する追跡調査の重要性を強調。
pmid-35845975.summary_en: Case report of partial hydatidiform mole presenting as tubal ectopic pregnancy in 22-year-old woman. Only ~200 cases of tubal molar pregnancy reported worldwide (incidence ~1.5 per 1,000,000). Emphasizes importance of pathologic review of ectopic specimens and appropriate follow-up for choriocarcinoma risk.

pmid-35846506.summary_ja: 停留精巣由来の15cm腹腔内セミノーマの症例報告。47歳男性が腹部腫瘤で発症。停留精巣の早期治療と腫瘍の早期発見の重要性を強調。
pmid-35846506.summary_en: Case report of 47-year-old male with 15-cm intra-abdominal seminoma arising from undescended testis, presenting as abdominal mass with empty scrotum. Emphasizes importance of early treatment of cryptorchidism to prevent malignant transformation and facilitate early detection of testicular tumors.

pmid-35846860.summary_ja: 腹痛と腫瘤を呈した4歳女児の、卵黄嚢腫瘍成分を伴う未熟卵巣奇形腫の症例報告。未熟奇形腫は侵襲性が高いものの、適時の治療と外科的介入により、18か月のフォローアップで再発なく良好な予後が得られた。
pmid-35846860.summary_en: Case report of immature ovarian teratoma with yolk sac tumor component in 4-year-old girl presenting with abdominal pain and mass. Despite aggressive behavior of immature teratomas, timely management and surgical intervention led to good prognosis with no recurrence at 18-month follow-up.

pmid-35846908.summary_ja: スウェイヤー症候群患者の15歳卵巣ジスジャーミノーマの症例報告。卵巣機能不全による一次無月経で発症。性腺形成不全とジスジャーミノーマの稀な関連について記述。
pmid-35846908.summary_en: Case report of dysgerminoma (ovarian GCT) in 15-year-old with Swyer syndrome (46,XY pure gonadal dysgenesis). Patients with Swyer syndrome present with primary amenorrhea due to non-functioning streak gonads. Describes rare association between gonadal dysgenesis and dysgerminoma development.

pmid-35850510.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者の腫瘍溶解症候群の症例報告。化学療法中に上昇したAFP/hCGマーカーと生命に危険を及ぼす合併症の管理について記述。
pmid-35850510.summary_en: Case report of 36-year-old male with nonseminomatous testicular GCT (pT3N3M1b) complicated by tumor lysis syndrome during chemotherapy. Describes elevated AFP/hCG tumor markers and clinical management of life-threatening metabolic complication with continuous hemodiafiltration.

pmid-35855571.summary_ja: 若年男性で最も多い充実性悪性腫瘍である精巣胚細胞腫瘍の遺伝学的基盤をレビューした。CHEK2遺伝子と78個の低〜中リスクSNPが家族性リスクの44%を占めることや、セミノーマに限られる3つの体細胞変異（KIT、KRAS、NRAS）について述べている。さらに、リスクや治療抵抗性に関連する遺伝マーカーと、再発の指標となりうるマイクロRNAについても検討している。
pmid-35855571.summary_en: Review of genetic basis of testicular germ cell tumors (most common solid malignancy in young males). Discusses heritable risk factors including CHEK2 gene and 78 low-to-moderate-risk SNPs from GWAS accounting for 44% of familial risk. Covers somatic mutations and biomarkers for prognosis.

pmid-35859959.summary_ja: 33歳男性の膵臓原発卵黄嚢腫瘍の極めて稀な症例報告。卵黄嚢腫瘍は稀な胚細胞腫瘍であり、膵臓原発は非常に稀である。精巣外胚細胞腫瘍の診断と管理について論じている。
pmid-35859959.summary_en: Case report of extremely rare primary pancreatic yolk sac tumor in 33-year-old male. Yolk sac tumor is rare type of GCT; pancreatic origin is exceptionally uncommon. Discusses diagnostic and management considerations for this extragonadal GCT variant.

pmid-35860118.summary_ja: 2ヶ月児の縦隔成熟奇形腫と十二指腸回転異常の併存症例。縦隔原発は稀な部位。消化管不耐症と両病変の外科的治療の重要性について論じている。
pmid-35860118.summary_en: Case report of mature mediastinal teratoma in 2-month-old infant concurrent with duodenal malrotation. Mediastinal location is uncommon for teratomas; typically found in coccyx, ovaries, and testes. Discusses GI complications and importance of surgical management for both conditions.

pmid-35863107.summary_ja: MaGICによるコンセンサス報告。卵巣未熟奇形腫の主要な臨床病理学的問題を扱う。悪性度分類システム、微小な卵黄嚢腫瘍の定義、体性悪性腫瘍への転化、血清腫瘍マーカーの解釈を、小児と成人の両方の患者について検討している。
pmid-35863107.summary_en: Consensus report from Malignant Germ Cell International Consortium addressing key clinicopathologic issues in ovarian immature teratoma: grading systems, microscopic yolk sac tumor definition, somatic malignancy transformation, and interpretation of serum tumor biomarkers in pediatric and adult patients.

pmid-35863988.summary_ja: 精巣がんの世界的な疾病負担、発生率、死亡率の解析。若年男性における増加傾向が見られ、先進国で最高率。HDI、GDP、生活習慣因子との関連を検討。死亡率トレンドは相対的に安定。
pmid-35863988.summary_en: Global analysis of testicular cancer burden examining incidence, mortality, and trends across countries. Found increasing incidence particularly in younger males and developed countries, with associations to HDI, GDP, lifestyle factors, and metabolic risk factors. Mortality trends relatively stable despite rising incidence.

pmid-35865446.summary_ja: 卵巣ダーモイド嚢胞（成熟奇形腫）の破裂症例報告。化学的腹膜炎と腹腔内播種という稀な合併症を示す。画像診断上の特徴と臨床的意義について論じている。
pmid-35865446.summary_en: Case report of chronically ruptured ovarian dermoid (mature teratoma) incidentally discovered on imaging. Demonstrates rare complication of rupture causing chemical peritonitis and peritoneal implantation of multiple fat-containing lesions. Discusses imaging characteristics and clinical significance.

pmid-35865777.summary_ja: 若年男性の後腹膜成熟奇形腫の症例報告。後腹膜原発は精巣外奇形腫の4%未満の稀な部位。外科的切除と病理組織学的検査が確定診断に必須である。
pmid-35865777.summary_en: Case report of extragonadal mature teratoma in retroperitoneal location—a rare presentation comprising less than 4% of extragonadal teratomas. Presents in young male with abdominal pain. Emphasizes importance of surgical resection and histological examination for definitive diagnosis.

pmid-35866762.summary_ja: 若年の中国漢民族女性50例の卵巣卵黄嚢腫瘍を対象とした後方視的症例集積研究。追跡期間の中央値64.5か月で全生存率は91.6%であった。Ki67の割合と腫瘍径が予後因子として同定された。妊孕性温存手術は根治的手術と同等の生存成績を示し、妊娠・出産の転帰も報告されている。
pmid-35866762.summary_en: Retrospective case series of 50 Chinese Han women with ovarian yolk sac tumors (median age 22.7 years). 92% overall survival at median follow-up of 64.5 months. Ki67 percentage and tumor size identified as prognostic factors. Fertility-preserving surgery showed equivalent survival to radical surgery.

pmid-35866814.summary_ja: 単一施設で12年間に治療された小児の悪性精巣腫瘍の経験を報告した。混合型胚細胞腫瘍17例、卵黄嚢腫瘍15例、未熟奇形腫2例、奇形癌2例などが含まれる。手術アプローチ（鼠径部と陰嚢）の選択と補助療法の成績を検討し、36例が無病で生存していることを示している。
pmid-35866814.summary_en: Single-institution 12-year review of malignant testicular tumors in children. Included 17 mixed GCTs, 15 yolk sac tumors, 2 immature teratomas, 2 teratocarcinomas. Discusses optimal surgical approaches (inguinal vs scrotal) and adjuvant therapy outcomes, with 36 patients disease-free at follow-up.

pmid-35873897.summary_ja: 両側停留精巣とクラインフェルター症候群を有する33歳男性の凍結切片で診断されたセミノーマの症例報告。一次不妊症を4年間有していた患者である。停留精巣における悪性転化を正確に診断するためには、複数の診断法を組み合わせることが重要であると論じている。
pmid-35873897.summary_en: Case report of seminoma diagnosed by frozen section in a 33-year-old male with bilateral cryptorchidism and Klinefelter syndrome. Discusses the importance of combining multiple diagnostic modalities for accurate diagnosis of malignant transformation in undescended testes.

pmid-35875180.summary_ja: ドキソルビシン耐性絨毛癌細胞（JEG-3、BeWo）の球様体における幹細胞マーカー発現と浸潤能を研究。処理細胞由来球様体は幹細胞マーカー増加を示すが浸潤能は低下。
pmid-35875180.summary_en: Study of stem cell marker expression and invasion capability in doxorubicin-resistant choriocarcinoma cell lines (JEG-3, BeWo). Spheroids from doxorubicin-treated cells showed increased stem cell markers (NANOG, OCT4, SOX2) compared to parental cells, but demonstrated reduced invasion capacity.

pmid-35877234.summary_ja: 膵頭部に85 mmの嚢胞性腫瘍を認めた33歳女性の症例報告である。組織学的に成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と神経内分泌腫瘍の併存が確認された。外科的切除を受け、8か月のフォローアップ時点で再発は認められていない。
pmid-35877234.summary_en: Case report of 33-year-old female with pancreatic mature cystic teratoma with concomitant neuroendocrine tumor. 85mm cystic tumor in pancreatic head; histology confirmed mature teratoma with neuroendocrine tumor, an extremely rare combination. Complete surgical resection with no recurrence at 8-month follow-up.

pmid-35891831.summary_ja: 後腹膜混合型胚細胞腫瘍（絨毛癌成分を含む）症例。肺転移を含む遠隔転移を認め、呼吸不全で死亡した。
pmid-35891831.summary_en: Case of 18-year-old male with complex congenital heart disease history presenting with progressive dyspnea and found to have mixed GCT with choriocarcinoma components in retroperitoneum. Imaging showed metastatic disease including pulmonary metastases, leading to respiratory failure and death.

pmid-35892855.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍の診断におけるMRIと超音波の比較検討。113例中52.8%が悪性、50.9%が良性。MRIは超音波より高い特異性（72.8%対20%）と陽性予測値（52.1%対36%）を示した。
pmid-35892855.summary_en: Retrospective multi-center analysis of MRI vs ultrasound for diagnosing testicular tumors. 113 patients reviewed; 52.8% malignant, 50.9% benign. MRI showed superior specificity (72.8%) and positive predictive value (52.1%) compared to ultrasound for testicular tumor diagnosis.

pmid-35896086.summary_ja: 奇形腫を伴う1例を含む抗LGI1脳炎の症例集積である。奇形腫は主に甲状腺組織から構成され、LGI1の免疫染色が陽性であった。奇形腫症例は非奇形腫症例と類似した経過をたどったが、慢性的な不安と重積状態での発症が相違点として挙げられている。
pmid-35896086.summary_en: Case series of anti-LGI1 encephalitis including one teratoma-associated case. Teratoma composed of mostly thyroid tissue with positive LGI1 immunostaining. Teratoma case presented similarly to non-teratoma cases but with chronic anxiety and status epilepticus as distinguishing features.

pmid-35899265.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマに関連した傍腫瘍性脱髄病変の症例。脳MRIで内包病変を認め、腫瘍マーカー上昇と抗アンフィシン抗体陽性。根治的精巣摘除と化学療法・免疫療法で部分的改善。
pmid-35899265.summary_en: Case of 32-year-old Japanese man with testicular seminoma presenting with paraneoplastic tumefactive demyelination. Brain MRI showed lesion in internal capsule; blood showed tumor marker elevation and anti-amphiphysin antibodies. Radical orchiectomy followed by chemotherapy and immunotherapy partially improved neurological symptoms.

pmid-35899888.summary_ja: 少年の成熟小腸奇形腫症例。嚢胞性、充実性、石灰化成分を含む腸外胚細胞腫瘍。AFPとβ-hCGは正常。外科的切除のみで化学療法・放射線療法を要さず症状完全消失。
pmid-35899888.summary_en: Case report of mature jejunal teratoma (extragonadal GCT) in adolescent with anemia and abdominal mass. Contains cystic, solid, and calcified components. AFP and β-hCG were normal. Patient underwent surgical resection without requiring chemotherapy or radiotherapy.

pmid-35900314.summary_ja: 46,XX精巣性および卵精巣性性分化疾患（DSD）患者の性腺組織を組織学的に検討し、胚細胞悪性腫瘍の検出に焦点を当てた研究である。本コホートでは、思春期前の早期の前浸潤性および浸潤性悪性腫瘍が検出された。その内訳は未分化性腺組織5例、性腺芽腫5例、ディスジャーミノーマ1例であった。従来は低リスクと考えられてきた疾患群における知見であり、今後のさらなる研究の必要性が示されている。
pmid-35900314.summary_en: Study of histological findings in 46,XX testicular and ovotesticular disorders of sex development (DSD) with focus on germ cell malignancy. In 16 patients, early prepubertal malignancies were detected: five with undifferentiated gonadal tissue, five with gonadoblastoma, one with dysgerminoma.

pmid-35900555.summary_ja: 若年女性の卵巣原発扁平上皮癌症例報告。ほとんどが成熟奇形腫（全卵巣腫瘍の20%）から発生。膀胱、生殖器、肺、GI癌の転移を除外し、根治手術と補助化学療法・放射線治療で治療。
pmid-35900555.summary_en: Case report of de novo ovarian squamous cell carcinoma in young woman. Most cases arise from mature teratoma (20% of ovarian tumors). Diagnosis requires excluding metastases. Treatment involves radical surgery combined with adjuvant chemotherapy and radiation therapy.

pmid-35903506.summary_ja: 口蓋裂を伴う14ヶ月女児の鼻咽頭奇形腫症例。鼻咽頭奇形腫は全奇形腫の2%に過ぎず稀少で、口蓋裂との非典型的な関連性を示す。
pmid-35903506.summary_en: Case report of nasopharyngeal teratoma in 14-month-old girl with cleft palate. Nasopharyngeal teratomas represent only 2% of all teratomas and are rare. This case demonstrates an atypical association between nasopharyngeal teratoma and cleft palate.

pmid-35903864.summary_ja: 前縦隔非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍患者がBEP化学療法中にCOVID-19を発症した症例報告。COVID-19発症後16日で化学療法を再開し、その後手術を施行して完治。
pmid-35903864.summary_en: Case report of 18-year-old with primary mediastinal nonseminomatous GCT who developed mild COVID-19 during third cycle of BEP chemotherapy. Chemotherapy was successfully restarted on day 16 after COVID-19 onset, followed by surgery without COVID-19 recurrence.

pmid-35905234.summary_ja: 成人頭頸部胚細胞腫瘍のリンパ節転移での発症症例報告。顎下リンパ節転移から胚細胞腫瘍が確認され、化学療法中に原発巣が鼻腔に出現。WHO高悪性度未熟奇形腫と診断。
pmid-35905234.summary_en: Case report of adult head and neck GCT presenting with lymph node metastasis as initial symptom. 28-year-old woman with enlarged submandibular nodes; histology confirmed metastatic GCT. Primary tumor emerged in nasal cavity during chemotherapy, confirmed as WHO grade high immature teratoma (Norris grade 3).

pmid-35906286.summary_ja: 病期Iの非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍について、リンパ管侵襲以外の予後因子を検討したシステマティックレビューである。11件の研究で評価された20因子のうち、胎児性癌が腫瘍再発と最も強く関連していた。精巣網浸潤や卵黄嚢腫瘍優勢などは有望であったが、エビデンスは限定的であった。
pmid-35906286.summary_en: Systematic review of prognostic factors for stage I nonseminomatous GCT beyond lymphovascular invasion (LVI). Among 11 studies evaluating 20 potential factors, embryonal carcinoma showed strongest association with tumor relapse. Other factors (rete testis invasion, yolk sac tumor predominance) showed promising but limited evidence.

pmid-35907696.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の既往がある26歳男性の、残存後腹膜腫瘤に対する外科的管理の症例報告である。病理検査では未熟奇形腫と卵黄嚢腫瘍からなる混合型胚細胞腫瘍が確認された。腎自家移植を伴う切除により腫瘍陰性の切除断端を得ており、腎機能を温存することを目的とした手技である。
pmid-35907696.summary_en: Case report of surgical management of residual retroperitoneal mass in 26-year-old with nonseminomatous GCT. Pathology revealed mixed GCT composed of immature teratoma and yolk sac tumor. Kidney autotransplantation was performed to achieve tumor-free margins while preserving renal function.

pmid-35916971.summary_ja: 卵巣嚢胞性腫瘍のMRI鑑別診断に関する総説で5つの主要な画像パターンを解説。良性腫瘤、粘液性腫瘍、境界悪性/悪性病変、子宮内膜症由来腫瘍、奇形腫関連病変を含める。成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の壁結節（Rokitansky突起）が悪性を示さないことを強調。
pmid-35916971.summary_en: Review of MRI differential diagnosis of five common types of cystic ovarian tumors. Discusses benign masses, mucinous tumors, borderline/malignant lesions, endometriosis-derived tumors, and teratoma-related lesions. Emphasizes characteristic features of mature cystic teratoma with mural nodules (Rokitansky protuberance) that do not indicate malignancy.

pmid-35926809.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の病期分類システムに関する総説であり、特にAJCC病期分類マニュアル第8版に焦点を当てている。精巣がんは20〜40歳男性で最も多い充実性腫瘍であり、胚細胞腫瘍は精巣腫瘍の95%を占める。病期評価、治療への影響、危険因子、予後について検討している。
pmid-35926809.summary_en: Review of testicular germ cell tumor staging systems, particularly the 8th edition AJCC Staging Manual. Testicular cancer is most common solid neoplasm in men aged 20-40 years. GCTs account for 95% of all testicular tumors. Reviews staging assessment, treatment implications, risk factors, and prognostic outcomes.

pmid-35927927.summary_ja: 後腹膜原発の絨毛癌（外性器原性GCT）の症例報告。24 歳男性。胸膜炎性胸痛と肺転移で発症。β-hCG 著明高値（104,712 mIU/mL）。生検で転移性絨毛癌を確認。Stage IIIC GCT と診断。
pmid-35927927.summary_en: Case report of 24-year-old man with primary retroperitoneal choriocarcinoma (extragonadal GCT) presenting with pleuritic chest pain and lung metastases. Markedly elevated β-hCG (104,712 mIU/mL). CT-guided biopsy confirmed metastatic choriocarcinoma. Diagnosed as stage IIIC GCT with urgent chemotherapy initiated.

pmid-35930824.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍43例を対象に、SOX2およびPRAMEの発現を検討した研究である。SOX2は非セミノーマ性腫瘍で高発現し、PRAMEはセミノーマで高発現していた。これらの結果は、腫瘍進展における組織学的変化の分子基盤を支持するものである。
pmid-35930824.summary_en: Study of SOX2 and PRAME expression in 43 testicular germ cell tumor cases, including pure seminoma, nonseminomatous GCTs, embryonal carcinoma, and GCNIS. SOX2 higher in nonseminomatous tumors; PRAME higher in pure seminoma. Findings support model of molecular basis for histologic transformation during tumor progression.

pmid-35932143.summary_ja: 睾丸がん患者 338 例中 38 例の化学療法後後腹膜腫瘍切除術。完全切除 81.6%。病理組織：奇形腫 47.4%、壊死 26.3%。5 年無病生存率 50%、全生存率 65.8%。
pmid-35932143.summary_en: Study of 38 patients undergoing postchemotherapy retroperitoneal mass excision for testicular cancer (11.2% of 338 treated patients). Complete resection achieved in 81.6%. Histopathology: teratoma 47.4%, necrosis 26.3%. 5-year disease-free survival 50%, overall survival 65.8%.

pmid-35934321.summary_ja: 睾丸胚細胞腫瘍の血清バイオマーカー（miR-371a-3p および miR-372-3p）の臨床検査法の検証。miR-371a-3p 感度 81.8%、特異度 100%；miR-372-3p 感度 87.5%、特異度 94%。
pmid-35934321.summary_en: Validation study of laboratory-developed test for serum embryonic miRNAs (miR-371a-3p and miR-372-3p) as biomarkers for testicular germ cell tumors. Clinical accuracy evaluated in 34 GCT patients with active disease and 17 without. miR-371a-3p: sensitivity 81.8%, specificity 100%; miR-372-3p: sensitivity 87.5%, specificity 94%.

pmid-35935368.summary_ja: 性分化異常と Y 染色体を有する女児・思春期の性腺腫瘍リスク評価。22 例。27.3% が性腺新生物：ゴナドブラストーマ 5 例、ジスゲルミノーマ 3 例。46,XY 完全性腺萎縮で最高リスク（66.7%）。
pmid-35935368.summary_en: Retrospective study of gonadal tumor risk in pediatric/adolescent phenotypic females with disorders of sex development and Y chromosome (22 patients, 9 months-19 years). 27.3% had gonadal neoplasia: 5 gonadoblastomas, 3 dysgerminomas, 2 Leydig cell tumors. 46,XY complete gonadal dysgenesis had highest tumor risk (66.7%).

pmid-35936190.summary_ja: 絨毛性疾患（GTD）患者353例の10年間の後方視的検討。完全胞状奇胎65.2%、浸潤奇胎20.4%。頻度は1000妊娠当たり3.72例。吸引・搔爬法、化学療法、子宮全摘出術施行。96.29%が寛解達成。
pmid-35936190.summary_en: 10-year retrospective study of 353 gestational trophoblastic disease (GTD) patients. Complete mole 65.2%, invasive mole 20.4%. Disease frequency 3.72 per 1000 pregnancies. Treatment included suction evacuation (69.97%), chemotherapy (47.69%), hysterectomy (8.2%). Overall 96.29% achieved complete remission.

pmid-35936876.summary_ja: 卵巣皮様嚢腫（成熟奇形腫）の症例報告。生殖年齢女性における最も一般的な生殖細胞腫瘍。良性。腹腔鏡下手術で安全に摘出。嚢液漏出は合併症の可能性。
pmid-35936876.summary_en: Case report of ovarian dermoid cyst (mature teratoma), the most common germinative ovarian tumor in reproductive-aged women. Benign embryonal tumor with slow growth. Laparoscopic surgical removal performed successfully. Cyst contents leakage during surgery is common complication that can rarely cause chemical peritonitis.

pmid-35945757.summary_ja: 未熟卵巣奇形腫の術後に生じる骨盤内腫瘤を検討した10年間の後方視的研究である。5年無病生存率は74.3%、全生存率は96.5%であった。growing teratoma syndromeは20.0%、再発は7.7%に認められた。初発病変の破裂、リンパ節郭清、補助化学療法が無病生存期間の独立した予後因子として同定された。
pmid-35945757.summary_en: 10-year retrospective study of immature ovarian teratomas with focus on pelvic masses after surgery. 5-year disease-free survival 74.3%; overall survival 96.5%. Growing teratoma syndrome occurred in 20%, relapse in 7.7%. Rupture, lymph node dissection, and adjuvant chemotherapy were independent prognostic factors.

pmid-35948940.summary_ja: 卵巣奇形腫の稀な悪性型（悪性ストルマオバリイ）の症例。甲状腺組織を主に含む。全子宮切除術、両側付属器切除術、予防的全甲状腺切除術、および放射性ヨウ素アブレーションが施行。1年で無病。
pmid-35948940.summary_en: Case report of malignant struma ovarii (MSO), a rare malignant variant of ovarian teratoma containing predominantly thyroid tissue. Patient underwent total hysterectomy, bilateral adnexectomy, prophylactic total thyroidectomy, and radioactive iodine ablation. At 1-year follow-up, patient remained disease-free.

pmid-35952569.summary_ja: 前縦隔セミノーマの症例。上大静脈症候群と大きな心内血栓（7.2×3.8 cm）を伴う23歳男性。悪性胚細胞腫瘍を確認。治療中に死亡。合併症を伴うセミノーマの高い死亡率を強調。
pmid-35952569.summary_en: Case report of 23-year-old with primary mediastinal seminoma presenting with superior vena cava syndrome, dyspnea, and large intracardiac thrombus (7.2 × 3.8 cm). Biopsy confirmed malignant germ cell tumor. Despite medical management, patient died during planned radiotherapy, emphasizing high mortality of complicated mediastinal seminoma.

pmid-35965932.summary_ja: 外性器原性成熟奇形腫の小児症例（後縦隔部位置は稀）。組織成分と石灰化を含む大きな嚢胞性腫瘤。超音波ガイド下生検で良性外性器原性胚細胞腫瘍と診断。完全外科切除が行われた。
pmid-35965932.summary_en: Case report of 2.5-year-old with posterior mediastinal mature teratoma (extragonadal GCT), a rare location compared to typical anterior mediastinal presentation. Imaging revealed cystic mass with tissue component and calcification. Biopsy confirmed benign extragonadal germ cell tumor. Complete surgical excision performed.

pmid-35967159.summary_ja: 36歳男性で同側の停留精巣を伴う自然消退型精巣胚細胞腫瘍の症例。原発精巣病変の退縮が示唆されたにもかかわらず、後腹膜リンパ節腫大が認められた。生検で胎児性癌と奇形腫成分を含む混合型胚細胞腫瘍と診断された。同側の停留精巣を伴う報告としては2例目である。
pmid-35967159.summary_en: Case of burned-out testicular germ cell tumor in 36-year-old male with cryptorchidism. Presented with retroperitoneal lymphadenopathy despite apparent primary testicular regression. Biopsy revealed mixed GCT with embryonal carcinoma and teratoma components. Represents second reported case with ipsilateral cryptorchidism.

pmid-35968525.summary_ja: 転移性の精巣混合型胚細胞腫瘍に由来するリンパ節転移の自然破裂により、大量の後腹膜出血を呈した症例。全身治療歴のない患者で、外科的治療を行わず保存的に管理され、良好な転帰が得られた。まれで生命を脅かす胚細胞腫瘍の病像を示している。
pmid-35968525.summary_en: Case of metastatic testicular mixed germ cell tumor presenting with spontaneous retroperitoneal hemorrhage from lymph node metastasis rupture. Patient without prior systemic treatment managed conservatively without surgery with favorable outcome. Demonstrates rare life-threatening GCT presentation.

pmid-35971364.summary_ja: 抗NMDA受容体自己免疫脳炎と成熟卵巣嚢胞性奇形腫の症例。腹腔鏡卵巣摘出後、第154病日に神経症状完全回復。奇形腫検出・摘出の重要性を強調。
pmid-35971364.summary_en: Case of 27-year-old woman with autoimmune limbic encephalitis associated with anti-NMDA receptor antibodies and concurrent mature cystic ovarian teratoma. Single-port laparoscopic oophorectomy performed with complete neurological recovery at 154 days postoperatively.

pmid-35971543.summary_ja: 14才女児の巨大卵巣腫瘤が成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と診断。良悪性鑑別困難性と生殖温存を強調。腹腔鏡が小児卵巣病変の金標準。
pmid-35971543.summary_en: Case of 14-year-old female with giant ovarian mass managed laparoscopically, diagnosed as mature cystic teratoma with mature tissues. Emphasizes diagnostic challenges differentiating benign from malignant tumors and value of ovarian-sparing approach for fertility preservation.

pmid-35972012.summary_ja: 卵巣ダーモイド嚢胞102例の腹腔鏡/開放摘出成績。平均フォロー72ヶ月。超音波再発率は腹腔鏡群で低率。手術アプローチが再発検出に影響する可能性。
pmid-35972012.summary_en: Retrospective review of 102 women with ovarian dermoid cyst (mature teratoma) undergoing laparoscopic or open cystectomy with mean 72-month follow-up. Ultrasound-detected recurrence lower in laparoscopy group, suggesting surgical approach influences recurrence patterns.

pmid-35973038.summary_ja: 5800以上の腫瘍のPRAME発現を検索。セミノーマは78%高発現。診断特異性は限定的だが、PRAME陽性悪性腫瘍検出の信頼性ある方法を示唆。
pmid-35973038.summary_en: Large immunohistochemical study of PRAME expression across >5,800 tumors. Seminomas showed high PRAME expression (78%). While PRAME lacks diagnostic specificity, study documents expression in testicular seminoma and validates immunohistochemistry as reliable detection method.

pmid-35977130.summary_ja: 陰嚢腫瘤の総説。精巣捻転、精巣炎、水瘤、精索静脈瘤、精巣がん。臨床プレゼンテーション、画像診断を記載。GCTを含む鑑別診断の枠組み提示。
pmid-35977130.summary_en: Comprehensive review of scrotal and testicular masses including painful and painless conditions. Covers testicular torsion, epididymitis, hydrocele, varicocele, and testicular cancer. Discusses diagnostic approaches and clinical presentation with emphasis on early detection of potential GCT.

pmid-35982815.summary_ja: 卵巣ストルマオバーリ(成熟奇形腫内甲状腺組織)の悪性転化と腹膜転移。凍結胚保存後に手術と高用量放射性ヨウ素治療。完全奏効達成。
pmid-35982815.summary_en: Case of metastatic malignant struma ovarii (thyroid tissue within mature ovarian teratoma). Underwent embryo cryopreservation for fertility preservation followed by bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy and total thyroidectomy. Treated with high-dose radioiodine therapy with complete metastatic ablation.

pmid-35983109.summary_ja: 退縮した精巣胚細胞腫瘍を有する31歳男性で、非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の一成分として類上皮性栄養膜腫瘍（妊娠性絨毛性疾患関連腫瘍）が発生した症例報告。後腹膜リンパ節転移として提示された。胚細胞腫瘍と妊娠性絨毛性疾患由来腫瘍が重なるまれな病態である。
pmid-35983109.summary_en: Case report of epithelioid trophoblastic tumor (gestational trophoblastic disease) occurring as component of non-seminomatous germ cell tumor in 31-year-old male with regressed testicular GCT. Presents as retroperitoneal lymph node metastasis. Represents rare intersection of GCT and GTD-derived tumor.

pmid-35997696.summary_ja: 監視療法中の病期I精巣胚細胞腫瘍（セミノーマおよび非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍）患者を対象に、乳酸脱水素酵素（LDH）による再発検出の有用性を検討した。LDH高値が独立して再発を予測することはなく、画像検査が最も多い再発検出法であった。LDHは再発の単独指標としては限定的な価値しかないことが示唆された。
pmid-35997696.summary_en: Evaluates lactate dehydrogenase (LDH) utility in detecting relapse in stage I seminomatous and non-seminomatous testicular GCT on surveillance. LDH elevation never independently predicted relapse; imaging was most common detection mode. Suggests LDH has limited value as sole recurrence indicator.

pmid-36010875.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍を含む精巣腫瘍に対する超音波検査の包括的レビュー。走査法、撮像パラメータ、各腫瘍型の形態学的特徴を解説している。診断上の落とし穴を論じ、形態学的特徴づけには限界があるものの、超音波検査が第一選択の検査であることを示している。
pmid-36010875.summary_en: Comprehensive review of ultrasound imaging for testicular germ cell tumors. Outlines scanning technique, imaging parameters, and morphological features of different tumor types. Discusses diagnostic pitfalls and establishes ultrasound as first-line investigation despite limited morphological characterization.

pmid-36012938.summary_ja: 妊娠中の卵巣奇形腫を含む付属器腫瘤の腹腔鏡手術。18 cm奇形腫を妊娠10週に摘出。全例で合併症なく正期産達成。妊娠中GCT手術の微創治療の安全性。
pmid-36012938.summary_en: Reports laparoscopic surgical management of adnexal masses during pregnancy including an 18 cm ovarian teratoma removed at 10 weeks gestation. All patients had optimal postoperative recovery and normal term delivery. Demonstrates safety of minimally invasive GCT surgery during pregnancy.

pmid-36016622.summary_ja: 37歳女性の再発・難治性性腺外卵黄嚢腫瘍（腹膜腸間膜）の症例報告。初診時にαフェトプロテインが著明に上昇し、腸間膜に巨大な腫瘤を認めた。手術と複数の化学療法レジメン（BEP、VIP、TIP）による多段階治療を受けた。侵攻性の性腺外胚細胞腫瘍に対する多角的治療の一例である。
pmid-36016622.summary_en: Case report of recurrent and refractory extragonadal yolk sac tumor of peritoneal mesentery in a 37-year-old woman. Initial massive AFP elevation and mesenteric mass treated with multiple surgeries and various chemotherapy regimens (BEP, VIP, TIP). Illustrates multimodal management of aggressive extragonadal GCT.

pmid-36017281.summary_ja: 10ヶ月男児の先天性口蓋奇形腫(エピグナサス)症例。硬口蓋から口腔に伸展する軟硬組織腫瘤。手術治療で完全治癒。小児奇形腫の典型的プレゼンテーション。
pmid-36017281.summary_en: Case report of congenital epignathus (oral/palatal teratoma) in a 10-month-old male. CT imaging showed soft and hard tissue masses in the hard palate extending into oral cavity. Successfully treated surgically with complete recovery.

pmid-36018202.summary_ja: 寄生性結合双生児の手術治療。胎児腫と成熟奇形腫を含む異なる形態での提示。後腹膜および表面病変の複雑な解剖学的復元の課題。
pmid-36018202.summary_en: Describes surgical management of parasitic conjoined twins with various presentations including foetus in foetu and mature teratoma. Five cases involving retroperitoneal and external locations with discussion of embryologic mechanisms and surgical challenges.

pmid-36028450.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍に対する化学療法中の体組成変化を、141例を対象に検討した研究。CT画像から算出した指標を用いた。骨格筋量の減少は有害事象の発生率上昇と独立して関連していたが、脂肪量の変化には有意な関連が認められなかった。
pmid-36028450.summary_en: Examines body composition changes during chemotherapy for testicular germ cell tumors. Skeletal muscle loss was independently associated with higher adverse event rates in 141 patients, while fat mass changes were not significant.

pmid-36028719.summary_ja: 病期I精巣胚細胞腫瘍における再発を予測するバイオマーカーをレビューした。現在の指標（腫瘍サイズ、精巣網浸潤、リンパ管侵襲）は有用性が限られ、50〜85%の患者が過剰治療されうる。新規バイオマーカーは、補助療法を受ける患者の選択を改善し、過剰治療の低減に役立つと述べられている。
pmid-36028719.summary_en: Reviews biomarkers predicting relapse in stage I testicular germ cell tumors. Current markers (tumor size, rete testis invasion, lymphovascular invasion) have limited utility, with 50-85% overtreatment. Novel biomarkers could improve patient selection for adjuvant therapy.

pmid-36030288.summary_ja: 体細胞型悪性成分を有する男性精原細胞腫瘍36例の分子解析。広範な異数性、特異的なDNAメチル化プロフィール、TP53変異の濃縮（特に縦隔腫瘍で86%）、MDM2増幅（16%）、イソ12p（91%）を同定。体細胞型成分の組織型より同定そのものが重要であることを示唆している。
pmid-36030288.summary_en: Multi-platform molecular analysis of 36 male GCTs (testicular n=29, mediastinal n=7) with somatic-type malignancy components. Found widespread aneuploidy, distinct DNA methylation profiles, enriched TP53 mutations (especially mediastinal), and similar molecular profiles between conventional and somatic-type components.

pmid-36036317.summary_ja: 9ヶ月女児の膣卵黄嚢腫瘍症例で、カルボプラチン系化学療法6コース後、腹腔鏡・内視鏡補助後矢状アプローチにより機能温存下での腫瘍摘出を達成。病理学的に腫瘍陰性縁を確認し、6ヶ月間の無病生存を得ている。
