pmid-33723169.summary_en: A case report of complete androgen insensitivity syndrome (CAIS) in a phenotypic female presenting with malignant transformation of undescended intra-abdominal testis diagnosed as seminoma. CAIS is a rare X-linked recessive disorder causing androgen receptor mutation leading to hormone resistance. Case highlights potential for malignant change in undescended testes and importance of recognizing this complication.

pmid-33723758.summary_ja: 頭頸部小児病理における奇形腫を含む先天性発達性病変の包括的レビューである。ハマルトーマ、キャリストーマ、奇形腫、異所性、異位性病変について取り扱っている。多能性細胞起源と病因研究の今後の方向性を強調している。
pmid-33723758.summary_en: A comprehensive review of congenital developmental lesions in pediatric head and neck including hamartomas, choristomas, teratomas, ectopias, and heterotopias. Discussion of pathogenetic foundations and taxonomic designations for these lesions including nasal chondromesenchymal hamartoma with DICER1 syndrome, lingual choristoma, ectopic meningothelial elements, and teratomas. Emphasis on pluripotent cell origins and future directions.

pmid-33729863.summary_ja: 国際的な大規模コンソーシアムにより、1990年から2013年に治療された転移性セミノーマの男性2,451例を対象に、IGCCCG分類を再評価した研究である。現代のコホートでは、予後良好群における5年PFS(82%から89%)およびOS(86%から95%)が、元のIGCCCGデータと比較して改善していた。乳酸脱水素酵素(LDH)が追加の予後不良因子として同定された。
pmid-33729863.summary_en: A large international consortium study re-evaluating the International Germ-Cell Cancer Collaborative Group (IGCCCG) classification in 2,451 men with metastatic seminoma treated 1990-2013. Modern cohort showed improved five-year PFS (89% vs 82%) and OS (95% vs 86%) in good prognosis compared to original IGCCCG data. Lactate dehydrogenase (LDH) was identified as an additional adverse prognostic factor.

pmid-33730730.summary_ja: 化学療法抵抗性の転移性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の患者3例において、次世代シーケンシングを用いて薬剤標的となる変異を同定した臨床報告である。同定された変異にはKIT D820G、TP53、NPM1、ミスマッチ修復欠損が含まれた。スニチニブ(2例)またはペムブロリズマブ(1例)による標的療法により、9、12カ月以上、15カ月間の顕著な部分寛解が得られた。個別化された分子生物学的アプローチの実現可能性が示されている。
pmid-33730730.summary_en: A clinical report describing integration of next-generation sequencing to identify druggable mutations in three patients with chemorefractory metastatic testicular germ cell tumors. Mutations identified included KIT D820G, TP53, NPM1, and mismatch repair deficiency. Targeted therapy with sunitinib (n=2) or pembrolizumab (n=1) resulted in remarkable partial remissions lasting 9, 12+, and 15 months. Demonstrates feasibility of personalized molecular approach.

pmid-33732029.summary_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の患者132例(捻転37例、非捻転95例)を対象に、術前血液学的パラメータを検討した後方視的研究である。捻転例では、白血球数、好中球率・数、および好中球/リンパ球比が有意に高値であった。梗塞を伴う捻転例では、WBCが高く、ヘモグロビンおよび血小板/リンパ球比が低かった。これらのパラメータは捻転の予測や卵巣予備能の評価に役立つ可能性がある。
pmid-33732029.summary_en: A retrospective study of 132 patients (37 with torsion, 95 without) with mature cystic ovarian teratoma examining preoperative hematological parameters. White blood cell count, neutrophil percent and count, and neutrophil-to-lymphocyte ratio were significantly higher in torsion cases. In torsion cases with infarction, WBC was higher and hemoglobin/platelet-to-lymphocyte ratio lower. These parameters may help predict torsion and assess ovarian reserve.

pmid-33732424.summary_ja: 76歳無症状女性の両側成熟嚢胞性卵巣奇形腫内に良性甲状腺腫を伴う症例報告である。画像検査と腫瘍マーカーで悪性を示唆した。開腹術、全子宮摘出術と両側付属器切除を施行した。最終病理は両側成熟嚢胞性奇形腫であった。
pmid-33732424.summary_en: A case report of bilateral mature cystic teratomas with benign struma ovarii (ectopic thyroid tissue within teratoma) in a 76-year-old asymptomatic woman. Imaging suggested malignancy with high Risk of Ovarian Malignancy Assessment score. Exploratory laparotomy with total hysterectomy and bilateral adnexectomy was performed. Final pathology confirmed bilateral mature cystic teratomas with benign struma ovarii. Surgery remains the standard treatment.

pmid-33737296.summary_ja: テロメア長と精巣胚細胞腫瘍（TGCT）リスク間の関連性を検討したメンデル型無作為化研究である。2,049例と6,921対照を用いた解析で、遺伝的推測テロメア長はTGCTリスクと関連しなかった。より大規模な解析でも同様の結果であった。
pmid-33737296.summary_en: A Mendelian randomization and genetic study examining association between telomere length and testicular germ cell tumor (TGCT) risk using data from 2,049 cases and 6,921 controls. Genetically inferred telomere length was not associated with TGCT risk (OR 1.02, 95% CI 0.97-1.07). Larger analysis of 3,558 cases and 13,971 controls confirmed no association. Peripheral blood leukocyte telomere length is not a strong biomarker for TGCT risk.

pmid-33738005.summary_ja: 妊娠絨毛癌の転移による自発的脾破裂の症例報告である。23歳女性が脾破裂で発症した。妊娠絨毛癌は肺、肝臓、中枢神経系に転移しやすいが脾臓転移は稀である。脾破裂が疾患の初発症状であった。脾破裂は対処されたが患者は脳転移により1か月後に死亡した。
pmid-33738005.summary_en: A case report of spontaneous splenic rupture secondary to metastatic gestational choriocarcinoma in a 23-year-old female. Gestational choriocarcinoma typically metastasizes to lungs, liver, and CNS, but splenic metastases are unusual and may cause spontaneous rupture. Splenic rupture was the first presentation of occult choriocarcinoma. Although the emergency condition was managed, the patient died one month later from brain metastasis.

pmid-33738399.summary_ja: 重度の胎児水腫を伴う出生前診断心臓奇形腫の新生児（体重1160g）における外科的切除の症例報告である。帝王切開で28週に出産した。初期段階で心嚢液排液により安定化した。生後12日目に完全摘出を施行。病理組織学的に奇形腫と確認され、1年後に良好な臨床状態を達成した。
pmid-33738399.summary_en: A case report of successful surgical resection of a prenatally diagnosed pericardial teratoma in a 1160 g neonate with severe fetal hydrops. Patient underwent emergent cesarean delivery at 28 weeks. Initial pericardial drainage of 60 mL effusion provided stabilization. On day 12, complete tumor resection was performed at 1160 g body weight. Histopathology confirmed teratoma. Patient achieved excellent clinical condition one year post-surgery.

pmid-33739378.summary_ja: 60例の悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍を対象に、全エクソーム解析により生殖細胞系列および体細胞変異を同定した全エクソーム解析研究である。卵黄嚢腫瘍ではコピー数の減少と増加が多く認められた。POU5F1が最も高頻度に変異した遺伝子(10%超)であり、血液と腫瘍の両方で検出された生殖細胞系列変異としてKRT4、RPL14、PCSK6、PABPC3、SARM1が挙げられる。
pmid-33739378.summary_en: A whole-exome sequencing study identifying germline and somatic mutations in 60 malignant ovarian germ cell tumors. Copy number loss/gain were common in yolk sac tumors. POU5F1 was the most frequently mutated gene (>10%). Germline mutations detected in both blood and tumor samples included KRT4, RPL14, PCSK6, PABPC3, and SARM1. Results provide genetic insights into the pathogenesis of rare ovarian germ cell tumors.

pmid-33740550.summary_ja: 1975年から2016年のSEER登録による頭頸部悪性奇形腫63例の研究である。82.54%が小児患者であり、79.37%が乳幼児で診断された。小児では軟部組織が、成人では甲状腺が最多部位であった。5年生存率は乳幼児で45.83%、小児で46%であった。頭頸部奇形腫の予後は他部位より不良である。
pmid-33740550.summary_en: A SEER database study of 63 pediatric and adult head and neck malignant teratomas (1.96% of all malignant teratomas) from 1975-2016. 82.54% were pediatric with 79.37% diagnosed during infancy. Most common location was soft tissue in pediatrics and thyroid in adults. Five-year survival was 45.83% in infants and 46% in children. Pediatric head and neck teratomas showed worse prognosis compared to non-head and neck malignant teratomas.

pmid-33741258.summary_ja: 低リスク妊娠滋養膜疾患（FIGO/WHOスコア0-6）の治療戦略のレビューである。ほぼ100%の治癒率を達成する。第一選択単剤化学療法でhCG反応率は60-90%である。約25-30%が初期治療耐性を呈する。ほぼすべての治療失敗は集学的化学療法に反応する。スコアリングの改善と国際協力研究が必要である。
pmid-33741258.summary_en: A review of treatment strategies for low-risk gestational trophoblastic neoplasia (FIGO/WHO score 0-6) with nearly 100% cure rate. First-line single-agent chemotherapy with methotrexate or actinomycin-D achieves 60-90% hCG response rates. About 25-30% develop resistance to initial therapy. Despite challenges, almost all treatment failures respond to sequential or multiagent chemotherapy. Need for refined scoring and international collaborative studies is emphasized.

pmid-33742980.summary_ja: 再発した転移性精巣胚細胞腫瘍に対する治療選択肢をまとめた総説。早期再発は予後リスクで層別化され、3年全生存期間は超高リスク群の6%から超低リスク群の77%までである。救援療法には二次化学療法（TIP、PEI）や大量化学療法が含まれる。残存腫瘤の完全切除が重要である。経験豊富な施設での多角的治療により、長期治癒率は25～60%に達する。
pmid-33742980.summary_en: A comprehensive review of treatment options for relapsing metastatic testicular germ cell tumors. Early relapses are stratified by prognostic risk with three-year overall survival ranging from 6% (very high risk) to 77% (very low risk). Salvage therapy includes second-line chemotherapy (TIP, PEI) or high-dose chemotherapy. Complete resection of residual masses is essential. Multimodality treatment in experienced centers achieves 25-60% long-term cure rates.

pmid-33754611.summary_ja: 44歳男性が鼠径管を通じて後腹膜に広がる巨大な潰瘍性精巣腫瘍で発症した。スクロータム内に壊死現象を認めた。CT検査で後腹膜浸潤とリンパ節腫大が確認された。睾丸摘出術と陰嚢皮膚切除を施行。病理診断はセミノーマであった。シスプラチン系化学療法が施行され部分奏効を示したが、後に再発した。
pmid-33754611.summary_en: A 44-year-old male presented with a massive ulcerated testicular mass with retroperitoneal extension through the inguinal canal. Physical examination revealed necrotic phenomena within the scrotum. CT imaging confirmed bulky testicular mass with retroperitoneal involvement and lymph node enlargement. Orchiectomy and scrotum excision were performed. Histology confirmed seminoma. Patient received cisplatin-based chemotherapy with partial response, later relapsed.

pmid-33756161.summary_ja: 外傷後に偶発的に発見された巨大な後腹膜未分化奇形腫の症例である。腫瘍マーカーは正常範囲であった。外科的切除により未分化奇形腫が確認され、術中下大静脈損傷が認められたが修復された。患者は良好な経過をたどった。成人男性における原発性後腹膜未分化奇形腫の初例である。
pmid-33756161.summary_en: A 53-year-old male presented with a massive retroperitoneal immature teratoma incidentally detected following trauma. Tumor markers (AFP, hCG, LDH) were normal. Surgical resection was performed with histopathological confirmation of immature teratoma. An intraoperative vena cava injury required repair. The patient recovered well with good prognosis. This represents the first reported primary retroperitoneal immature teratoma in an adult male.

pmid-33759321.summary_ja: ヒト卵巣奇形腫癌細胞(PA-1)に対するシリング酸(SRA)の抗がん作用を検討したin vitro研究である。SRAは用量依存的に増殖を抑制し、カスパーゼ経路を介してアポトーシスを誘導し、STAT3/JNK/AKT経路を抑制した。これらの結果から、SRAは卵巣奇形腫の治療候補となる可能性が示唆される。
pmid-33759321.summary_en: In vitro study of syringic acid (SRA) anti-cancer effects on PA-1 human ovarian teratoma cancer cells. SRA dose-dependently suppressed proliferation, induced apoptosis via caspase cascade, and inhibited STAT3/JNK/AKT pathways. Findings suggest SRA as potential therapeutic candidate for ovarian teratoma treatment.

pmid-33763267.summary_ja: 精巣絨毛癌転移による十二指腸出血の症例。内視鏡治療で止血し、シスプラチン系化学療法で奏効。絨毛癌の稀な消化管転移合併症を示唆。
pmid-33763267.summary_en: 40-year-old male with testicular choriocarcinoma presenting with GI hemorrhage from metastatic duodenal lesion. Capsule and push endoscopy revealed bleeding ulcerated mass in proximal duodenum treated with hemospray. Pathology confirmed pure choriocarcinoma. Cisplatin-based chemotherapy successful; no recurrent bleeding at 3-month follow-up.

pmid-33767973.summary_ja: シスプラチン系化学療法を受けた精巣胚細胞腫瘍68例の分析。28%に血栓塞栓症発生、特にIII期疾患と化学療法サイクル増加で高リスク。高リスク患者への予防的抗凝固療法検討を提議。
pmid-33767973.summary_en: Retrospective analysis of 68 testicular GCT patients receiving platinum-based chemotherapy. 19 (28%) developed thromboembolic events (TEE), 68% during treatment. Stage III disease and greater chemotherapy cycles significantly increased TEE risk. Proposes consideration of prophylactic anticoagulation in high-risk GCT patients.

pmid-33767982.summary_ja: 精巣がんの腫瘍形成、進行、治療反応における長鎖非コードRNA(lncRNA)の役割を総説したものである。lncRNAのバイオマーカー、薬剤標的、治療薬としての可能性を検討し、二次性腫瘍、不妊、心血管疾患などの治療関連毒性を伴う精巣胚細胞腫瘍の管理改善を目指している。
pmid-33767982.summary_en: Review of long non-coding RNA (lncRNA) roles in testicular cancer tumorigenesis, progression, and treatment response. Discusses lncRNA potential as biomarkers, drug targets, and therapeutics to improve management of testicular GCTs while addressing treatment-related toxicities including secondary tumors, infertility, and cardiovascular disease.

pmid-33768807.summary_ja: 極低出生体重児の巨大先天性仙尾部奇形腫の症例。高度な血行動態障害による限定的治療の意思決定を示唆する臨床的課題を呈示。
pmid-33768807.summary_en: Brief case report of massive congenital sacrococcygeal teratoma in preterm infant with significant hemodynamic consequences. Raises clinical considerations regarding care limitation decisions in extreme prematurity with major congenital teratomas.

pmid-33768867.summary_ja: 帝王切開瘢痕に発生した再発性化学療法耐性絨毛癌の腹腔鏡治療。妊娠性栄養膜疾患の難治症例に対する低侵襲手術の可能性を示唆。
pmid-33768867.summary_en: Case report of laparoscopic treatment of recurrent chemoresistant choriocarcinoma in cesarean scar. Brief report confirming feasibility of laparoscopic approach for cesarean scar gestational trophoblastic disease in experienced hands.

pmid-33772392.summary_ja: 初期卵巣未熟奇形腫124例の子宮温存手術：単側卵管卵巣摘出術83例、嚢胞摘出術41例。再発率同等、妊娠成功率優秀（83.3%対85.7%、31例中26例妊娠成立）。化学療法併用嚢胞摘出術は妊孕性温存の選択肢。
pmid-33772392.summary_en: 124 early-stage ovarian immature teratoma (IMT) patients receiving fertility-sparing surgery: 83 unilateral salpingo-oophorectomy (USO), 41 cystectomy. Similar recurrence rates (5 vs 3), excellent pregnancy rates (83.3% USO vs 85.7% cystectomy, 26/31 successful pregnancies). USO is standard; cystectomy with adjuvant chemotherapy represents acceptable alternative.

pmid-33773600.summary_ja: 巨大骨盤腫瘍治療中に混合性腺性異形成と診断された成人女性。思春期の外性器異常指摘時にMGD診断が未付与、成人での悪性胚細胞腫瘍発症に至った。早期診断と予防的去勢の重要性を強調。
pmid-33773600.summary_en: Adult female with mixed gonadal dysgenesis (MGD, DSD-related) diagnosed during treatment for giant pelvic germ cell tumor. Initial puberty evaluation noted external genital abnormality but MGD diagnosis missed. Case illustrates importance of early MGD recognition to prevent gonadal tumor development through prophylactic gonadectomy.

pmid-33776695.summary_ja: 妊娠10週に診断された卵巣ジスジェルミノーマの稀有症例。超音波検査、外科手術、病理診断の協調により母児良好な転帰を獲得。妊娠中のがん治療個別化の重要性を示唆。
pmid-33776695.summary_en: Rare case of right ovarian dysgerminoma diagnosed at 10 weeks gestation in young female. Multidisciplinary management including early ultrasound detection, surgery, histopathology, and imaging resulted in favorable maternal-fetal outcomes. Demonstrates feasibility of cancer treatment during pregnancy with individualized approach.

pmid-33776737.summary_ja: 回帰性セミノーマで小腸転移による狭窄と後腹膜転移を呈した症例。免疫染色でOCT3/4陽性の腫瘍細胞と大量の浸潤リンパ球を認め、精巣は線維化のみ。補助BEP化学療法施行。
pmid-33776737.summary_en: Case report of 66-year-old with regressed seminoma presenting with jejunal obstruction and metastatic disease. Immunohistochemistry revealed OCT3/4, AE1/AE3, CD117, D2-40 positive tumor cells with massive lymphocyte infiltrates. Left testis showed extensive scar tissue without residual tumor. Adjuvant BEP chemotherapy administered.

pmid-33777092.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者の予後予測のためのRNA結合蛋白6個からなる予後リスクモデル構築。TCGA等のデータセットから無病生存期間との相関を同定し、複数コホートで検証。再発予測用ノモグラム作成。
pmid-33777092.summary_en: Prognostic model for testicular GCTs using six RNA-binding proteins (RBPs: TRMT61A, POLR2J, DIS3L2, IFIH1, IGHMBP2, NPM2) from TCGA and GEO datasets. LASSO regression identified RBP signature predicting disease-free survival with high specificity/sensitivity. Validated across multiple cohorts; nomogram constructed for recurrence prediction.

pmid-33777179.summary_ja: 低中所得国における前縦隔胚細胞腫瘍57例の臨床成績。セミノーマ20例は95%がBEP施行、94.7%奏効。非セミノーマ37例は中央生存期間9.06ヶ月で予後不良。非セミノーマの治療最適化が課題。
pmid-33777179.summary_en: 57-patient study of primary mediastinal GCTs (20 seminoma, 37 non-seminomatous) in low-middle income setting. Seminoma: 95% received BEP, 94.7% partial response, all alive/disease-free at 2 years. Non-seminomatous: 91.8% BEP/EP, median OS 9.06 months, 24.3% alive at 2 years. Higher mortality in non-seminomatous disease.

pmid-33782290.summary_ja: 左精巣胚細胞腫瘍の既往がある40歳男性の症例報告。経過観察中に後縦隔腫瘤が出現し、FDG-PET/CTで奇静脈の集積増加が認められた。造影CTで奇静脈腫瘍栓症が確認され、精巣胚細胞腫瘍に続発するものとされた。
pmid-33782290.summary_en: Case report of 40-year-old man with history of left testicular GCT and left nephrectomy with retroperitoneal lymph node dissection. During follow-up, developed posterior mediastinal mass with FDG-PET/CT showing increased activity in azygos vein. Contrast-enhanced CT revealed azygos vein tumor thrombosis secondary to testicular GCT.

pmid-33785312.summary_ja: 卵巣成熟奇形腫125例のCT/MRI特性分析。抗NMDAR脳炎患者8例の奇形腫は非脳炎患者と比較して腫瘍径が小さく（26.1mm対67.0mm）、石灰化率が低く（36%対75%）、脂肪成分に乏しい特徴を示した。
pmid-33785312.summary_en: CT/MRI study comparing imaging characteristics of ovarian mature teratomas in 125 women, with focus on 8 NMDAR-E patients versus 117 controls. Teratomas associated with NMDAR-E showed smaller size (26.1mm vs 67.0mm), lower calcification rate (36% vs 75%), and reduced fat component proportion compared to non-NMDAR-E group.

pmid-33786289.summary_ja: 前縦隔非セミノーマ型胚細胞腫瘍患者にBEP化学療法後続発した組織球肉腫の症例。腫瘍マーカー正常化後も腫瘍増大し肝脾転移を認め、初診から9ヶ月で死亡。二次悪性腫瘍の稀な合併症。
pmid-33786289.summary_en: Case report of 26-year-old with primary mediastinal non-seminomatous germ cell tumor (AFP 160.4 ng/mL) who developed histiocytic sarcoma as secondary malignancy following BEP chemotherapy. Despite chemotherapy response and normal AFP, residual tumor progressed with hepatosplenic metastases. Patient died 9 months after presentation with autopsy diagnosis of histiocytic sarcoma.

pmid-33787574.summary_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の悪性転化14例の臨床病理学的検討。発生率2.46%、平均年齢51.3歳、腫瘍径14cm。主に扁平上皮癌であり、完全減量術と化学療法で92%の奏効率、5年生存率31.2%。
pmid-33787574.summary_en: Case series of 14 patients with malignant transformation of ovarian mature cystic teratoma (MT-MCT), 2.46% incidence. Mean age 51.3 years, larger tumors (14cm mean), majority squamous cell carcinoma. Complete cytoreduction and carboplatin-paclitaxel chemotherapy achieved 92% response rate; 5-year OS 31.2%, DFS 31.6%.

pmid-33789803.summary_ja: 小児精巣腫瘍34例の20年間の回顧的研究。良性18例、悪性16例を含み、胚細胞腫瘍（卵黄嚢腫瘍、奇形腫、混合型）と性索間質腫瘍を分析。全体生存率97%、非GCNIS由来腫瘍が最多（56%）。延期された転移性疾患を除き予後は良好。
pmid-33789803.summary_en: 20-year retrospective study of pediatric testicular tumors in UK. Of 34 cases, 18 were benign and 16 malignant, including germ cell tumors (yolk sac, teratoma, mixed types), sex cord-stromal tumors. 97% survival rate; non-GCNIS tumors were most common (56%). Prognosis generally excellent except for delayed presentations with metastatic disease.

pmid-33792962.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマが、精巣網へ、さらに予想外に精管上皮へ Paget 様(上皮内)進展を示し、切除断端に達していた症例を報告する。この極めてまれな病理組織学的所見は、このような進展様式を示すセミノーマにおいて、正確な病期分類と最適な術後管理の決定に関する重要な課題を提起している。
pmid-33792962.summary_en: This case reports an unusual presentation of testicular seminoma with pagetoid (intraepithelial) spread into rete testis and unexpectedly into vas deferens epithelium to the surgical margin. This rare histopathological finding raises important issues regarding accurate staging and optimal post-surgical management decisions in seminomas with unusual patterns of spread.

pmid-33796464.summary_ja: 体細胞悪性転化（肉腫型）を伴う混合GCTが、GCT指向型化学療法で完全寛解を達成。肉腫組織診療法は無効。RNA-Seq、エクソーム解析で分子プロファイル解明。
pmid-33796464.summary_en: This case reports complete remission of a mixed germ cell tumor with somatic-type malignancy (sarcoma type) using GCT-oriented chemotherapy as salvage therapy. Initial sarcoma-histology-directed chemotherapy was ineffective, but GCT-based regimen achieved complete radiological response. Genomic profiling with RNA-sequencing and exome sequencing provided additional molecular insights into tumor biology.

pmid-33798590.summary_ja: 536件の胚細胞腫瘍検体を対象に、FISH、SNPアレイ、NGSを用いてイソクロモソーム12pおよび12p獲得の検出法を評価した研究である。12p獲得は男性GCTの約73%、女性GCTの約32%で認められた。12p獲得はGCTに対して感度77.2%、特異度97.3%を示した。FISHは腫瘍含有率の低い検体に対しても迅速に結果が得られるなどの利点がある。
pmid-33798590.summary_en: This study evaluated methods for detecting isochromosome 12p and 12p gains in 536 germ cell tumor specimens using FISH, SNP arrays, and NGS. 12p gains were found in ~73% of male GCTs and ~32% of female GCTs. Results showed 12p gains had 77.2% sensitivity and 97.3% specificity for GCT. FISH offers advantages including rapid turnaround for low-purity specimens.

pmid-33800799.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍の液体生検バイオマーカーをまとめた総説。古典的な血清腫瘍マーカー（AFP、hCG、LDH）、マイクロRNA、無細胞DNA、DNAメチル化マーカー、循環腫瘍細胞を扱う。低侵襲な診断、経過観察、治療反応性の予測を可能にし、組織生検がほとんど行われないという臨床上の課題に対応する。
pmid-33800799.summary_en: This review summarizes liquid biopsy biomarkers for germ cell tumors, including classical serum tumor markers (AFP, hCG, LDH), microRNAs, cell-free DNA, DNA methylation markers, and circulating tumor cells. Liquid biopsies enable minimally invasive diagnosis, monitoring, and therapy response prediction, addressing the clinical challenge that tissue biopsies are rarely performed in GCT practice.

pmid-33805658.summary_ja: α-ソラニン（ジャガイモ由来化合物）の絨毛癌JEG-3細胞に対する抗腫瘍効果を検証。コロニー形成抑制、アポトーシス誘導、MMP-2/9ダウンレギュレーション。体内外で腫瘍成長抑制。
pmid-33805658.summary_en: This study investigated anti-cancer effects of α-solanine (a potato-derived compound) on human choriocarcinoma JEG-3 cells. α-Solanine inhibited colony formation, reduced cell migration and invasion, and induced apoptosis in vitro and in vivo. The mechanism involved downregulation of matrix metalloproteinases and altered expression of apoptosis-related proteins.

pmid-33805941.summary_ja: 精巣GCTのエピジェネティクスに関する総説。DNA メチル化、ヒストン修飾、miRNAが感受性、進行、化学療法応答に関与。「分化または死滅」モデルを提唱。
pmid-33805941.summary_en: This mini-review examines epigenetics in testicular germ cell tumors (TGCTs), emphasizing DNA methylation, histone modifications, and miRNAs in TGCT susceptibility, progression, and chemotherapy response. Despite decades of genetic research identifying few targetable drivers, the authors propose a "differentiate or die" epigenetic model explaining TGCT tumorigenicity and curability.

pmid-33809521.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の組織標本で脈管侵襲を検出する人工知能アルゴリズムを開発した研究である。脈管侵襲は非セミノーマ性腫瘍における強力な予後因子である。AI分類器は疑わしい領域のフラグ付けにおいて適合率68%を示し、AIを用いた病理診断の実現可能性が示唆された。
pmid-33809521.summary_en: This study developed an artificial intelligence algorithm to detect lymphovascular invasion in testicular germ cell tumor histology slides. Lymphovascular invasion is a powerful prognostic factor in nonseminomatous tumors. The AI classifier showed 68% precision for flagging suspicious areas, suggesting feasibility of AI-assisted pathology in TGCT diagnosis and staging.

pmid-33814829.summary_ja: 卵巣胚細胞がん303例を対象とした後方視的研究で、再発性growing teratoma syndrome（GTS）が8例（2.6%）で確認された。GTSの大半は未熟奇形腫由来で、進行期であった。最適な外科的減量術により無病生存率は85.7%に達し、若年患者ではGTSが稀であっても良好に管理できることが示された。
pmid-33814829.summary_en: This retrospective study of 303 ovarian germ cell cancer patients identified 8 cases (2.6%) with recurrent growing teratoma syndrome (GTS). Most GTS cases originated from immature teratomas and were advanced stage. Optimal surgical cytoreduction achieved 85.7% disease-free survival, demonstrating that GTS can be successfully managed despite its rarity in young patients.

pmid-33818523.summary_ja: 精巣悪性腫瘍患者は他の疾患患者比較で著明な精子減少を示した。非セミノーマ型は最も低い精子数。凍結精子利用率は5.3%と低いが、生殖保存は有意義である。
pmid-33818523.summary_en: This retrospective study compared sperm quality in cancer patients before gonadotoxic treatment. Testicular malignancy patients showed significantly lower sperm counts than other patients, with nonseminomatous tumors showing the lowest counts. Although only 5.3% used cryopreserved sperm, sperm banking remains valuable for eligible GCT patients facing gonadotoxic therapy.

pmid-33822655.summary_ja: 1990～2013年に治療された患者9,728例のデータを用い、転移性非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の予後分類を更新した国際コンソーシアム研究。元のIGCCCG基準と比較して、全リスク群で転帰の改善が認められた。新たな予後モデルでは、乳酸脱水素酵素が上限正常値の2.5倍以上であることと肺転移が、追加の不良予後因子として特定された。
pmid-33822655.summary_en: This international consortium study updated prognostic classifications for metastatic nonseminomatous germ cell tumors using data from 9,728 patients treated 1990-2013. Improved outcomes were observed across all risk groups compared to original IGCCCG criteria. A novel prognostic model identified LDH ≥2.5× upper limit of normal and lung metastases as additional adverse factors.

pmid-33823933.summary_ja: 対応する原発性および転移性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の検体について、EPICアレイを用いたDNAメチル化解析を行った。組織型がメチル化パターンの主要な決定因子であった。シスプラチン耐性の胎児性癌では、顕著な高メチル化が認められた。本結果は、シスプラチン耐性疾患に対して、免疫療法との併用を含む脱メチル化剤の使用を支持するものである。
pmid-33823933.summary_en: This study analyzed DNA methylation patterns in matched primary and metastatic testicular germ cell tumor samples using EPIC arrays. Histology was the major methylation determinant; cisplatin-resistant embryonal carcinomas showed remarkable hypermethylation. Findings support hypomethylating agents, potentially combined with immunotherapies, for treating cisplatin-resistant disease.

pmid-33824593.summary_ja: 鼻腔の稀な卵黄嚢腫瘍症例で血清AFP上昇。当初純粋YSTと診断されたがINI-1欠失癌でYST分化を伴う。手術と放射線療法により治療され6ヶ月で再発なく、AFP値は正常化した。
pmid-33824593.summary_en: This case describes a rare nasal yolk sac tumor (YST) in a 55-year-old man with elevated serum AFP. Initially diagnosed as pure YST, molecular analysis revealed SMARCB1-deficient carcinoma with YST differentiation. Successful treatment combined surgery and radiotherapy with normalized AFP levels and no recurrence at 6-month follow-up.

pmid-33824772.summary_ja: 卵巣甲状腺腫は、主に甲状腺組織からなるまれな単一胚葉性の卵巣胚細胞腫瘍である。本稿では、サイログロブリン値の上昇を呈した56歳女性の再発性卵巣甲状腺腫の症例を報告する。妊娠可能年齢の患者においては、保存的外科的治療が治療として妥当であると考察している。
pmid-33824772.summary_en: Struma ovarii are rare monodermal ovarian germ cell tumors containing predominantly thyroid tissue. This case describes a 56-year-old woman with recurrent struma ovarii presenting with elevated thyroglobulin levels. Conservative surgical treatment is discussed as an appropriate management option for patients of childbearing age.

pmid-33832117.summary_ja: 妊娠38-39週の帝王切開時に偶発的に発見された卵巣ジスジェルミノーマ症例。純粋ジスジェルミノーマ、IA期と診断。妊娠とGCTの稀な共存を示し、帝王切開と付属器摘出術及び術後腫瘍マーカー監視戦略を記述。
pmid-33832117.summary_en: Case of ovarian dysgerminoma discovered incidentally during cesarean section at 38-39 weeks gestation in a 25-year-old primigravida. Pathology confirmed pure dysgerminoma, stage IA. Demonstrates management combining cesarean delivery with adnexectomy followed by surveillance with tumor markers and imaging.

pmid-33835857.summary_ja: COVID-19パンデミック中に入院を延期した妊娠関連絨毛がん症例。子宮穿孔と大量出血により生殖能を喪失。急速に進行する栄養膜疾患における治療遅延の重大な結果を示し、迅速な診断と治療の重要性を強調。
pmid-33835857.summary_en: Case of gestational choriocarcinoma patient who delayed hospital admission during COVID-19 pandemic, resulting in uterine rupture and massive intra-abdominal hemorrhage with loss of fertility. Demonstrates severe consequences of treatment delay in rapidly progressive trophoblastic disease and emphasizes urgent need for prompt diagnosis.

pmid-33838085.summary_ja: 停留精巣患者のAR遺伝子CAGリピート長を分析したメキシコ人集団研究。健常対照比で有意に長いCAGトラクトを検出。精巣GCTリスク関連の新規AR遺伝子欠失を特定。停留精巣とGCTの遺伝学的関連性を支持。
pmid-33838085.summary_en: Analyzes androgen receptor CAG trinucleotide repeat length in Mexican cryptorchidism patients. Shows significantly longer CAG tracts in cryptorchidism versus healthy controls. Identifies novel AR gene deletion previously associated with testicular GCT risk, supporting genetic link between cryptorchidism and testicular germ cell tumors.

pmid-33842209.summary_ja: 妊娠から10年以上経過後に腎転移による自発出血で発症した妊娠関連絨毛がん症例。亜臨床的原発腫瘍からの遅延転移を示す。生殖年齢女性の腎腫瘍の鑑別診断として重要。
pmid-33842209.summary_en: Case of metastatic gestational choriocarcinoma presenting as spontaneous bleeding renal mass over a decade after pregnancy. Demonstrates delayed metastasis from presumed subclinical primary tumor. Important for recognizing gestational choriocarcinoma as differential diagnosis of renal masses in reproductive-age women.

pmid-33847540.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマと神経内分泌腫瘍が同一精巣に共存した初の報告症例。両腫瘍がFISHで12p増幅を示しGCNISからの共通起源を示唆。GCT領域内の分子的異種性を示す稀な組織学的所見。
pmid-33847540.summary_en: First case of primary testicular neuroendocrine tumor coexisting with seminoma in ipsilateral testis. Both tumors demonstrate 12p amplification on FISH, indicating shared germ cell neoplasia in situ (GCNIS) origin. Demonstrates molecular heterogeneity and rare histologic presentation within germ cell tumors.

pmid-33848089.summary_ja: 化学療法後に後腹膜に残存腫瘤を有するNSGCTの症例に対するロボット支援後腹膜リンパ節郭清の動画症例報告。病理検査で思春期後奇形腫の転移が認められた。ロボット支援RPLNDは、GCT治療において開腹手術の代替として実行可能であり、侵襲が少ないことが示された。
pmid-33848089.summary_en: Video case report of robot-assisted retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy (RPLND) for NSGCT with residual retroperitoneal mass after chemotherapy. Pathology revealed post-pubertal teratoma metastasis. Demonstrates technical feasibility and minimal morbidity of robotic RPLND as alternative to open surgery in GCT management.

pmid-33850739.summary_ja: 574例のセミノーマのミスマッチ修復蛋白発現を分析。MLH1/PMS2欠損セミノーマを1例特定。セミノーマにおけるMMR欠損は頻度が非常に低く、リンパ球浸潤の要因ではないことを示唆する知見。
pmid-33850739.summary_en: Analyzes mismatch repair (MMR) protein expression in 574 seminomas using immunohistochemistry. Identifies one seminoma with MLH1/PMS2 loss and MSI-low pattern. Demonstrates MMR deficiency is extremely rare in seminomas (<0.2%), and not a determinant of lymphocyte infiltration characteristic of this GCT subtype.

pmid-33850760.summary_ja: 精巣GCTの予後予測に関連する5つのアポトーシス関連遺伝子を特定。疾患無再発生存の独立した予後因子として確認。リスク層別化と再発予測のための予後ノモグラムを開発。臨床的患者管理に有用。
pmid-33850760.summary_en: Identifies five apoptosis-related genes (CHGA, LPCAT1, PPP1CA, PSMB5, UBR2) as independent prognostic factors for disease-free survival in testicular GCT. Develops prognostic nomogram for risk stratification and recurrence prediction. Provides clinical tool for patient management in testicular germ cell tumors.

pmid-33851019.summary_ja: 髄外NSGCTからの両側副腎転移の稀な症例報告。副腎生検が非診断的で後腹膜リンパ節生検により診断確定。不要な副腎摘出術を回避し適切な化学療法に導いた重要な症例。
pmid-33851019.summary_en: Rare case of nonseminomatous germ cell tumor with bilateral adrenal metastases from retroperitoneal lymph node origin. Initial adrenal biopsy non-diagnostic; retroperitoneal lymph node biopsy confirmed diagnosis. Demonstrates importance of alternative biopsy sites and prevented unnecessary adrenalectomy in this GCT metastasis case.

pmid-33851642.summary_ja: 卵巣成熟奇形腫内に発生した結腸腺がんと神経内分泌腫瘍の同時性腫瘍症例。卵巣奇形腫における稀な複数の悪性転化を示す。成熟奇形腫の合併症と悪性転化の可能性を理解するうえで重要。
pmid-33851642.summary_en: Case of synchronous colonic adenocarcinoma and neuroendocrine tumor arising within mature cystic ovarian teratoma. Demonstrates rare dual malignancy transformation in mature teratoma, confirmed by immunohistochemistry. Important for understanding potential complications and malignant transformations of ovarian teratomas.

pmid-33852367.summary_ja: 副鼻腔に発生する髄外GCT（奇形癌肉腫）の症例報告。MRIおよびCT画像所見が真菌性副鼻腔炎を模倣することを示唆。この稀な髄外GCTの画像診断的特徴と鑑別診断の重要性を記述している。
pmid-33852367.summary_en: Case report of sinonasal teratoid carcinosarcoma, an extremely rare extragonadal germ cell tumor of paranasal sinuses. Describes MRI and CT imaging characteristics that can mimic fungal infections. Highlights diagnostic and imaging challenges in this rare extragonadal GCT presentation.

pmid-33853746.summary_ja: 1995年以降の精巣GCTの診療進展を25年間にわたりレビュー。セミノーマと非セミノーマGCTの診断・治療方法の進歩と今後の課題を記述。精巣がん管理の臨床的進展を総括する重要な総説。
pmid-33853746.summary_en: 25-year review of advances in testicular germ cell tumors since 1995, covering diagnostic methods and therapeutic strategies. Discusses management of seminomas and non-seminomatous GCTs across therapeutic disciplines. Identifies key clinical challenges and future directions in testicular cancer evaluation and treatment.

pmid-33862460.summary_ja: 本研究は、精巣胚細胞腫瘍においてDPPA2がSPOP-CUL3-RBX1 E3ユビキチンリガーゼ複合体のタンパク質分解基質であることを明らかにした。SPOPの発現低下は多能性マーカーのOCT4およびNanogを増加させ、悪性転化に寄与する。SPOP-DPPA2軸の機能異常が精巣胚細胞腫瘍の進行に関わることが示された。
pmid-33862460.summary_en: Identifies DPPA2 as a proteolytic substrate of SPOP-CUL3-RBX1 E3 ubiquitin-ligase complex in testicular GCT. SPOP downregulation increases pluripotency markers OCT4 and Nanog, contributing to malignant transformation. Reveals dysregulation of SPOP-DPPA2 axis in testicular germ cell tumor progression.

pmid-33865902.summary_ja: NCCIT胚胎がん細胞におけるNANOG発現のESE-1による転写制御機構を研究。ESE-1はNANOGプロモーター領域に直接結合して転写を抑制し、NANOG誘発性増殖を阻害する。GCT由来胚胎がんにおける多能性と分化制御の分子基盤を明らかにしている。
pmid-33865902.summary_en: Examines ESE-1 transcription factor regulation of NANOG expression in NCCIT embryonic carcinoma cells derived from germ cell tumors. ESE-1 acts as a transcriptional repressor inhibiting NANOG-induced proliferation through direct promoter binding. Reveals molecular mechanisms controlling pluripotency and differentiation in embryonic carcinoma.

pmid-33868944.summary_ja: 36歳患者の腎奇形腫の症例報告。画像検査で大きく複雑な嚢胞性病変として認められた。複数の胚葉の組織から成る、まれな性腺外胚細胞腫瘍である。根治的腎摘除術が行われ、病理組織学的に成熟奇形腫と診断された。
pmid-33868944.summary_en: Case report of renal teratoma in 36-year-old patient presenting as large complex cystic lesion on imaging. Rare extragonadal GCT composed of tissues from multiple germ layers. Radical nephrectomy performed with histopathologic diagnosis of mature teratoma.

pmid-33869715.summary_ja: 妊娠第3三半期に肺転移を第一徴候とした妊娠性絨毛癌症例。生存可能妊娠での絨毛癌診断の希少性と、非典型症状に対する鑑別診断での絨毛癌検討の重要性を強調。
pmid-33869715.summary_en: Case report of gestational choriocarcinoma presenting with pulmonary metastasis as primary manifestation during third trimester pregnancy. Highlights rarity of choriocarcinoma diagnosis in viable pregnancies and importance of including choriocarcinoma in differential diagnosis for atypical symptoms.

pmid-33870841.summary_ja: 小型過剰マーカー染色体を有するターナー症候群患者を対象とした後方視的研究。TS 69例中13例がsSMCを有し、SRY検査を受けた11例中10例が陽性であった。性腺摘除標本2例では、上皮内セミノーマを伴う性腺芽腫および上皮内セミノーマが認められた。性腺胚細胞腫瘍のリスク増加が強調されている。
pmid-33870841.summary_en: Retrospective study of Turner syndrome patients with small supernumerary marker chromosomes. Among 69 TS cases, 13 had sSMC; 10 of 11 SRY-tested were positive. Two gonadectomy specimens showed gonadoblastoma with seminoma in situ and seminoma in situ. Emphasizes increased GCT risk.

pmid-33871428.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍の形態学的、免疫組織化学的、分子的特性の包括的総説。2016 WHO分類、GCNIS関連セミノーマ・非セミノーマGCT、非GCNIS腫瘍（前思春期奇形腫、卵黄嚢腫瘍）、セックスコード・ストロマル腫瘍、分子的進展を論じる。
pmid-33871428.summary_en: Comprehensive review of testicular tumors including morphologic, immunohistochemical, and molecular features. Discusses 2016 WHO classification including GCNIS-related seminomatous/nonseminomatous GCTs, non-GCNIS tumors (prepubertal teratomas, yolk sac tumors), sex cord-stromal tumors, and molecular advances.

pmid-33875512.summary_ja: 妊娠第3三半期に喀血で発症した転移性妊娠性絨毛癌症例。生存可能妊娠での絨毛癌症状の希少性と早期診断の重要性を示す。母胎転帰改善のための迅速な治療が必須。
pmid-33875512.summary_en: Case report of metastatic gestational choriocarcinoma presenting with hemoptysis in third trimester pregnancy. Demonstrates rarity of choriocarcinoma manifestation in viable pregnancies and importance of early diagnosis and prompt treatment for improved maternal and fetal outcomes.

pmid-33877552.summary_ja: 卵巣卵黄嚢腫瘍269患者の人口ベース分析。中央年齢22.0歳、ほぼ一側性。5年生存率83.2%、疾患特異的生存率84.5%。年齢>50歳と卵巣外転移は予後不良と関連。
pmid-33877552.summary_en: Population-based analysis of 269 ovarian yolk sac tumor patients. Median age 22.0 years, mostly unilateral tumors. 5-year overall survival 83.2%, disease-specific survival 84.5%. Age >50 years and extra-ovarian spread associated with worse prognosis.

pmid-33885951.summary_ja: ドイツにおける精巣がん長期追跡費用（2000-2015年）分析。セミノーマGCT1期監視費用は€11,995から€4,430に低下。医療画像が資源の70%を占める。保険者から患者への費用転嫁を記録。
pmid-33885951.summary_en: Analysis of 10-year testicular cancer follow-up costs in Germany (2000-2015). Seminomatous GCT stage I surveillance declined from €11,995 to €4,430. Medical imaging accounted for 70% of resources. Documents economic burden and cost shifting from insurers to patients.

pmid-33886084.summary_ja: 精巣生殖細胞腫瘍の診断のためのmiR-371a-3pの診断精度に関する6試験1,835例のメタアナリシス。感度0.90、特異度0.93、AUC 0.94。精巣GCT診断の有用なバイオマーカーを確立。
pmid-33886084.summary_en: Systematic review and meta-analysis of 1,835 individuals in six studies assessing diagnostic accuracy of miR-371a-3p for testicular GCTs. Sensitivity 0.90, specificity 0.93, AUC 0.94. Establishes miR-371a-3p as viable biomarker for distinguishing testicular GCTs.

pmid-33887861.summary_ja: 穿孔による胸痛と膵酵素含有胸膜液を呈した前縦隔成熟奇形腫症例。10歳男児が緊急胸骨正中切開と胸腺切除術を施行。病理学的に良性成熟奇形腫。良性組織型でも穿孔リスクを示す。
pmid-33887861.summary_en: Case report of anterior mediastinal mature teratoma with spontaneous perforation presenting with chest pain and pleural effusion containing pancreatic enzymes. 10-year-old boy underwent emergency sternotomy and thymectomy. Histology confirmed mature teratoma without malignant elements.

pmid-33888146.summary_ja: 転移性非妊娠性卵巣純粋絨毛癌の症例報告。DNA STR分析で非妊娠性起源を確認。MEA化学療法とBEP化学療法の両方に抵抗性を示し、診断後21ヶ月で死亡。予後不良。
pmid-33888146.summary_en: Case report of metastatic nongestational pure choriocarcinoma of ovary with poor prognosis. DNA STR analysis confirmed nongestational origin. Patient refractory to both gestational and nongestational chemotherapy regimens (MEA and BEP therapy), dying 21 months after diagnosis.

pmid-33889701.summary_ja: 28歳女性の肺原発性絨毛癌の症例報告。無月経と上昇β-hCGで妊娠未知部位を模倣。原発性胎外絨毛癌の希少性と生殖年齢女性のhCG上昇時の診断重要性を示す。
pmid-33889701.summary_en: Case report of primary choriocarcinoma of the lung in 28-year-old woman presenting with amenorrhea and elevated β-hCG mimicking unknown-location pregnancy. Demonstrates rarity of primary extragonadal choriocarcinoma and diagnostic importance in reproductive-age women with elevated hCG.

pmid-33889702.summary_ja: 閉経後女性の子宮内卵黄嚢腫瘍の症例報告と文献レビュー。報告18例中7例が純粋卵黄嚢腫瘍。免疫組織化学により腫瘍細胞逆分化が胎外卵黄嚢腫瘍発生メカニズムを示唆。
pmid-33889702.summary_en: Case report and literature review of yolk sac tumor of endometrium in postmenopausal woman. Seven of eighteen reported endometrial YST cases were pure YST. Immunohistochemistry suggests somatic tumor cell retro-differentiation as mechanism for extragonadal YST genesis.

pmid-33890816.summary_ja: 複数の腫瘍型にわたるPRAMEがん精巣抗原の発現を免疫組織化学的に検討した研究。セミノーマではびまん性のPRAME発現が認められ、他の癌腫では発現の程度が様々であった。PRAMEは胚細胞腫瘍およびその他の新生物における診断マーカーとして有用であることを示している。
pmid-33890816.summary_en: Immunohistochemical study of PRAME cancer-testis antigen expression across multiple tumor types. Found diffuse PRAME expression in seminomas and variable expression in other carcinomas. Demonstrates PRAME as diagnostic marker in germ cell tumors and other neoplasms.

pmid-33893031.summary_ja: 小児精巣腫瘍320患者の精巣温存手術に関するシステマティックレビューとメタアナリシス。奇形腫49.6%、卵黄嚢腫瘍23.1%が最多で、良性率70.9%。低再発率5.8%がTSSの有効性を支持。
pmid-33893031.summary_en: Systematic review and meta-analysis of testis-sparing surgery in 320 childhood testicular tumor patients. Teratoma (49.6%) and yolk sac tumor (23.1%) were most common histologies; 70.9% were benign. Very low 5.8% recurrence rate supports TSS in benign lesions.

pmid-33894120.summary_ja: 呼吸窮迫を呈した早産児頸部の大型成熟奇形腫症例。病理学的に多層胚葉由来組織（筋肉、脳、唾液腺、肺組織）を含む成熟奇形腫を確認。出生前診断とEXIT手術を検討。
pmid-33894120.summary_en: Case report of large mature teratoma in premature newborn's neck causing respiratory distress. Histopathology confirmed mature teratoma with tissues from multiple germ layers (muscle, brain, salivary, pulmonary tissues). Discusses prenatal diagnosis and EXIT procedures for management.

pmid-33897926.summary_ja: 76歳男性の骨盤内に広範な成熟嚢胞性奇形腫が生じ、6年間にわたり慢性前立腺膿瘍として誤診された症例報告。成人男性の骨盤内における成熟奇形腫のまれさと、培養陰性の場合などにおける鑑別診断の重要性を示している。
pmid-33897926.summary_en: Case report of extensive mature cystic teratoma in 76-year-old male pelvis, misdiagnosed as chronic prostate abscess for six years. Demonstrates rarity of mature teratomas in adult male pelvis and importance of differential diagnosis, particularly when cultures are negative.

pmid-33898029.summary_ja: 13歳の女児に生じた混合型卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の症例報告で、良好な経過をたどった。臨床像、組織学的分布、予後について小児と成人の差異を考察している。生殖機能温存のための保存的手術と、診断およびフォローアップのための腫瘍マーカーの重要性を強調している。
pmid-33898029.summary_en: Case report of mixed ovarian germ cell tumor in 13-year-old girl with favorable outcome. Discusses clinical presentation, histologic distribution, and prognostic differences between pediatric and adult populations. Emphasizes conservative surgery for fertility preservation and tumor markers for diagnosis and follow-up.

pmid-33906346.summary_ja: 胎児期および新生児期に発生する、最も一般的なI型性腺外胚細胞腫瘍である仙尾部奇形腫の包括的レビュー。胚発生、解剖学的位置に基づく手術アプローチ、腫瘍マーカーであるαフェトプロテイン(AFP)、肛門直腸および泌尿器の合併症を含む長期的後遺症について考察している。
pmid-33906346.summary_en: Comprehensive review of sacrococcygeal teratoma (SCT), the most common type I extragonadal GCT occurring in fetal and neonatal periods. Discusses embryogenesis, surgical approaches based on anatomic location, tumor markers (AFP), and long-term sequelae including anorectal and urological complications.

pmid-33907877.summary_ja: デンマーク人口ベース症例対照研究で178例の小児GCT症例（卵黄嚢腫瘍50例、奇形腫65例）を分析。母親の教育職および高社会接触職業と卵黄嚢腫瘍有意関連。小児GCT発症における職業的危険因子の疫学的根拠を提供。
pmid-33907877.summary_en: Case-control study of 178 childhood GCT cases (50 yolk sac tumors, 65 teratomas) in Denmark. Maternal employment in education and high social contact occupations significantly associated with offspring yolk sac tumors. Provides epidemiologic evidence for occupational risk factors in childhood GCT development.

pmid-33912935.summary_ja: マウス精巣奇形腫モデル（129.MOLF-Chr19）を用いた研究であり、精巣胚細胞腫瘍が性特異的分化の重要な調節因子であるNANOS2を発現しない胚細胞から生じることを示している。NANOS2欠損胚細胞は多能性を保持し、胎児性癌の表現型を獲得する。
pmid-33912935.summary_en: Study using mouse testicular teratoma model (129.MOLF-Chr19) demonstrating that testicular germ cell tumors arise from germ cells failing to express NANOS2, a key regulator of sex-specific differentiation. NANOS2-deficient germ cells retain pluripotency and develop embryonal carcinoma phenotype.

pmid-33913479.summary_ja: 発生過程における胚細胞の決定と胚細胞腫瘍の発生起源を論じた総説。胚細胞腫瘍は、生殖腺への定着の有無にかかわらず、配偶子形成への決定を行えなかった細胞から生じるというモデルを提案している。腫瘍内の細胞型の多様性は、移動性原始生殖細胞の広い発生能を反映するとされる。
pmid-33913479.summary_en: Review article discussing germ cell determination during development and the developmental origin of germ cell tumors. Proposes that GCTs arise from cells failing to commit to gametogenesis (germ cell determination) regardless of gonadal colonization. Suggests tumor diversity reflects broad developmental potential of migratory primordial germ cells.

pmid-33916078.summary_ja: 散発性296例および家族性305例の精巣胚細胞腫瘍について、腫瘍の組織構成、リンパ球浸潤、精巣内胚細胞腫瘍性病変（GCNIS）、精巣微小石灰化を病理組織学的に比較した。両群の間に明確な差は認められなかった。加齢に伴いリンパ球浸潤は増加し、GCNISおよび精巣微小石灰化は減少する傾向が示された。
pmid-33916078.summary_en: Histopathological comparison of 296 sporadic and 305 familial testicular germ cell tumors (TGCTs) examining tumor composition, lymphocytic infiltration, germ cell neoplasia in situ (GCNIS), and testicular microlithiasis. Age-related changes showed increased lymphocytic infiltration and decreased GCNIS with advancing age.

pmid-33916925.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍180例における免疫チェックポイント蛋白（VISTA、PD-L1）と全身炎症マーカーの予後予測値を検討。低VISTA発現と高血小板・リンパ球比の組み合わせが進行GCTの予後不良を予測。
pmid-33916925.summary_en: Study of immune checkpoint proteins (VISTA and PD-L1) and systemic inflammation markers as prognostic predictors in 180 testicular germ cell tumor (GCT) patients. Low VISTA expression combined with high platelet-to-lymphocyte ratio predicted shorter event-free and overall survival in advanced GCTs.

pmid-33922599.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の胚細胞がん幹細胞を標的とした分化誘導療法の研究。チオリダジンとサリノマイシンが胚細胞がん幹細胞の分化を誘導し、腫瘍形成能を低減させ、有毒な化学療法の代替治療となりうる可能性を示唆。
pmid-33922599.summary_en: Study of differentiation therapy targeting embryonal carcinoma cancer stem cells in testicular germ cell tumors (TGCTs). FDA-approved drugs thioridazine and salinomycin induce EC differentiation and reduce tumorigenic potential in vitro and in vivo. Suggests thioridazine as effective TGCT treatment avoiding chemotherapy toxicity.

pmid-33923996.summary_ja: シスプラチン耐性精巣胚細胞腫瘍に対するWnt/β-catenin経路阻害剤の治療効果を検討。PRI-724がNTERA-2耐性細胞で効果を示し、Wnt/β-catenin経路が耐性GCTの治療標的として有用な可能性を示唆。
pmid-33923996.summary_en: Study investigating Wnt/β-catenin signaling inhibitors (LGK974, PRI-724) as potential treatment for cisplatin-resistant testicular germ cell tumors (GCTs). Using cisplatin-resistant GCT cell lines, PRI-724 showed selective efficacy against NTERA-2 resistant cells with pro-apoptotic effects across all lines.

pmid-33933657.summary_ja: 妊娠16週の卵巣奇形腫（16cm）に対する腹腔鏡下単孔in-bag摘出術の技術報告。新規技術により内容物漏出を防ぎながら効率的な摘出が可能で、母児とも良好な経過を示した。
pmid-33933657.summary_en: Technical report of novel laparoscopic single-site in-bag ovarian cystectomy for large ovarian dermoid cyst (teratoma) in pregnancy. 26-year-old at 16 weeks gestation with 16 cm × 10 cm × 12 cm dermoid cyst underwent successful minimally invasive surgery with good fetal and maternal outcomes.

pmid-33934450.summary_ja: 卵巣成熟奇形腫から発生した神経芽細胞腫の症例。全ゲノム解析で広範なLOHが検出され、腫瘍抑制遺伝子の変異が顕性化することで神経芽細胞腫への転化機序が示唆された。
pmid-33934450.summary_en: Advanced neuroblastoma arising within mature ovarian teratoma with clonal evidence of evolution from teratoma cells. Whole-exome sequencing revealed extensive copy-neutral loss of heterozygosity in both components. Demonstrates malignant transformation mechanism where LOH forces heterozygous germline variants homozygous.

pmid-33934699.summary_ja: 妊娠中に発見された卵巣struma ovariの再発と腹膜播種性甲状腺腫の症例。良性であっても腹膜播種は悪性腫瘍類似の生物学的振る舞いを示し、完全切除の重要性が強調された。
pmid-33934699.summary_en: Case report of recurrent benign struma ovarii (thyroid tissue in ovarian teratoma) with dissemination of nodules in peritoneal cavity during pregnancy. Though histologically benign, peritoneal strumosis shows biologically aggressive behavior. Emphasizes importance of complete resection.

pmid-33936236.summary_ja: 当初原発性腺癌と誤診された複数の肝腫瘤として発症した、消失型成分を伴う思春期後精巣奇形腫の稀な症例。陰嚢超音波検査で精巣内病変が認められ、精巣由来であることが示された。病理組織学的検査により診断が確定した。
pmid-33936236.summary_en: Rare case of post-pubertal testicular teratoma with burned-out component presenting as multiple liver masses initially misdiagnosed as primary adenocarcinoma. Scrotal ultrasound revealed intratesticular lesion confirming testicular origin; histopathology confirmed diagnosis.

pmid-33936718.summary_ja: 縦隔混合胚細胞腫瘍に同時発生した巨核芽球性白血病の症例。MGCT患者では予後不良なAMLの合併に注意が必要であり、組織学的精査の重要性が示唆された。
pmid-33936718.summary_en: Case report of acute megakaryoblastic leukemia (AML) arising concurrently with mediastinal mixed germ cell tumor (MGCT). The combination demonstrates known association between AML and MGCT with dismal prognosis, highlighting importance of careful pathologic examination.

pmid-33936892.summary_ja: 34歳男性の巨大仙骨部奇形腫症例。肛門周囲膿瘍を偽装し、長期経過後に診断された。放射線画像と組織学的検査で確認され、長期肛門周囲腫脹の鑑別診断における重要性が示唆された。
pmid-33936892.summary_en: Rare case of giant sacrococcygeal teratoma in a 34-year-old male presenting as perianal abscess with spontaneous rupture. Diagnosis by imaging and histopathology confirmed teratoma with long-standing indolent course; surgical excision with coccygectomy achieved good outcome.

pmid-33937155.summary_ja: 小児胚細胞腫瘍の管理上の課題を報告。良性と悪性成分の共存の可能性、乳幼児期の生理的AFP上昇の解釈、稀な後腹膜発生例の治療上の注意点が強調された。
pmid-33937155.summary_en: Case reports of pediatric germ cell tumors highlighting management challenges and unusual features. Key issues include potential coexistence of benign and malignant components, interpretation of elevated serum AFP in infants, and rare retroperitoneal presentations with local invasiveness requiring careful surgical consideration.

pmid-33937452.summary_ja: 血清ポリ塩化ビフェニル（PCB）レベルと精巣胚細胞腫瘍リスクの関連を検討した疫学研究。診断年齢と組織型別に層別化し、PCB暴露パターンと加齢の相互作用を調査。
pmid-33937452.summary_en: Population-based case-control study investigating associations between serum polychlorinated biphenyl (PCB) levels and testicular germ cell tumor (TGCT) risk. Data stratified by age at diagnosis and histologic type (seminoma vs. non-seminoma) to examine how PCB bioaccumulation patterns differ with age.

pmid-33937779.summary_ja: 仙骨部奇形腫切除術後の新生児2例における超音波ガイド下仙骨多裂筋平面ブロックの使用経験。従来の硬膜外麻酔が困難な部位における有効な鎮痛技法が示された。
pmid-33937779.summary_en: Two neonatal cases of sacrococcygeal teratoma undergoing surgical excision with regional anesthesia using ultrasound-guided sacral multifidus plane block. The technique proved effective for post-operative analgesia while avoiding conventional regional techniques problematic in this location.

pmid-33955122.summary_ja: 絨毛癌においてmiR-373-3pによるEMT抑制とTGFβR2標的化を示し、転移抑制の治療標的となる可能性を提案した。
pmid-33955122.summary_en: Studies miR-373-3p's role in choriocarcinoma (gestational trophoblastic disease), showing upregulation inhibits epithelial-mesenchymal transition (EMT) by targeting TGFβR2. Demonstrates that miR-373-3p suppresses migration of choriocarcinoma cells, suggesting potential as therapeutic target to inhibit metastasis.

pmid-33958236.summary_ja: 胎盤と腫瘍の構造機能比較に関する総説。絨毛癌と栄養膜腫瘍について侵襲性と分化能の観点から分析した。
pmid-33958236.summary_en: Comprehensive review comparing placental and tumor biology, analyzing parallels in invasiveness and metastasis. Discusses choriocarcinomas and trophoblastic neoplasias as unique malignancies derived from abnormal trophoblast, including mechanisms of invasiveness, role of invasion-restraining molecules, and comparison with cancer stem cells.

pmid-33959446.summary_ja: 56歳男性の前立腺原発性性腺外セミノーマの症例報告。腫瘤径は10.2 cmであった。放射線療法単独(20分割で50 Gy)で治療し、化学療法を行わずに治療後24か月の時点で無病の状態を得た。非転移性の性腺外セミノーマに対し、放射線療法が治療選択肢となりうることが示唆された。
pmid-33959446.summary_en: Case report of primary extragonadal seminoma of the prostate (10.2 cm) in 56-year-old male treated with radiotherapy alone (50 Gy in 20 fractions). Patient achieved disease-free status at 24 months without chemotherapy, suggesting radiotherapy as viable option for non-metastatic extragonadal seminomas.

pmid-33959785.summary_ja: 精巣がん患者のロボット支援後腹膜リンパ節郭清の安全性と有効性を報告。神経温存で70.6%の前向き射精が保持された。
pmid-33959785.summary_en: Multi-institutional study of post-chemotherapy robot-assisted retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (PC-RARPLND) in 43 testicular cancer patients. Demonstrates safety and efficacy with low morbidity, mean operative time 374 minutes, 55% necrosis/fibrosis, 37% teratoma, 7% viable tumor. Antegrade ejaculation preserved in 71% with nerve sparing.

pmid-33963590.summary_ja: 精巣精子細胞腫瘍の診断にSSX_CT免疫染色が高感度・高特異度のバイオマーカーであることを示した。他のGCT亜型との鑑別に有用。
pmid-33963590.summary_en: Evaluates SSX_CT (C-terminal region of SSX protein) immunostaining as diagnostic biomarker for spermatocytic tumors (rare testicular GCT). Demonstrates diffuse positivity in 93% of spermatocytic tumors with high specificity compared to other GCT subtypes (seminoma, embryonal carcinoma, yolk sac tumor, choriocarcinoma, teratoma).

pmid-33964115.summary_ja: 2010年から2021年の文献に基づき、陰嚢病変における多パラメトリックMRIの適応をまとめたシステマティックレビュー。腫瘍型の鑑別、精巣悪性腫瘍の局所病期分類、手術が遅れる場合のセミノーマと非セミノーマ性腫瘍の鑑別、急性陰嚢の評価など、陰嚢MRIが診断的価値を加える主要な臨床場面を示している。
pmid-33964115.summary_en: Systematic review of multiparametric MRI indications for scrotal pathology based on 2010-2021 literature. Outlines key clinical scenarios where scrotal MRI adds diagnostic value: differentiating tumor types, local staging of testicular malignancies, discriminating seminomas from non-seminomatous tumors when surgery is delayed, and assessing acute scrotum.

pmid-33968500.summary_ja: 精巣非セミノーマの絨毛癌症候群について、HCG上昇に伴う甲状腺機能亢進症と肺出血を述べた。軽度HCG上昇での症候発症例。
pmid-33968500.summary_en: Describes choriocarcinoma syndrome in testicular non-seminomatous GCT: paraneoplastic hyperthyroidism and pulmonary hemorrhage/ARDS induced by markedly elevated HCG. Reports unusual case with both syndromes despite only mildly elevated HCG levels, questioning quantitative HCG thresholds for paraneoplastic manifestations.

pmid-33968653.summary_ja: miR-371a-3pとmiR-375-5pの併用発現が、化学療法後の残存腫瘤において生存腫瘍・奇形腫を壊死・線維化から高精度に区別できることを示した(AUC 0.94、感度・特異度93.75%)。不要な化学療法後RPLNDを避けるべき患者を同定するバイオマーカーとして提案されている。
pmid-33968653.summary_en: Demonstrates that combined miR-371a-3p and miR-375-5p expression accurately distinguishes viable tumor and teratoma from necrosis/fibrosis in post-chemotherapy residual masses (AUC 0.94, sensitivity/specificity 93.75%). Proposes these miRNAs as biomarkers to identify patients who can be spared unnecessary post-chemotherapy RPLND.

pmid-33968659.summary_ja: セミノーマのシスプラチン耐性にm6Aメチル化による自食作用が関与することを明かした。METTL3/ATG5軸が治療標的候補。
pmid-33968659.summary_en: Investigates role of m6A methylation (via METTL3 methyltransferase) in autophagy and cisplatin resistance in seminoma cells. Shows METTL3 upregulation increases ATG5 methylation, enhancing autophagy and chemoresistance. Identifies METTL3 as potential therapeutic target to overcome cisplatin resistance in seminoma.

pmid-33968669.summary_ja: 64歳女性の原発性腎悪性奇形腫のまれな症例報告と文献レビュー。腎摘除術と補助BEP化学療法を受けたが、肺および肝転移を生じた。この希少な悪性腫瘍について、予後が不良であること、標準化された治療方針の必要性が強調されている。
pmid-33968669.summary_en: Rare case report and literature review of primary malignant teratoma of the kidney in a 64-year-old female. Patient underwent nephrectomy with adjuvant BEP chemotherapy but developed pulmonary and hepatic metastases. Emphasizes poor prognosis and need for standardized treatment approaches for this rare malignancy.

pmid-33969110.summary_ja: 低侵襲手術中の電動細切機による卵巣卵黄嚢腫瘍播種症例。固形腫瘤に対する電動細切機回避の重要性を強調。
pmid-33969110.summary_en: Case report of disseminated ovarian endodermal sinus tumor (yolk sac tumor) following uncontained power morcellation in a 15-year-old. Emphasizes risks of tissue dissemination during laparoscopic surgery and the FDA recommendation against power morcellation for suspected malignant solid adnexal masses.

pmid-33972495.summary_ja: 19歳女性で、胞状奇胎が完全に排出される前に妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍(GTN)へ早期移行した症例報告。腫瘤が早期に出現し、病期II GTNが疑われた。まれな早期GTN発現として、慎重な臨床評価の必要性が示された。
pmid-33972495.summary_en: Case report of early transformation of hydatidiform mole into gestational trophoblastic neoplasia (GTN) in a 19-year-old. Presents with concurrent vaginal mass suspicious for stage II GTN before complete mole evacuation, representing rare early GTN manifestation requiring careful clinical evaluation.

pmid-33976047.summary_ja: 82歳の女性で、ステージIVの胆管がんと直径33cmの巨大な良性卵巣奇形腫を合併した症例である。奇形腫を外科的切除したところ、QOLと症状の改善が顕著であった。進行がん患者においても、症状を引き起こす良性腫瘍の切除が緩和的な利益をもたらす可能性が示された。
pmid-33976047.summary_en: Case of 82-year-old with stage IV cholangiocarcinoma and giant (33 cm) benign ovarian teratoma. Surgical resection of the teratoma significantly improved quality of life and symptom control, demonstrating potential palliative benefit of removing symptomatic benign tumors in advanced cancer patients.

pmid-33977249.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマ術後7年目の外腸骨リンパ節転移症例。インドシアニングリーン蛍光ガイド下で転移リンパ節を同定。
pmid-33977249.summary_en: Case report of solitary external iliac lymph node recurrence seven years after orchiectomy for testicular seminoma (pT1). Uses indocyanine green fluorescence-guided laparoscopic dissection to visualize lymphatic drainage and identify metastatic site, confirming germ cell tumor metastasis.

pmid-33981691.summary_ja: 若年成人男性における精巣成熟奇形腫(非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍)からの脈絡膜転移の症例報告である。ブレオマイシン・エトポシド・シスプラチン(BEP)化学療法の後、患者は正常またはほぼ正常な視力を回復した。転移性成熟奇形腫としては稀な良好な転帰である。
pmid-33981691.summary_en: Case report of choroidal metastasis from testicular mature teratoma (non-seminomatous GCT) in a young adult male. Patient achieved normal or near-normal visual acuity following bleomycin, etoposide, and cisplatin (BEP) chemotherapy, representing rare successful outcome for metastatic mature teratoma.

pmid-33983633.summary_ja: 粘液性卵巣腫瘍のインプリンティング遺伝子のメチル化プロファイルを解析し、奇形腫由来であるかを検討した。粘液性腫瘍の一部は奇形腫由来のメチル化パターンを示し、成熟奇形腫に由来する可能性が示唆された。ゲノムインプリンティング解析は、新たな診断戦略となりうる。
pmid-33983633.summary_en: Analyzes methylation profiles of imprinted genes in mucinous ovarian tumors to determine teratomatous origin. Demonstrates that a subset of mucinous tumors carry teratoma-derived methylation patterns, suggesting they originated from mature teratomas. Genome imprinting analysis serves as novel diagnostic strategy.

pmid-33989803.summary_ja: Swyer症候群患者に認められた卵管内のジスジャーミノーマの稀な症例報告。両側性腺摘出と卵管切除による腫瘍予防の重要性を強調している。
pmid-33989803.summary_en: Case report of dysgerminoma discovered exclusively within the fallopian tube of a 16-year-old female with Swyer syndrome (46XY pure gonadal dysgenesis). Highlights the importance of prophylactic bilateral gonadectomy and salpingectomy for cancer prevention, since germ cell tumors may develop in atypical locations during gonadal dysgenesis.

pmid-33996469.summary_ja: 原始生殖細胞の発生中のエピジェネティック修飾がGCT形成へ至る過程を検討した包括的総説。SOX2とSOX17の発現パターンがBMPなどの微小環境因子と組み合わさって細胞運命を決定し、セミノーマや胎児性癌などの特定のGCTサブタイプの発生を規定すると提唱している。
pmid-33996469.summary_en: Comprehensive review of epigenetic and molecular pathogenesis of germ cell tumors (GCTs), examining how epigenetic modifications during primordial germ cell development lead to GCT formation. Proposes that SOX2 and SOX17 expression patterns, combined with microenvironmental factors such as BMPs, determine cell fate and development of specific GCT subtypes including seminomas and embryonal carcinomas.

pmid-33996471.summary_ja: 臨床病期I非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍に対する、積極的監視、後腹膜リンパ節郭清、補助化学療法の治療戦略を論じている。適切な管理により治癒率は99%を超える。治療の選択は、リンパ管・血管侵襲などの予後因子に基づく個別のリスク評価によって行われる。
pmid-33996471.summary_en: Discusses treatment strategies for clinical stage I non-seminomatous germ cell tumors (NSGCTs) including active surveillance, retroperitoneal lymph node dissection, and adjuvant chemotherapy. Cure rates exceed 99% with appropriate management. Treatment selection depends on individual risk assessment based on lymphovascular invasion and other prognostic factors.

pmid-33997822.summary_ja: 精巣GCT患者の化学療法後後腹膜リンパ節郭清時における純粋奇形腫検出にmiRNAを用いた研究。miR-375-3pとmiR-375-5pの感度・特異度は不十分。初期精巣奇形腫の存在のみが予測因子で、血清miRNAでは純粋奇形腫を予測できない可能性を示した。
pmid-33997822.summary_en: This study investigated serum microRNAs including miR-375 for detecting pure teratoma at post-chemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph node dissection in TGCT patients. Among 40 patients, both miR-375-3p and miR-375-5p exhibited poor performance with limited sensitivity and specificity. Teratoma at orchiectomy was the only predictor of PC-RPLND teratoma.

pmid-34002664.summary_ja: TCGAデータベースの156例のTGCTデータを用いて、精巣胚細胞腫瘍の予後因子としてのTLR2発現を解析した。TLR2発現は生存と正の相関を示した。TLR2高発現では細胞接着分子およびケモカインシグナル伝達経路が濃縮された。TLR2発現は予後予測や腫瘍微小環境の免疫能に影響しうる。
pmid-34002664.summary_en: This study analyzed TLR2 expression as a prognostic factor in testicular germ cell tumors using TCGA data from 156 TGCT cases. TLR2 expression was positively correlated with TGCT survival. High TLR2 expression enriched for cell adhesion molecule and chemokine signaling pathways. TLR2 expression may predict TGCT prognosis and influence tumor microenvironment immune competence.

pmid-34007775.summary_ja: 原発性縦隔セミノーマにより肺動脈が圧迫され、慢性的な肝静脈の逆流と肝うっ血を来した症例報告である。患者には、意義が不明な稀な所見である精巣微小石灰化も認められた。縦隔セミノーマは、十分に増大すると重度の呼吸器症状や心血管症状を呈しうる。
pmid-34007775.summary_en: This case report presents a large primary mediastinal seminoma that caused pulmonary artery compression, resulting in chronic hepatic venous backflow and hepatic congestion. The patient also had testicular microlithiasis, a rare finding with unknown clinical significance. Mediastinal seminomas are rare neoplasms that may present with severe respiratory or cardiovascular symptoms if sufficiently enlarged.

pmid-34010145.summary_ja: 文献からの36例とSEERの追加8例、計44例の悪性甲状腺奇形腫を統合解析した。成人女性に多く、甲状腺外進展(80%)、リンパ節浸潤(62%)など侵襲的な経過を示した。再発(42%)および転移(46%)が一般的であり、腫瘍径が大きいことと転移の存在が高い死亡率と関連していた。
pmid-34010145.summary_en: This integrated analysis examined 36 cases of malignant thyroid teratoma (MTT) from literature plus 8 additional SEER cases. MTT typically presents in adult females with aggressive clinical behavior including high rates of extrathyroidal extension (80%) and nodal involvement (62%). Recurrence and metastases were common (42% and 46% respectively). Large tumor size and metastases predicted higher mortality.

pmid-34011267.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞癌細胞（NT2/D1）におけるLRWD1遺伝子の発現制御をDNAメチル化の観点から検討。LRWD1プロモーター領域のCpG島の高メチル化は転写低下と関連。メチル化阻害剤による脱メチル化でLRWD1発現が上昇。メチル化状態は男性不妊の分子マーカーの可能性。
pmid-34011267.summary_en: This study examined LRWD1 gene expression regulation via DNA methylation in human testicular embryonal carcinoma cells (NT2/D1). A CpG island in the LRWD1 promoter showed hypermethylation linked to reduced transcription. Using methylation modulators demonstrated that demethylation via 5-Aza-dc increased LRWD1 expression. LRWD1 methylation status may serve as a diagnostic marker for male infertility.

pmid-34011651.summary_ja: 進行性腹部膨満を呈した9ヶ月女児。左後腹膜巨大囊胞性腫瘤を認め、右腎欠損とhydrometrocolposを伴いOHVIRA症候群を示唆。腫瘍ドレナージと完全切除施行。組織診は成熟奇形腫で未分化神経組織を少量含む。
pmid-34011651.summary_en: A 9-month-old girl presented with progressive abdominal distension. Imaging revealed a huge left retroperitoneal cystic mass with solid components. The right kidney was absent with hydrometrocolpos present, suggestive of OHVIRA syndrome. Tumor drainage and complete surgical excision were performed. Pathology showed teratoma with focal immature neural tissue.

pmid-34012615.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍および前立腺がんの肺転移巣切除術に関するレビューである。胚細胞腫瘍に関するエビデンスは他の悪性腫瘍と比べて限られている。胚細胞腫瘍における外科手術は、主に化学療法後の残存病変に限定すべきである。外科的切除、アブレーション放射線療法、局所療法と全身療法の併用を取り上げている。
pmid-34012615.summary_en: This review examines pulmonary metastasectomy in germ cell and prostate tumors. While evidence for GCT is limited compared to other malignancies, surgery should be mainly reserved for residual disease after chemotherapy. The article covers surgical resection, ablative radiotherapy, and combination local-systemic therapy approaches for managing pulmonary metastases.

pmid-34013198.summary_ja: 本症例報告は、右精巣の純粋卵黄嚢腫瘍で肺転移を伴った37歳男性の症例を記述する。純粋卵黄嚢腫瘍は小児期では最も一般的な精巣腫瘍であるが、成人ではまれであり、通常は混合型胚細胞腫瘍の一成分として生じる。患者は高位鼠径精巣摘除術に続くBEP併用化学療法により良好に治療された。
pmid-34013198.summary_en: This case report describes a 37-year-old man with pure yolk sac tumor of the right testis with lung metastasis. Pure yolk sac tumors are the most common testicular tumor in childhood but are rare in adults, typically occurring as a component of mixed germ cell tumors. The patient was successfully treated with high inguinal orchidectomy followed by BEP combination chemotherapy.

pmid-34016454.summary_ja: 本症例対照研究は、胚細胞腫瘍（n=188）、性索間質腫瘍（n=116）、漿液性腫瘍（n=4854）を含む非上皮性卵巣癌と生殖因子との関連を検討した。出産経験は胚細胞腫瘍のオッズ上昇と関連し、不妊はオッズを低下させた。経口避妊薬の使用は3つの腫瘍型すべてのオッズを低下させた。
pmid-34016454.summary_en: This case-control study examined associations between reproductive factors and non-epithelial ovarian cancer including germ cell tumors (n=188), sex cord-stromal tumors (n=116), and serous tumors (n=4854). Parity was associated with increased odds for germ cell tumors, while infertility decreased odds. Oral contraceptive use decreased odds for all three tumor types.

pmid-34019886.summary_ja: hCG正常化した水胞状奇胎患者7761例での妊娠栄養膜腫瘍への悪性転化リスク研究。0.26%で悪性転化を認めた。部分奇胎0%、全奇胎0.36%、双胎奇胎2.1%の悪性転化率。年齢45歳以上とhCG正常化時間延長が高リスク因子。
pmid-34019886.summary_en: This retrospective cohort study of 7761 molar pregnancy patients with normalized hCG levels examined risk of malignant transformation to GTN. Among patients whose hCG normalized, 20 (0.26%) developed GTN. Risk varied by mole type: 0% for partial mole, 0.36% for complete mole, and 2.1% for twin molar pregnancy. Age ≥45 years and prolonged hCG normalization were risk factors.

pmid-34020555.summary_ja: スロバキアの妊娠栄養膜疾患専門センターで1993～2017年に治療された100例の妊娠栄養膜腫瘍。低リスク74%、高リスク26%。全体治癒率96%、死亡率4%。ステージI-IIIで100%治癒、ステージIVで60%治癒。妊娠栄養膜腫瘍の種類により発症率は大きく異なる。
pmid-34020555.summary_en: This retrospective study reviewed 100 gestational trophoblastic neoplasia patients treated at a specialized Slovak center from 1993-2017. According to FIGO/WHO classification, 74% were low-risk and 26% high-risk. Overall curability was 96% with 4% mortality. Stages I-III achieved 100% curability, stage IV 60%. Incidence varied by GTN type, ranging from 1 in 28,487 to 1 in 489,348 pregnancies.

pmid-34021196.summary_ja: 転移性精巣GCT患者23例に対するロボット支援後腹膜リンパ節郭清の検討。一次郭清の手術時間は中央値243分、化学療法後郭清は359分。術中合併症は化学療法後例のみに発生（44%）。術後16.3ヶ月の追跡で再発と死亡は認めなかった。
pmid-34021196.summary_en: This retrospective study evaluated robotic retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (R-RPLND) for metastatic testicular germ cell tumors in 23 patients. Median operative times were 243 minutes for primary R-RPLND versus 359 minutes for post-chemotherapy R-RPLND. Post-chemotherapy cases had higher intraoperative complications (44%). After median 16.3-month follow-up, no recurrences or deaths occurred.

pmid-34022590.summary_ja: 女性および思春期女児における70例の性腺外奇形腫を解析したシステマティックレビュー。大網奇形腫が最も多く(56.5%)、続いてダグラス窩病変(23.2%)であった。大網病変の病因として自然切断が最も多かった(55.3%)。治療は主に外科的で、5 cm程度までの病変では腹腔鏡手術が妥当とされる。
pmid-34022590.summary_en: This systematic review examines extragonadal teratomas (EGTs) in women and adolescent girls, analyzing 70 cases from 1920-2020. Omental teratomas were most common (56.5%), followed by Pouch of Douglas lesions (23.2%). Auto-amputation was the commonest etiology for omental EGTs (55.3%). Surgical treatment remains the primary approach with laparoscopy suitable for lesions ≤5 cm.

pmid-34026175.summary_ja: 本症例報告は、未熟奇形腫を伴う思春期女性において、プロテウス症候群と卵巣胚細胞腫瘍との間に認められた初めての関連を記述する。プロテウス症候群は、多様な過成長と腫瘍感受性の亢進を特徴とする複雑な疾患であり、この関連は、この希少な遺伝性疾患を持つ患者にとって臨床的に重要である。
pmid-34026175.summary_en: This case report describes the first known association between Proteus syndrome and ovarian germ cell tumor in an adolescent female with immature teratoma. Proteus syndrome is a complex disorder characterized by variable overgrowth and increased tumor susceptibility, making this association clinically significant for patients with this rare genetic condition.

pmid-34026657.summary_ja: イタリアの医学センターにおける妊娠栄養膜疾患54例の後方視的コホート研究。水胞状奇胎85%、持続性栄養膜腫瘍15%。発症率は出産1000例当たり1.8例。患者生存率は100%で、hCGレベルと超音波所見が予後因子として重要である。
pmid-34026657.summary_en: This retrospective cohort study assessed gestational trophoblastic disease incidence and treatment outcomes in an Italian university hospital over 20 years. Among 54 GTD cases, 46 (85%) were hydatidiform moles and 8 (15%) were persistent GTN. The incidence was 1.8 per 1000 deliveries with 100% patient survival. Prognostic factors included hCG levels and ultrasound findings.

pmid-34027878.summary_ja: 新生児期より眼窩奇形腫を呈した6ヶ月女児の症例。3胚葉由来の成熟奇形腫は良性腫瘍だが、視神経圧迫による視力障害の危険性がある。完全な外科的切除により良好な整容結果を得た。視力は救済不可能だったが、術後経過は良好である。
pmid-34027878.summary_en: A 6-month-old female infant presented with mature orbital teratoma since birth with progressive unilateral proptosis. Composed of tissues from all three germ layers, mature teratomas are benign. Complete surgical excision was performed as primary treatment. While vision could not be salvaged due to optic nerve compromise, excellent cosmetic results were achieved.

pmid-34028621.summary_ja: 縦隔セミノーマに伴う多房性胸腺嚢胞の症例。診断課題を強調し、胸腺絨毛細胞とミオイド細胞増殖の新知見を含む組織学的特徴を記載。
pmid-34028621.summary_en: Multilocular thymic cyst associated with mediastinal seminoma. Case demonstrates diagnostic challenges and novel findings regarding thymic tuft cells and myoid cell proliferation in thymic cyst pathogenesis.

pmid-34029275.summary_ja: 縦隔胚細胞腫瘍(体外胚細胞腫瘍)の包括的総説。病理分類、臨床的特徴、分子所見(i(12p)など)、化学療法と手術治療の方針をカバー。
pmid-34029275.summary_en: Comprehensive review of mediastinal germ cell tumors (extragonadal). Covers pathologic classification, clinical features, molecular findings including chromosome 12p gains and i(12p), treatment with neoadjuvant chemotherapy and surgical resection.

pmid-34031349.summary_ja: 13歳の女性で、11cmの未熟なGrade 3卵巣奇形腫と抗NMDAR脳炎を認めた。卵巣摘出に加え、ステロイドおよび免疫グロブリン療法を行った結果、神経学的後遺症なく完全に回復した。
pmid-34031349.summary_en: 13-year-old female with immature grade-3 ovarian teratoma (11 cm) and anti-NMDAR encephalitis. Ovariectomy combined with steroid and immunoglobulin therapy resulted in complete neurologic recovery without sequelae.

pmid-34031745.summary_ja: 卵巣卵黄嚢腫瘍患者由来異種移植(PDX)モデルの確立と特性評価。PDXは原腫瘍の組織・免疫組織化学的特徴を保持し、臨床患者と同様のJEB化学療法反応性を示した。
pmid-34031745.summary_en: Ovarian yolk sac tumor patient-derived xenograft (PDX) model established and characterized. PDX preserves histologic and immunohistochemical features of primary tumor; responsive to JEB chemotherapy as in clinical patients.

pmid-34031784.summary_ja: 再発/難治性胚細胞腫瘍に対するブレンツキシマブベドチンの第2相臨床試験。18例中完全/部分奏効なし、安定化6例。マーカーの一過性低下を認めた例あり。
pmid-34031784.summary_en: Phase 2 trial of brentuximab vedotin in relapsed/refractory GCTs. No complete or partial responses observed; 6/18 patients achieved stable disease. Modest activity in transient marker decline.

pmid-34032766.summary_ja: 妊娠34週の絨毛癌で肺静脈血栓症、肺脳転移を伴った稀な症例。緊急帝王切開後、多剤併用化学療法と抗凝固療法で完全寛解を達成。11ヶ月で無病生存。
pmid-34032766.summary_en: Gestational choriocarcinoma in third trimester with pulmonary vein thrombosis, lung and brain metastases. Emergency cesarean section with multiagent chemotherapy and anticoagulation achieved complete remission.

pmid-34034636.summary_ja: 絨毛癌(胎盤トロホブラスト疾患)研究で、インスリンとの5-FU併用が化学耐性を克服。サルビビン燐酸化とP-GP、MRP1を阻害するメカニズムを解明。
pmid-34034636.summary_en: Gestational choriocarcinoma study: insulin combined with 5-FU reverses chemoresistance in vitro and in vivo. Mechanism involves inhibition of survivin phosphorylation and drug resistance proteins P-GP and MRP1.

pmid-34035080.summary_ja: 病期I の卵巣胚細胞腫瘍（ディスジャーミノーマ、未熟奇形腫、混合型、卵黄嚢腫瘍）を経過観察単独で管理した。適切に病期分類された患者の68.9%が補助化学療法を回避し、良好な経過をたどった。
pmid-34035080.summary_en: Stage I ovarian germ cell tumors (dysgerminomas, immature teratomas, mixed tumors, yolk sac tumors) managed with surveillance alone. 68.9% of properly staged patients avoided adjuvant chemotherapy with favorable outcomes.

pmid-34036140.summary_ja: テストステロン産生性ライディッヒ細胞過形成伴う成熟嚢胞性奇形腫で閉経後女性に男性化を生じた症例。脂肪分化の病理学的特徴と内分泌学的合併症を記載。
pmid-34036140.summary_en: Mature cystic teratoma with androgen-producing Leydig cell hyperplasia causing virilization in postmenopausal woman. Discusses differential diagnosis of adipocytic differentiation and hormonal complications of teratoma.

pmid-34039259.summary_ja: 睾丸胚細胞腫瘍による肺塞栓が重篤な左心室機能不全をきたした稀な症例。最適医療により3ヶ月での完全回復を達成。若年健康人での肺塞栓では原因追究の必要性を強調。
pmid-34039259.summary_en: Testicular germ cell tumor complicated by pulmonary embolism causing severe isolated left ventricular dysfunction. Young healthy patient achieved full recovery with optimal medical therapy despite unusual presentation.

pmid-34040900.summary_ja: 睾丸絨毛癌が消化管出血で発症した稀な症例。絨毛癌症候群の定義(びまん性腫瘍負荷と転移巣からの出血)を示し、若年男性での鑑別診断の重要性を強調。
pmid-34040900.summary_en: Testicular choriocarcinoma presenting with choriocarcinoma syndrome and fatal gastrointestinal hemorrhage. Emphasizes need for differential diagnosis in young males with refractory anemia and testicular mass.

pmid-34045903.summary_ja: 成熟嚢胞性奇形腫が産後早期に卵巣捻転を引き起こした症例。経腟分娩後5日目に右下腹部急性腹痛で発症。超音波およびCT検査で脂肪と石灰化を含む右付属器腫瘤を認め正確に診断。手術により合併症なく治癒。
pmid-34045903.summary_en: Mature cystic teratoma causing ovarian torsion in early postpartum period. Patient presented with acute right lower quadrant pain on postpartum day 5. Ultrasound and CT imaging confirmed diagnosis, enabling rapid surgical management with salpingo-oophorectomy.

pmid-34054461.summary_ja: 47歳男性の超大型(22×18cm)非セミノーム睾丸胚細胞腫瘍で高リスク所見(AFP >10,000 ng/mL、LDH >10倍上限)。ICU入院が必要な全身状態でも初期化学療法(BEP/EI)で完全病理学的奏効を達成。診断遅延のリスクを指摘し、若年男性での早期診断の重要性を強調。
pmid-34054461.summary_en: 47-year-old with giant nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumor (22×18 cm) and high-risk profile (AFP >10,000 ng/mL, LDH >10× ULN). Despite poor initial condition requiring ICU care, primary chemotherapy with BEP/EI achieved complete pathological response.

pmid-34055440.summary_ja: エストロゲン産生機能性基質を伴う卵巣ジスジェルミノーマによる思春期早発の稀な症例。7歳女児で血清エストラジオール著増、ゴナドトロピン低下。免疫組織化学で腫瘍内のテカ様紡錘形細胞にP450アロマターゼを検出。
pmid-34055440.summary_en: Rare case of ovarian dysgerminoma with estrogen-producing functioning stroma presenting with precocious puberty. 7-year-old girl with markedly elevated serum estradiol and suppressed gonadotropins. Immunohistochemistry revealed aromatase and steroidogenic enzymes in theca-like spindle cells within dysgerminoma.

pmid-34055789.summary_ja: TRIM71の哺乳類胚細胞発生における役割を検討した。Trim71ノックアウトマウスはSertoli cell-only表現型と不妊を示した。TRIM71のノックダウンは、セミノーマ由来のTCam-2細胞および非セミノーマ由来のNCCIT細胞の増殖を低下させた。不妊男性のコホートでTRIM71変異も同定された。
pmid-34055789.summary_en: Study of TRIM71 protein role in mammalian germ cell development. Trim71 knockout mice show Sertoli cell-only phenotype and infertility. TRIM71 knockdown reduces proliferation in TCam-2 seminoma cells and NCCIT non-seminoma cells. TRIM71 variants identified in infertile men cohort.

pmid-34068019.summary_ja: 小児および若年成人における精巣胚細胞腫瘍の分子生物学を包括的にレビューした。小児と成人のTGCTについて、遺伝学、細胞遺伝学、エピジェネティクスの特徴を比較した。化学療法抵抗性の違いについても論じ、小児のTGCTは異なる疾患を代表する可能性があることを示唆した。
pmid-34068019.summary_en: Comprehensive review of molecular biology of testicular germ cell tumors in children and young adults. Compares genetic, cytogenetic, and epigenetic features between pediatric and adult TGCTs. Discusses chemotherapy resistance and biological differences suggesting pediatric TGCTs may represent distinct disease.

pmid-34070473.summary_ja: XY-DSD患者における悪性性腺胚細胞腫瘍の症例集積と文献レビューである。性腺摘出術を受けた27名の所見を報告し、セミノーマやセルトリ細胞腺腫を含む。悪性転化を防ぐための予防的性腺摘出術の時期と必要性を論じている。
pmid-34070473.summary_en: Case series and literature review of malignant gonadal germ cell tumors in XY-DSD patients. Reports gonadectomy findings in 27 patients, including seminomas and Sertoli cell adenomas. Discusses timing and necessity of prophylactic gonadectomy to prevent malignant transformation.

pmid-34071828.summary_ja: まれな未分化胚細胞腫の転移を示した症例報告と文献レビューである。転移の低い傾向で知られる卵巣未分化胚細胞腫からの腟転移について、初めての報告例を記載している。患者は治療に良好に反応し、臨床的寛解を維持しており、フォローアップ計画が進行中である。
pmid-34071828.summary_en: Case report and literature review of unusual dysgerminoma metastasis. Documents first reported case of vaginal metastasis from ovarian dysgerminoma, which is known for low metastatic propensity. Patient responded well to therapy and remains in clinical remission with follow-up plan.

pmid-34074603.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患(胞状奇胎、侵奇胎、絨毛癌など)のモニタリングに用いられるヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)測定法についての総説。英国のフォローアップ体制、ラジオイムノアッセイ法、hCGの構造と機能、現行測定法の限界と利点を扱う。また、英国の標準法の抗体を置き換える予備的検討についても述べている。
pmid-34074603.summary_en: Review of human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG) assays for monitoring gestational trophoblastic disease, including hydatidiform mole, invasive mole, and choriocarcinoma. Discusses UK follow-up protocols, radioimmunoassay methodology, hCG structure/function, and limitations of current assays used in GTD monitoring.

pmid-34075764.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の診断における血清学的および免疫組織化学的腫瘍マーカーを総説した。αフェトプロテイン、ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン、乳酸脱水素酵素を標準的な血清マーカーとして扱った。免疫組織化学マーカーの役割と、病理学的・臨床的診断の向上への寄与も取り上げている。
pmid-34075764.summary_en: Comprehensive review of serological and immunohistochemical tumor markers for testicular germ cell tumor diagnosis. Discusses alpha-fetoprotein, human chorionic gonadotropin, and lactate dehydrogenase as standard serologic markers. Covers immunohistochemical markers and their role in improving pathologic and clinical diagnosis.

pmid-34081032.summary_ja: 脳転移を有する胚細胞腫瘍患者35例を対象とした後方視的研究で、自己末梢血造血幹細胞支持を伴う大量化学療法の結果を報告した。2年全生存率は36.9%、全生存期間の中央値は12か月だった。異時性の脳転移例で良好な反応が多くみられた。
pmid-34081032.summary_en: Retrospective study of 35 germ cell tumor patients with brain metastases treated with high-dose chemotherapy and autologous stem cell support. 2-year overall survival 36.9%; median OS 12 months. Metachronous brain metastases showed better outcomes. Eight of eleven patients with favorable responses had isolated metachronous lesions.

pmid-34083896.summary_ja: 小児の精巣傍腫瘍に関する症例報告。嚢胞性奇形腫、線維性過誤腫、細胞性血管線維腫などの稀な病理組織型を提示。横紋筋肉腫などの悪性腫瘍との鑑別が重要。
pmid-34083896.summary_en: Case report of rare paratesticular masses in children, including discussion of fibrous hamartoma of infancy and cellular angiofibroma. Notes that pediatric paratesticular masses can include teratoma, encysted hydrocele, epididymal cyst, and malignant lesions such as rhabdomyosarcoma requiring exclusion.

pmid-34083993.summary_ja: 良性卵巣嚢胞72例の腹腔鏡下嚢胞切除術が卵巣予備能に及ぼす影響。嚢胞性奇形腫は術後90日で最も高いAMH回復率（83%）を示した。内膜症性嚢胞や粘液性嚢腺腫よりも回復が良好。
pmid-34083993.summary_en: Prospective study of 72 benign ovarian cyst patients undergoing laparoscopic cystectomy to assess impact on anti-Mullerian hormone (AMH) levels. Cystic teratoma showed greatest AMH recovery at 3 months postoperatively (83% of baseline), compared to endometriotic and mucinous cysts. Significant initial AMH reduction occurred in first week postoperatively.

pmid-34084505.summary_ja: 20歳男性の精巣セミノーマ症例。9ヶ月間の左下腹部腫瘤を主訴に泌尿器科受診。セミノーマの典型的な組織学的パターンと免疫組織化学的特性の診断的課題について報告。
pmid-34084505.summary_en: Case report of seminoma in 20-year-old man presenting with left-sided lower abdominal mass. Discusses typical histological patterns and immunoreactivity of seminoma as diagnostic challenges in urological practice.

pmid-34085325.summary_ja: 進行精巣腫瘍の化学療法後後腹膜リンパ節郭清66例の予後分析。残存奇形腫例は壊死のみの例に比べ5年全生存率が有意に低下（74.1% vs 100%）。残存奇形腫の完全切除例では壊死のみ例と同等の成績。
pmid-34085325.summary_en: Retrospective analysis of 66 advanced germ cell tumor patients undergoing post-chemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph node dissection. Examined histologic findings and outcomes, with residual teratoma present in 36.4% of specimens. Residual teratoma associated with significantly worse 5-year overall survival (74.1% vs 100%) compared to necrosis-only cases.

pmid-34086989.summary_ja: 絨毛癌におけるlncRNA MEG3の腫瘍抑制機能に関する論文の撤回。実験方法と結果の不一致、複数の欠陥が指摘され、論文の結論が無効とみなされた。
pmid-34086989.summary_en: Retraction notice for previously published article on long noncoding RNA MEG3 as tumor suppressor in choriocarcinoma. Retraction due to methodological flaws and inconsistencies between results and experimental methods, with editorial finding of invalid conclusions.

pmid-34088998.summary_ja: 絨毛性疾患の診断における遺伝型判定の精密医療での応用。水疱状奇胎の確認・分類、良性奇胎と悪性腫瘍の区別、絨毛癌の診断に有用。父親由来ゲノムの偏倚がこれらの病変の分子基盤となり、FIGO/WHO予後スコア体系での活用も重要。
pmid-34088998.summary_en: Comprehensive review of DNA genotyping applications in diagnosis and classification of gestational trophoblastic disease. Discusses genotyping as gold standard for hydatidiform mole confirmation, partial/complete mole differentiation, and gestational choriocarcinoma diagnosis. Addresses distinction of gestational from non-gestational neoplasia and FIGO/WHO prognostic scoring.

pmid-34091978.summary_ja: 胸部不快感の評価中に偶発的に発見された、成人の心臓内成熟嚢胞性奇形腫のまれな症例。右心室内の小さな腫瘤で、心室中隔近傍に位置した。外科的切除により良好な経過をたどり、6か月の経過観察で再発はみられなかった。
pmid-34091978.summary_en: Rare adult case of intracardiac mature cystic teratoma discovered incidentally during evaluation for chest pain. Small mass located in right ventricle near interventricular septum. Surgical excision performed with successful outcome and no recurrence during 6-month follow-up.

pmid-34093900.summary_ja: 中国南部の卵巣奇形腫に伴う抗NMDAR脳炎患者21例を検討した。平均年齢は24.3歳で、発症は秋冬に多かった。手術を受けた20例中17例が成熟奇形腫で、85%に臨床的改善がみられた。奇形腫内のNMDAR陽性組織も確認された。
pmid-34093900.summary_en: Study of 21 patients with anti-NMDAR encephalitis associated with ovarian teratoma in South China. Mean age 24.3 years with peak disease onset in autumn/winter. Psychiatric abnormalities, seizures, movement dysfunction, and consciousness disorders common; most patients developed four symptom categories within first four weeks. Twenty underwent surgery (17 mature, 3 immature teratomas); 85% showed clinical improvement. NMDAR-positive tissues identified in teratomas.

pmid-34094541.summary_ja: 化学療法抵抗性妊娠性絨毛癌患者のNGS解析。腫瘍ゲノムに相手方ゲノムが含まれることで高頻度SNVを認めた。妊娠性絨毛性疾患における独特のゲノム複雑性を示唆。マッチドペア解析が治療判定に不適切である可能性。
pmid-34094541.summary_en: Case report of 51-year-old woman with chemotherapy-resistant gestational choriocarcinoma who underwent NGS tumor panel analysis. Tumor genome identified 245 single nucleotide variants with high allele frequency due to contribution from partner's genome. Highlights unique genomic complexity in gestational trophoblastic neoplasia and demonstrates that matched normal-tumor pair analysis may be inappropriate for GTN treatment planning.

pmid-34102789.summary_ja: 精巣精原細胞腫瘍の症例。25歳男性。精巣腫大と精索静脈瘤で発症。9.8×9 cmの腫瘤を認めた。精巣摘除術を施行。病理検査で3種類の特徴的細胞を認め診断確定。精子細胞腫瘍は精巣摘除術で治癒。
pmid-34102789.summary_en: Case report of spermatocytic tumor in 25-year-old male presenting with right testicular swelling and ipsilateral varicocele. Radiology revealed 9.8×9 cm testicular mass. Right orchiectomy performed; histopathology showed characteristic morphology with three distinctive cell types, confirming spermatocytic tumor diagnosis. This rare germ cell tumor derived from postpubertal-type germ cells is typically cured by orchidectomy alone.

pmid-34105734.summary_ja: TCGAデータベースの132例のセミノーマ検体のRNA-seqデータと156のメチル化部位を解析した研究。KCNC1遺伝子の高メチル化は発現を抑制し、病期II/IIIのセミノーマ患者の全生存期間不良と関連していた。セミノーマ細胞株では正常精巣と比べKCNC1発現が低下しており、診断指標や治療標的となりうると提案されている。
pmid-34105734.summary_en: Analysis of RNA-seq and methylation data from 132 seminoma specimens and 156 methylation sites from TCGA database. KCNC1 gene hypermethylation inhibited expression and was associated with poor overall survival in stage II/III seminoma patients. KCNC1 expression reduced in seminoma cell lines compared to normal testis. Proposed KCNC1 as potential diagnostic indicator and therapeutic target for seminoma progression.

pmid-34107893.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者177例を対象に、除睾術前後の血清25-ヒドロキシビタミンD(25OHD)値を縦断的に調べた研究。術後6～12か月で一過性の有意な低下がみられた後に回復し、永続的な低下は認められなかった。テストステロン、FSH、腫瘍の組織型との関連は認められなかった。
pmid-34107893.summary_en: Longitudinal study of 177 testicular germ cell tumor patients examining serum 25-hydroxy vitamin D (25OHD) levels before and after orchiectomy. Found significant transient decrease in 25OHD levels with nadir at 6–12 months post-orchiectomy, followed by recovery. No permanent reduction observed. Results suggest important role of testis in vitamin D metabolism; no association with testosterone, FSH levels, or tumor histology.

pmid-34109709.summary_ja: 不成熟奇形腫成分を伴う卵巣透明細胞癌の症例。47歳女性。透明細胞癌と奇形腫成分は同一のARID1A欠損とPIK3CA変異を示し、クローン関連を示唆。化学療法にもかかわらず6ヶ月で再発、肝転移を来た。
pmid-34109709.summary_en: Case report of 47-year-old woman with ovarian clear cell carcinoma containing immature teratoma component showing aggressive biological behavior. Tumor composed of clear cell carcinoma nodules and teratomatous tissues including immature skeletal muscle, adipose tissue, and enteric glands. Both components showed ARID1A deficiency and identical PIK3CA mutation, suggesting clonal origin. Despite adjuvant chemotherapy, patient developed recurrence and liver metastasis within 9 months.
