Patient achieved good prognosis with neurological improvement after 23 months.

pmid-33100757.summary_ja: 22歳男性の膀胱成熟奇形腫症例、男性での初報告。髪尿症（尿中の毛髪排出）で提示。膀胱は奇形腫の稀な頻外性部位。病理組織学で脂腺や毛髪を含む分化組織を有する成熟奇形腫を確認。
pmid-33100757.summary_en: Case of mature teratoma of urinary bladder in 22-year-old male, first reported in male patient. Presented with pilimiction (passage of hair in urine). Bladder is rare extragonadal site for teratoma. Histopathology confirmed mature teratoma with differentiated tissues including sebaceous glands and hair.

pmid-33101916.summary_ja: グレード3の卵巣未熟奇形腫の治療から19年後に発症した遅発性のgrowing teratoma syndromeの稀な症例。再発腫瘤は成熟嚢胞性奇形腫であった。卵巣GTSの文献をレビューし、進行期、高悪性度、早期再発をGTS発症の危険因子として挙げている。
pmid-33101916.summary_en: Rare case of late-onset growing teratoma syndrome (GTS) 19 years after treatment of grade 3 ovarian immature teratoma. Recurrent mass revealed mature cystic teratoma. Reviews ovarian GTS literature noting advanced stage, high grade, or early recurrence as risk factors for GTS development.

pmid-33102043.summary_ja: 両側精巣停留を伴う持続性Müller管症候群における腹腔内セミノーマの稀症例。セミノーマは第3～4十年で最も一般的な精巣腫瘍。PMDS における異常な解剖学的提示を強調。
pmid-33102043.summary_en: Rare case of intra-abdominal seminoma in patient with persistent Müllerian duct syndrome with bilateral undescended testes. Seminoma is most common testicular tumor in third-fourth decade. Case highlights unusual anatomical presentation of germ cell tumor in PMDS.

pmid-33102083.summary_ja: 40歳男性の精巣奇形腫に生じた稀な横紋筋肉腫症例。体細胞型悪性成分を伴う奇形腫は成人では稀。成人患者における横紋筋肉腫分化を伴うGCTの稀な提示。
pmid-33102083.summary_en: Rare case of rhabdomyosarcoma arising in testicular teratoma in 40-year-old male. Somatic-type malignancy components in teratomas are uncommon in adults. Case highlights unusual presentation of germ cell tumor with rhabdomyosarcoma differentiation in adult patient.

pmid-33102126.summary_ja: 出産3年後に両側腎臓および肺転移で提示した妊娠絨毛癌の稀症例。化学療法および生命を脅かす血尿に対する腎動脈塞栓術で治療。妊娠絨毛癌の遅延提示と稀な転移パターンを強調。
pmid-33102126.summary_en: Rare case of gestational choriocarcinoma presenting 3 years post-term delivery with bilateral kidney and lung metastases. Management included chemotherapy and renal embolization for life-threatening hematuria. Emphasizes delayed presentation and uncommon metastatic pattern in gestational choriocarcinoma.

pmid-33104706.summary_ja: セミノーマの3つの予後バイオマーカー（TYROBP、CD68、ITGAM）をネットワーク分析で同定。免疫細胞浸潤制御を通じてセミノーマ生存に影響。治療標的として機能する可能性。
pmid-33104706.summary_en: Study identifying three prognostic biomarkers (TYROBP, CD68, ITGAM) in seminoma using weighted gene co-expression network analysis. Results suggest these genes influence seminoma patient survival through regulating immune cell infiltration. Biomarkers could serve as prognostic indicators and therapeutic targets.

pmid-33106451.summary_ja: 小児良性卵巣腫瘍89例の英国・エジプト施設比較研究。成熟奇形腫/皮様嚢胞が最頻出（英国75.9%、エジプト82.8%）。画像診断と手術アプローチに変動。腹腔鏡手術は卵巣温存と相関。
pmid-33106451.summary_en: Retrospective comparative study of 89 pediatric patients with benign ovarian tumors across English and Egyptian centers. Mature teratomas/dermoid cysts were most common (75.9% England, 82.8% Egypt). Variations in diagnostic imaging and surgical approaches noted. Minimally invasive surgery correlated with ovarian preservation.

pmid-33112774.summary_ja: セロトニン受容体拮抗薬メチオテピンが人間絨毛膜絨毛癌細胞に及ぼす影響を研究。ミトコンドリア機能を低下、小胞体ストレスを誘導。パクリタキセルとの相乗効果。新規抗癌剤として絨毛癌治療への応用可能性を示唆。
pmid-33112774.summary_en: Study of methiothepin, serotonin receptor antagonist, on human placental choriocarcinoma cells. Methiothepin attenuated mitochondrial function, induced endoplasmic reticulum stress, and reduced oxidative phosphorylation. Showed synergistic effects with paclitaxel. Supports repositioning methiothepin as novel anti-cancer agent for choriocarcinoma.

pmid-33113876.summary_ja: 生殖細胞系列のSDHB変異を有する19歳の患者が、縦隔胚細胞腫瘍(嚢胞性奇形腫95%、セミノーマ5%)とβ-hCGの上昇を呈した症例。画像検査で縦隔病変が確認された。外科的切除により診断が確定し、SDHB変異との関連は非褐色細胞性腫瘍における遺伝的素因を示唆する。
pmid-33113876.summary_en: Case of 19-year-old with germline SDHB mutation presenting with mediastinal germ cell tumor (cystic teratoma 95%, seminoma 5%) and elevated β-hCG. Imaging showed mediastinal lesion. Surgical resection confirmed diagnosis. SDHB mutation association suggests genetic predisposition to mediastinal GCT.

pmid-33130749.summary_ja: 縦隔の転移性非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍でAFPが上昇した22歳男性の症例。生検で成熟奇形腫が認められた。化学療法でAFPは低下したが腫瘍は増大し、びまん性石灰化を伴った。原発性縦隔非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍におけるgrowing teratoma syndromeは極めてまれである。
pmid-33130749.summary_en: Case of 22-year-old with metastatic nonseminomatous mediastinal germ cell tumor with elevated AFP. Biopsy showed mature teratoma. Despite chemotherapy reducing AFP, tumor enlarged with diffuse calcification. Growing teratoma syndrome in primary mediastinal nonseminomatous GCT is extremely rare.

pmid-33132245.summary_ja: アクリロニトリル(AN)が絨毛癌細胞JEG-3およびBeWoに及ぼす影響を検討。AN用量依存的に細胞増殖を低下させ、サイクリン発現変化で細胞周期を停止。ROS媒介小胞体ストレス経由アポトーシスを促進。絨毛癌に対する抗癌可能性を示唆。
pmid-33132245.summary_en: Study examining acrylonitrile effects on human choriocarcinoma cell lines JEG-3 and BeWo. Acrylonitrile decreased cell proliferation dose-dependently, induced cell cycle arrest via altered cyclin expression, and promoted ROS-mediated apoptosis through ER-stress pathway. Suggests potential anti-cancer activity against choriocarcinoma.

pmid-33136554.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍22,165例の研究。全生存期間と癌特異生存期間の予後ノモグラムを開発。年齢、人種、AJCC病期が独立予後因子。ノモグラムはTNMより優れた予測精度を示した。
pmid-33136554.summary_en: Study of 22,165 testicular germ cell tumor (GCTC) patients from SEER database. Developed prognostic nomograms for overall and cancer-specific survival. Identified age, race, AJCC stage, SEER stage, and surgery/radiotherapy as independent prognostic factors. Nomograms showed better predictive value than TNM staging.

pmid-33142194.summary_ja: 初期成熟奇形腫後の悪性再発に関する1,516患者のメタ分析。悪性再発率5%で卵黄嚢腫瘍が主流。再発は診断後1～20年間に発生。残存悪性成分または成熟細胞の進行が再発パターンに関与する可能性。
pmid-33142194.summary_en: Meta-analysis of 1,516 sacrococcygeal teratoma (SCT) patients examining malignant recurrence after initially mature tumors. Found 5% malignant recurrence rate, predominantly yolk sac tumors. Recurrences ranged 1-20 years post-diagnosis. Suggests residual malignant components or progression of mature cells may account for recurrence.

pmid-33143824.summary_ja: 術前の炎症マーカー(NLR、LMR、PLR)とTGCT患者の臨床像・予後との関係を検討した99例の研究。好中球リンパ球比(NLR)高値は進行期、転移、後腹膜リンパ節浸潤と相関した。NLR高値は生存率低下を予測した。
pmid-33143824.summary_en: Study of 99 TGCT patients examining preoperative inflammation markers (NLR, LMR, PLR) in relation to clinical presentation and prognosis. Higher neutrophil-to-lymphocyte ratio correlated with advanced stage, metastasis, and retroperitoneal lymph node involvement. Elevated NLR predicted worse survival.

pmid-33144587.summary_ja: 精巣がんの患者由来移植（PDX）モデル3株の確立（卵黄嚢腫瘍・奇形腫成分含む）。組織型保持、患者腫瘍との分子的一致性。シスプラチン感受性が対応。mTORC1/2阻害薬が有効。
pmid-33144587.summary_en: Study establishing three patient-derived xenograft (PDX) models of testicular cancer including yolk sac tumor and teratoma components. Models retained histologic subtypes with molecular concordance to patient tumors. PDX cisplatin sensitivity matched patient responses; MDM2 and mTORC1/2 inhibitors showed efficacy.

pmid-33145142.summary_ja: 35歳女性の掌部再発性腫脹から診断された未分化奇形腫（grade 2）症例。組織学で確認、画像検査で潜在原発性腫瘍を除外。負の切除縁達成のため手術再検討推奨。
pmid-33145142.summary_en: Case report of immature teratoma grade 2 in palm of 35-year-old woman presenting with recurrent swelling. Histopathology confirmed diagnosis; imaging ruled out occult primary tumor. Surgical re-exploration recommended to achieve negative margins. Extragonadal teratomas in adults are rare.

pmid-33148936.summary_ja: 精巣がん563例の40年間の年齢・組織型トレンド研究（1980-2019年）。中央値28歳から38歳に上昇。40歳以上の比率が2000年以降有意に増加。セミノーマが50%以上を占めた。
pmid-33148936.summary_en: 40-year retrospective study of 563 testicular cancer patients examining age and histologic trends (1980-2019). Median age increased from 28 to 38 years; proportion over 40 years increased significantly since 2000. Seminoma represented over 50% since 2000, suggesting demographic shift toward older patients.

pmid-33150317.summary_ja: 原発性縦隔胚細胞腫瘍の化学療法後2年で急性骨髄性白血病が発症した11歳男児。発症後わずか1週間で死亡。PMGCT後の続発性血液悪性腫瘍の稀だが重要な関連性を強調。
pmid-33150317.summary_en: Case report of 11-year-old boy with primary mediastinal germ cell tumor (PMGCT) who developed acute myeloid leukemia two years after chemotherapy. Clinical course was aggressive with only 1-week survival after AML diagnosis. Highlights rare association between PMGCT and secondary hematologic malignancy.

pmid-33157971.summary_ja: 月経減少と腹部膨満で発症した21歳女性の卵巣ジスガーミノーマ症例。CA125上昇、18F-FDG PET/CT（SUVmax 15.8）で診断。手術と化学療法により3年以上の無再発生存を達成。
pmid-33157971.summary_en: Case report of 21-year-old woman with ovarian dysgerminoma presenting with reduced menstrual flow and abdominal distension. Elevated CA125 and 18F-FDG PET/CT (SUVmax 15.8) confirmed diagnosis. Patient underwent surgery and chemotherapy, achieving recurrence-free survival exceeding 3 years.

pmid-33158809.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者のDICER1遺伝子変異との関連性を検討。54名のDICER1保有者と41名対照で陰囊超音波検査実施。1,264例のTGCT患者でDICER1病的変異なし。
pmid-33158809.summary_en: Study examining association between pathogenic DICER1 variants and testicular germ cell tumors (TGCT). 54 DICER1-carriers and 41 controls underwent scrotal ultrasound; no difference in testicular cystic structures. Analysis of 1,264 TGCT-affected men found no pathogenic DICER1 variants.

pmid-33160385.summary_ja: NMDAR脳炎の有無による卵巣奇形腫のタンパク質発現差異を検討。HLA-AとHLA-DRB1が免疫経路に主に関与。NMDAR脳炎患者の奇形腫組織でHLA陽性細胞の集積が顕著。
pmid-33160385.summary_en: Study of differential protein expression in ovarian teratomas from patients with and without anti-NMDAR encephalitis. iTRAQ-LC-MS/MS identified 36 differentially expressed proteins, particularly HLA-A and HLA-DRB1. Immunohistochemistry confirmed aggregation of HLA+ cells in NMDAR-encephalitis patient teratomas.

pmid-33163850.summary_ja: 転移性胚細胞腫瘍50例の一次腫瘍と転移巣間の分子異質性を解析。68%の変異が不一致。ゲノム倍増は一致的だが、コピー数異常は25%のみ一致。TP53経路変異はシスプラチン耐性と相関。
pmid-33163850.summary_en: Whole-exome and targeted NGS of 50 metastatic GCT patients examining molecular heterogeneity between primary and metastatic sites. 68% of mutations were discordant between sites. Genome duplication was concordant; copy number alterations showed only 25% concordance. TP53 pathway alterations highly concordant and enriched in cisplatin-resistant disease.

pmid-33173481.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍患者のVIP化学療法（シスプラチン累積用量400mg/m²超過時）により発症したOgilvie症候群。末梢神経障害を伴わない自律神経障害による初報告例である。
pmid-33173481.summary_en: Case report of Ogilvie syndrome (intestinal pseudo-obstruction) in patient with metastatic nonseminomatous germ cell tumor treated with cisplatin-based chemotherapy (VIP). Syndrome developed when cumulative cisplatin dose exceeded 400 mg/m², presenting without peripheral sensory neuropathy—a unique presentation reportedly first in literature.

pmid-33175879.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍315例と対照群931名における下腹部放射線被曝と発症リスクの関連研究。3回以上のX線・CT検査または下部消化管造影で有意なリスク上昇（OR=1.78-4.58）。小児期被曝でリスク傾向認められた。
pmid-33175879.summary_en: Case-control study examining association between diagnostic radiation exposure below the waist and TGCT risk in 315 cases and 931 controls. Multiple exposures to x-ray/CT (≥3) or lower GI series showed significantly elevated risk (OR=1.78-4.58). Early childhood exposure (age 0-10) showed trend toward increased risk.

pmid-33189006.summary_ja: 潰瘍性大腸炎の既往がある34歳女性の原発性直腸絨毛癌と腺癌の併存に関する症例報告。βhCG高値、産後出血、直腸出血を呈した。全大腸切除術と化学療法を行ったが、患者は20か月後に死亡した。腺癌が絨毛癌へ脱分化した可能性が示唆された。
pmid-33189006.summary_en: Case report of primary rectal choriocarcinoma co-existing with adenocarcinoma in 34-year-old woman with ulcerative colitis history. Presented with elevated β-hCG, postpartum bleeding, and rectal bleeding. Despite proctocolectomy and chemotherapy, patient died at 20 months, suggesting adenocarcinoma dedifferentiation into choriocarcinoma in inflammatory bowel disease.

pmid-33190644.summary_ja: 結腸原発絨毛膜癌の稀な症例。初期FOLFOX治療で奏効せず、EMA/CO化学療法で急速奏効。適切な治療選択により18ヶ月の生存を達成。病理診断と治療選択の重要性を示す。
pmid-33190644.summary_en: Rare case of primary colorectal choriocarcinoma in 26-year-old woman initially treated with adenocarcinoma-directed chemotherapy (FOLFOX) but responding dramatically to choriocarcinoma-specific EMA/CO regimen. Achieved 18-month survival, highlighting importance of accurate pathological diagnosis and targeted treatment for these rare malignancies.

pmid-33194063.summary_ja: ヒト栄養膜および絨毛膜癌細胞におけるLAT1発現と機能の研究。LAT1はmTORC1シグナルを介して増殖促進、アポトーシス抑制、浸潤増強を行う。胎盤病態と腫瘍生物学の理解に有用である。
pmid-33194063.summary_en: Study of L-type amino acid transporter 1 (LAT1) expression in trophoblast and choriocarcinoma cell lines. LAT1 promotes proliferation, inhibits apoptosis, and enhances migration/invasion through mTORC1 signaling. Findings suggest LAT1 regulates trophoblast cell behaviors relevant to placental pathophysiology and cancer biology.

pmid-33194491.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマで後腹膜腫瘤を伴った31歳男性。精神疾患と物質乱用により化学療法への治療継続が困難となり、治癒可能な悪性腫瘍が進行した。精神医学的支援の重要性を示す症例。
pmid-33194491.summary_en: Case of 31-year-old male with testicular seminoma presenting with large retroperitoneal mass causing ureteral obstruction and hydronephrosis. Despite orchiectomy confirming seminoma, patient failed to comply with oncological treatment due to psychiatric illness and substance abuse, resulting in disease progression.

pmid-33195395.summary_ja: 両児が口咽頭奇形腫を有する双胎妊娠の稀な症例。Twin AはEXIT手術で気道確保、Twin Bは腫瘍減量術とトラケオストミーで対応。多職種による綿密な術前計画で良好な転帰を達成した。
pmid-33195395.summary_en: Rare case of monochorionic-diamniotic twin pregnancy with oropharyngeal teratomas requiring EXIT procedure. Twin A underwent EXIT with airway securement; Twin B received tumor debulking and tracheostomy. Multidisciplinary tabletop simulation facilitated pre-operative planning and successful outcomes in this complex prenatal scenario.

pmid-33195679.summary_ja: 妊娠絨毛膜癌で腰椎筋転移を呈した34歳女性の症例。子宮外妊娠と誤診されたが、β-hCG上昇と画像所見から診断確定。シスプラチン系化学療法により完全奏効、hCG正常化を達成した。
pmid-33195679.summary_en: Case report of 34-year-old woman with choriocarcinoma presenting with lumbar muscle metastasis, initially misdiagnosed as ectopic pregnancy. Elevated β-hCG levels and imaging studies confirmed diagnosis. Successfully treated with cisplatin-based chemotherapy, achieving complete remission and normalization of hCG levels.

pmid-33196463.summary_ja: 縦隔非セミノーマ(PMN)と血液系体細胞型悪性腫瘍(HSTM)のクローン関係に関する論評である。全エクソーム解析により、HSTMは共通の胎児性癌前駆細胞を共有する複数のクローンに由来することが明らかになった。縦隔の胚細胞腫瘍では精巣の胚細胞腫瘍に比べてTP53変異がより高頻度に認められた。
pmid-33196463.summary_en: Commentary on mediastinal nonseminomas (PMNs) and their clonal relationship to hematologic somatic-type malignancies (HSTMs). Whole-exome sequencing revealed HSTMs derive from multiple clones sharing a common embryonal carcinoma precursor, with TP53 mutations more prevalent in mediastinal than testicular GCTs.

pmid-33198808.summary_ja: クラインフェルター症候群患者が非セミノーマ性GCTから3種類の血液悪性腫瘍を続発。腫瘍細胞の多能性が強く示唆された。
pmid-33198808.summary_en: A 23-year-old man with Klinefelter's syndrome and mediastinal non-seminomatous germ cell tumor developed three sequential distinct hematological malignancies of different lineages following standard chemotherapy. Molecular evidence suggests leukemias derived from pluripotent clones within the original GCT.

pmid-33203785.summary_ja: 26歳男性が、燃え尽き型精巣胚細胞腫瘍(原発巣が目立たず自然退縮したもの)により、急性下大静脈症候群と右水腎症を引き起こす後腹膜腫瘤を呈した。精巣摘除術により診断が確定し、患者は化学療法によく反応して、残存する生存腫瘍は認められなかった。
pmid-33203785.summary_en: A 26-year-old man with burned-out testicular germ cell tumor (occult primary with spontaneous regression) presented with acute inferior vena cava syndrome and retroperitoneal mass causing right hydronephrosis. Orchiectomy confirmed the diagnosis, and the patient responded well to chemotherapy with no viable residual tumor.

pmid-33208175.summary_ja: 37例の中国人女性の妊娠性以外の絨毛癌患者を対象とした後方視的コホート研究である。手術と化学療法からなる集学的治療により、81.1%が完全奏効を示した。原発巣は卵巣が最も多く(92%)、転移部位としては肺が多かった(40.5%)。全生存率は3年で80%、5年で75.5%であった。
pmid-33208175.summary_en: Retrospective cohort study of 37 Chinese female patients with non-gestational choriocarcinoma showed 81.1% complete response to multimodal therapy (surgery and chemotherapy). Ovarian primary was most common (92%), with lung as frequent metastatic site (40.5%). Overall 3-year and 5-year survival rates were 80% and 75.5%.

pmid-33212946.summary_ja: NT2D1非セミノーマ精巣胚細胞腫瘍細胞はc-MET受容体を発現し、PI3K/AKT経路の活性化を介してHGFに応答し、増殖、遊走、浸潤が増加する。PI3Kの阻害はHGF依存的な細胞応答を遮断し、c-MET/HGF/PI3K-AKT軸が非セミノーマの進展における重要な経路であることを示している。
pmid-33212946.summary_en: NT2D1 non-seminomatous testicular germ cell tumor cells express c-MET receptor and respond to HGF with increased proliferation, migration, and invasion through PI3K/AKT pathway activation. PI3K inhibition blocks HGF-dependent cellular responses, highlighting the c-MET/HGF/PI3K-AKT axis as a key pathway in non-seminoma progression.

pmid-33217853.summary_ja: 膵頭部の腫瘤を成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と診断された23歳女性に対し、完全切除のためRoux-en-Y胆管空腸吻合術と胃空腸吻合術が施行された。脂肪抑制MRIが術前診断に有用であり、患者は無症状で、2年間の経過観察において再発は認められなかった。
pmid-33217853.summary_en: A 23-year-old woman with pancreatic head mass diagnosed as mature cystic teratoma underwent Roux-en-Y choledochojejunostomy with gastrojejunostomy for complete surgical excision. MRI with fat suppression proved useful for preoperative diagnosis, and the patient remained asymptomatic without recurrence at 2-year follow-up.

pmid-33217978.summary_ja: ヒストン脱アセチル化酵素阻害剤(HDACi)は、胚体組織を処理することで実験的マウス奇形腫の増殖を抑制した。トリコスタチンAとバルプロ酸は癌幹細胞様細胞と遺伝子発現に対して異なる影響を示し、HDACiが奇形腫の胚性起源の腫瘍形成能を低下させる可能性が示唆された。
pmid-33217978.summary_en: Histone deacetylase inhibitors (HDACi) reduced experimental mouse teratoma growth when applied to embryo-proper tissue sources. Trichostatin A and valproate showed different effects on cancer stem cell-like cells and gene expression, suggesting HDACi may diminish the tumorigenic potential of teratoma embryonal sources.

pmid-33219185.summary_ja: 卵巣奇形腫を伴う抗NMDAR(N-メチル-D-アスパラギン酸受容体)脳炎を発症した12歳女児が、精神症状と精神病様症状を呈した。免疫グロブリン治療と卵巣奇形腫の外科的切除の後、患者には著明な臨床的改善が認められた。
pmid-33219185.summary_en: A 12-year-old girl with anti-NMDAR (N-methyl-D-aspartate receptor) encephalitis associated with ovarian teratoma presented with psychiatric symptoms and psychosis. Following immunoglobulin treatment and surgical removal of the ovarian teratoma, the patient demonstrated remarkable clinical improvement.

pmid-33224314.summary_ja: 6つの有望なバイオマーカーと6つの既知のTGCTバイオマーカーについて、セミノーマ、非セミノーマ、精巣内胚細胞腫瘍を対象に、インシリコ解析と病理組織学的解析を包括的に行った。腫瘍型を区別するDNAメチル化と発現パターンが認められ、RASSF1、PRSS21、HOXA9を含むTGCT診断の改善に向けたバイオマーカーパネルが提案された。
pmid-33224314.summary_en: Comprehensive in silico and histopathological analysis of six prospective and six known TGCT biomarkers across seminomas, non-seminomas, and germ cell neoplasia in situ. Results showed distinct DNA methylation and expression patterns differentiating tumor types, with proposed biomarker panels for improved TGCT diagnostics including RASSF1, PRSS21, and HOXA9.

pmid-33233994.summary_ja: 卵巣ではなく膣壁に癒着した成熟嚢胞性奇形腫が、画像検査で同定され手術で確認された。本症例は、非典型的な部位に生じた奇形腫に対し、周囲組織の損傷を防ぎ適切な手術方針を決定するため、MRIやCTを用いた慎重な術前画像評価の重要性を示している。
pmid-33233994.summary_en: A mature cystic teratoma adherent to the vaginal wall rather than in the ovary was identified through imaging and confirmed at surgery. The case highlights the importance of careful preoperative imaging (MRI, CT) in teratomas with unusual locations to prevent damage to surrounding tissues and ensure appropriate surgical approach.

pmid-33234106.summary_ja: 25歳女性が、臀部腫脹、腹痛、排尿症状を伴う巨大仙尾部奇形腫を呈した。完全な外科的切除が施行され、病理組織学的検査で仙尾部奇形腫と確認された。6か月の経過観察で再発はみられなかった。成人では稀だが、骨盤内腫瘤の鑑別診断に含めるべきである。
pmid-33234106.summary_en: A 25-year-old female presented with a giant sacrococcygeal teratoma causing gluteal swelling, abdominal pain, and urinary symptoms. Complete surgical excision was performed, and histopathology confirmed sacrococcygeal teratoma with no recurrence at 6-month follow-up. Although rare in adults, this tumor should be included in the differential diagnosis of pelvic masses.

pmid-33244239.summary_ja: 絨毛癌では低発現のMST4がTGF-β1を介して上皮間葉転移と転移能を制御する。MST4喪失で浸潤・遊走能が増加し、過剰発現で減少した。
pmid-33244239.summary_en: MST4 expression is significantly reduced in choriocarcinoma metastatic lesions. Knockdown of MST4 promotes epithelial-mesenchymal transition (EMT) and increases invasion/migration through TGF-β1 upregulation, while MST4 overexpression suppresses EMT and metastatic ability. This identifies the MST4-TGF-β1 axis as a key mechanism in choriocarcinoma progression.

pmid-33246418.summary_ja: 卵巣胚芽腫の既往患者が全身肥満細胞症を続発。両腫瘍は同じKIT D816A変異を共有し、腫瘍進化または共通の幹細胞起源の可能性が示唆された。
pmid-33246418.summary_en: A female patient with previous ovarian dysgerminoma (treated 2 years prior) subsequently developed aggressive systemic mastocytosis (ASM). Molecular and cytogenomic analyses revealed both tumors carried the same KIT D816A mutation but differed in TP53 mutations. Results suggest either clonal evolution from dysgerminoma with acquired TP53 mutation or development from a common cancer stem cell precursor.

pmid-33246908.summary_ja: 腫瘍性脳動脈瘤の系統的レビューでは58%が絨毛癌に起因し、特に若い女性に見られた。絨毛癌関連脳動脈瘤は他の悪性腫瘍より高い生存率を示した。
pmid-33246908.summary_en: Systematic review of 50 published cases of neoplastic cerebral aneurysms (NCAs) found that 58% were caused by choriocarcinomas, primarily affecting young females. Choriocarcinoma-related NCAs showed 60% 90-day and 52% 180-day survival rates, superior to lung cancer and other malignancy-related aneurysms. The prognosis depends on disease progression and cancer management.

pmid-33251139.summary_ja: TGCT診断の10年前の患者の血清RNAプロファイリングを行い、健常対照と比較して循環RNAプロファイルが有意に異なることを明らかにした。セミノーマと非セミノーマのサブタイプでは異なるパターンが認められた。TSIXやTEX101を含む差次的発現RNAは癌関連経路と関連しており、循環RNAプロファイルがTGCTの早期発見に有用である可能性が示唆された。
pmid-33251139.summary_en: Serum RNA profiling of patients 10 years prior to testicular germ cell tumor (TGCT) diagnosis revealed significantly different circulating RNA profiles compared to healthy controls, with distinct patterns between seminoma and non-seminoma subtypes. Differentially expressed RNAs including TSIX and TEX101 were associated with cancer-related pathways. These findings suggest circulating RNA profiles may be useful for early TGCT detection.

pmid-33266100.summary_ja: CRISPR/Cas9技術を用いて、ヒトセミノーマTCam-2細胞におけるフィラミンA(FLNA)の役割を検討した。FLNAを欠失させると、アクチン細胞骨格の不規則化と細胞接着・遊走の障害が生じた。FLNA欠損細胞では幹細胞因子の転写活性が増加し、FLNAが幹細胞特性と浸潤性の均衡に関与することが示唆された。
pmid-33266100.summary_en: Investigation of filamin A (FLNA) role in human seminoma TCam-2 cells using CRISPR/Cas9 technology. FLNA loss caused irregular actin cytoskeleton, impaired cell adhesion and migration. FLNA-deficient cells showed increased stem cell factor transcriptional activity, suggesting FLNA role in balancing stem cell and invasive properties.

pmid-33267783.summary_ja: 二絨毛膜二羊膜双胎妊娠で一方の双子が妊娠中期に超音波で診断された仙骨尾骨奇形腫の症例報告。もう一方の双子は正常に発育。妊娠37+1週での計画帝王切開。患者側双子は生後4日目に手術を受けた。両側双子は良好な予後を示した。
pmid-33267783.summary_en: Case report of dichorionic-diamniotic twin pregnancy with sacrococcygeal teratoma in one twin diagnosed at second trimester by ultrasound. Other twin developed normally. Planned cesarean delivery at 37+1 weeks. Affected twin underwent excisional surgery at age four days. Both twins had good prognosis.

pmid-33269070.summary_ja: 75歳男性の左副腎領域に生じた後腹膜成熟嚢胞性奇形腫で、当初は副腎腺腫が疑われた。腹部CTで偶然発見され、腹腔鏡下左副腎摘除術が行われた。病理組織学的検査で良性の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と確認された。20か月の経過観察で再発はみられていない。
pmid-33269070.summary_en: Mature cystic retroperitoneal teratoma in left adrenal gland region of 75-year-old male initially suspected as adrenal adenoma. Incidentally found on abdominal CT. Laparoscopic left adrenalectomy performed. Histopathology confirmed benign mature cystic teratoma. No recurrence at 20-month follow-up.

pmid-33269267.summary_ja: 後腹膜と肝・肺転移を伴う焼け焦げ型原発性胚細胞腫瘍と絨毛癌を有する32歳男性が、BEP療法に続いてEMA-CO化学療法を受けた。EMA-CO8サイクル後に切除可能となり、外科的切除を完遂した。治療から10年後も無病生存を維持している。
pmid-33269267.summary_en: 32-year-old male with burned-out primary germ cell tumor and choriocarcinoma metastases treated with BEP followed by EMA-CO chemotherapy. After eight EMA-CO cycles, patient achieved resectable disease and underwent complete surgical resection. Patient remained disease-free 10 years after treatment.

pmid-33271650.summary_ja: 多発脳・肺・腎転移を伴う右精巣混合型胚細胞腫瘍の39歳男性に対し、BEP療法とTIP療法の化学療法を行い、その後外科的切除を実施した。治療中断後も腫瘍は縮小を続け、腫瘍マーカーは陰性化し、患者は完全奏効を維持している。
pmid-33271650.summary_en: 39-year-old male with testicular mixed germ cell tumor (seminoma, embryonal carcinoma, and teratoma) with multiple metastases to brain, lungs, and kidney. Treated with BEP and TIP chemotherapy followed by surgical resection. Continued tumor shrinkage and marker normalization after treatment discontinuation with complete response.

pmid-33274253.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマ患者55例を対象に、陽子線治療と3次元原体照射光子線放射線療法を比較した観察研究。陽子線治療では急性下痢が少なく、危険臓器への線量が低く、二次性悪性腫瘍は認められなかった。5年全生存率は100%、無病生存率は96.4%であった。
pmid-33274253.summary_en: Observational study comparing proton beam therapy versus 3D-conformal photon radiation therapy for testicular seminoma in 55 patients. Proton therapy resulted in lower acute diarrhea, lower dose to organs at risk, and no secondary malignancies. Five-year overall survival and disease-free survival were 100% and 96.4%.

pmid-33282160.summary_ja: 10年間の原発性縦隔胚細胞腫瘍患者46例を後方視的に解析した研究。患者の多くは男性(95.7%)で、年齢中央値は25歳、非セミノーマ性組織型が優勢(60.9%)だった。化学療法、手術、放射線療法を組み合わせた多様式治療により、5年全生存率が改善した(放射線療法あり72%、なし30%)。
pmid-33282160.summary_en: Retrospective analysis of 46 patients with primary mediastinal germ cell tumors over 10-year period. Majority males (95.7%), median age 25 years, predominant nonseminomatous histology (60.9%). Multimodality treatment with chemotherapy, surgery, and radiotherapy significantly improved 5-year overall survival (72% with radiotherapy vs 30%).

pmid-33282715.summary_ja: 精巣絨毛癌転移による十二指腸出血でショック状態で発症した17歳男性患者。ヘモグロビン5 g/dl。陰嚢検査により精巣腫瘤が明らかになり、精巣摘除術と絨毛癌診断に至った。6か月間の化学療法は完全な治療反応をもたらした。
pmid-33282715.summary_en: 17-year-old male presented in shock with hemoglobin 5 g/dl from duodenal bleeding secondary to testicular choriocarcinoma metastasis. Genital examination revealed testicular mass leading to radical orchiectomy and choriocarcinoma diagnosis. Six months of chemotherapy resulted in complete treatment response.

pmid-33284263.summary_ja: 両側卵巣奇形腫患者が卵巣組織と生殖能を保持しながら腫瘍切除を受けた症例。包括的な外科的アプローチにより両側奇形腫の完全核出が達成された。当初提案された両側卵巣切除が回避された。患者は卵巣機能と生殖能を維持した。
pmid-33284263.summary_en: Case of 22-year-old patient with bilateral ovarian teratoma undergoing tumor resection while preserving ovarian tissue and fertility. Complete enucleation of both teratomas achieved through comprehensive surgical approach, avoiding originally proposed bilateral oophorectomy. Patient maintained ovarian functionality.

pmid-33284891.summary_ja: 胸部圧迫感と呼吸困難を呈した42歳男性の原発性縦隔卵黄嚢腫瘍の症例報告。血清AFPの上昇(7169.66ng/ml)が認められ、生検で卵黄嚢腫瘍と確定した。BEP化学療法と手術を受け、VIP救援化学療法後に部分寛解となった。
pmid-33284891.summary_en: Case report of 42-year-old man with primary mediastinal yolk sac tumor presenting with chest tightness and dyspnea. Elevated serum AFP (7169.66 ng/ml) found. Biopsy confirmed yolk sac tumor. Patient received BEP chemotherapy and surgery, with partial remission after VIP salvage chemotherapy.

pmid-33294159.summary_ja: CTで仙骨前の嚢胞性腫瘤が偶発的に見つかった37歳男性の無症候性仙尾部奇形腫の稀な症例。病変の評価のためMRIとFDG-PETを実施した。尾骨を含めて経仙骨的に外科的切除を行い、病理組織学的に成熟奇形腫と確認された。
pmid-33294159.summary_en: Rare case of asymptomatic sacrococcygeal teratoma diagnosed incidentally in 37-year-old male via presacral cystic mass on CT imaging. MRI and FDG-PET performed for further characterization. Transsacral surgical excision with coccyx removal completed. Histopathology confirmed benign mature teratoma.

pmid-33294422.summary_ja: 精巣がんの画像診断を、初期診断から病期分類および再病期分類まで網羅的に図示した総説。セミノーマおよび非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍における超音波検査、CT、PET-CTの役割を解説している。治療反応の評価、再発モニタリング、画像所見の予後への意義も扱う。
pmid-33294422.summary_en: Comprehensive pictorial review of testicular cancer imaging from initial diagnosis through staging and restaging. Describes role of ultrasound, CT, and PET-CT across seminomas and nonseminomatous germ cell tumors. Covers treatment response assessment, recurrence monitoring, and prognostic implications of imaging.

pmid-33298910.summary_ja: 結節性硬化症を有する小児の仙骨奇形腫で同定された新規TSC1フレームシフト変異。TSCと奇形腫の初めて報告された関連性は胎児性腫瘍病態生理学と発達疾患における細胞分化メカニズムの理解に関連している。
pmid-33298910.summary_en: Novel TSC1 frameshift variant identified in child with tuberous sclerosis presenting with sacral teratoma. First reported association between TSC and teratoma has implications for understanding embryonic tumor pathophysiology and cellular differentiation mechanisms in developmental disease.

pmid-33299704.summary_ja: 眼窩および蝶形口蓋窩に拡張する新生児の先天性成熟奇形腫。下眼窩裂を経由した口腔内アプローチにより腫瘍全体が成功裏に摘出された。乳幼児の骨の軟らかさが眼窩壁破壊なしの摘出を可能にした。組織再形成は術後眼球陥没を改善した。
pmid-33299704.summary_en: Congenital mature teratoma in orbit extending into pterygopalatine fossa and zygoma in neonate. Intraoral approach via inferior orbital fissure successfully removed entire tumor. Softness of infant bone allowed tumor removal without orbital wall disruption. Tissue remodeling resolved postoperative depressed eye.

pmid-33304667.summary_ja: 胎児口腔咽頭奇形腫は硬口蓋に接続する上顎から発生する極めてまれな先天性疾患である。口腔咽頭腫瘤、羊水過多、気道閉塞による高い罹患率・死亡率に関連。超音波検査とMRIにより出生前診断と病変の特性化が可能である。
pmid-33304667.summary_en: Fetal oropharyngeal teratoma (OPT) is an extremely rare congenital disorder originating from upper jaws connected to hard palate. Associated with oropharyngeal mass, polyhydramnios, and high morbidity/mortality from airway obstruction. Ultrasound and MRI enable prenatal diagnosis and lesion characterization.

pmid-33311912.summary_ja: 混合生殖腺形成不全を有する表現型男性が異形性腫瘍からの肺転移による喀血で発症した。画像検査と腹腔鏡検査により生殖腺形成不全性異形性腫瘍、ミューラー管構造、および鼠径部の正常精巣が明らかになった。二次性肺転移に対し化学療法が開始された。
pmid-33311912.summary_en: Phenotypic male with mixed gonadal dysgenesis presented with hemoptysis from lung metastases of dysgerminoma. Diagnostic evaluation revealed dysgenetic intra-abdominal gonad with dysgerminoma, Müllerian structures, and normal testis in inguinal position. Chemotherapy was initiated for secondary lung metastases.

pmid-33314946.summary_ja: 血清および尿中β-hCGが陽性であり、子宮外妊娠が疑われた症例。術中所見で片側卵巣類皮嚢腫(奇形腫)が判明した。生殖可能年齢の女性で付属器腫瘤とhCG陽性を認める場合、胚細胞腫瘍をhCG産生源として考慮することの臨床的重要性を示している。
pmid-33314946.summary_en: Case of suspected ectopic pregnancy with positive serum and urine β-hCG, in which intraoperative findings revealed unilateral ovarian dermoid cyst (teratoma). Case highlights the clinical importance of considering germ cell tumors as sources of β-hCG production in reproductive-age women with adnexal masses and positive hCG.

pmid-33317204.summary_ja: 男性生殖管、精巣腫瘍（胚細胞腫瘍である胎児性癌を含む）、および精子におけるFSH-R発現を検討した研究。FSH-Rは胎児性癌には存在するがセミノーマには存在しない。FSH/FSH-R経路が精子の運動能や機能に影響することが示された。
pmid-33317204.summary_en: Study of follicle-stimulating hormone receptor (FSH-R) expression in male genital tract, testicular tumors (including embryonal carcinoma, a germ cell tumor), and sperm. FSH-R present in embryonal carcinoma but absent in seminoma; FSH/FSH-R pathway mediates effects on sperm motility and function.

pmid-33318239.summary_ja: 14歳思春期患者の稀な原発性胃奇形腫。大きな腹部腫瘤として見つかり、胃楔形切除を伴う一括摘出術が施行されました。乳幼児期以降の胃奇形腫は稀です。
pmid-33318239.summary_en: Rare case of primary gastric teratoma in a 14-year-old adolescent presenting as a large abdominal mass; patient underwent en bloc excision with gastric wedge resection. Gastric teratoma is extremely rare beyond infancy; literature review identified only five cases in patients over 1 year old in the past 50 years.

pmid-33319857.summary_ja: 絨毛癌の全エクソーム解析と遺伝子コピー数解析。独特なコピー数中立杂失とCNA、SMA/ARID1A変異を有し、胞状奇胎からの進行メカニズムが明らかになりました。
pmid-33319857.summary_en: Genomic analysis of gestational choriocarcinoma (unique cancer of pregnant tissues) using whole-exome sequencing and SNP microarray of 20-29 cases. Reveals unique copy-neutral LOH profiles, recurrent CNAs on 1q, and chromatin remodeling gene mutations; CNAs associated with poor prognosis and may drive progression from hydatidiform mole.

pmid-33321690.summary_ja: Turner症候群の7歳女児の卵巣ジスジャーミノーマ。KIT遺伝子exon17体細胞変異とSonichedgehogパスウェイ活性化を有する初報例。化学療法後に完全寛解を達成しました。
pmid-33321690.summary_en: Case of dysgerminoma (germ cell tumor) in a 7-year-old girl with Turner syndrome (mosaic 46,X,del(X)(q22)/45,X karyotype). Tumor harbors somatic KIT gene exon 17 mutation and Sonic-hedgehog pathway activation. Patient achieved complete remission after chemotherapy; this is the first reported Turner syndrome dysgerminoma with these specific molecular features.

pmid-33327406.summary_ja: 続発性悪性腫瘍を発症した精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者655例を対象とした研究。続発性悪性腫瘍においてアイソクロモソーム12p(i(12p))が認められ、化学療法後の奇形腫内に癌起始細胞が同定された。腫瘍の発生と休眠における細胞環境の重要性が示唆された。
pmid-33327406.summary_en: Study of 655 testicular germ cell tumor (TGCT) patients who developed subsequent malignant neoplasms. Molecular analysis demonstrates isochromosome 12p in secondary malignancies, identifies cancer-initiating progenitor cells within post-chemotherapy teratomas, and highlights cellular context in tumor development and dormancy.

pmid-33330062.summary_ja: 小児の骨盤内腫瘍において、多相CT画像から抽出した放射線学的特徴量とサポートベクターマシンモデルを用いて、卵黄嚢腫瘍(胚細胞腫瘍)と横紋筋肉腫を鑑別する研究。RMS 49例とYST 45例の計94例を解析し、AUC 0.7〜0.973と良好な診断性能を得た。
pmid-33330062.summary_en: Study using CT-based radiomics features with support vector machine model to differentiate pelvic yolk sac tumors (germ cell tumors) from rhabdomyosarcoma in children. Analysis of 94 patients (49 RMS, 45 YSTs) achieved good diagnostic performance (AUCs 0.7-0.973) using radiomics features extracted from multi-phase CT images.

pmid-33331598.summary_ja: 12歳男児の口腔毛様ポリープ（皮様嚢胞）。舌背部の有茎性腫瘍として見つかり、組織学的に良性奇形腫と診断されました。女性新生児例が多く、男児・思春期診断は稀です。
pmid-33331598.summary_en: Case report of oral hairy polyp (dermoid cyst variant) in a 12-year-old male with bulky pedunculated mass on tongue dorsum. Histopathological findings confirmed benign teratoma. Literature review found only 10 published cases between 1999-2019, predominantly in female newborns; this case is unusual for male sex and late diagnosis at age 12.

pmid-33342340.summary_ja: 鼻腔および副鼻腔に生じる、高度に浸潤性の悪性奇形腫である副鼻腔奇形癌肉腫（SNTCS）の症例報告と文献的考察。47歳男性が手術と放射線化学療法を受け、5年間の経過観察で再発はみられなかった。107例の文献的検討から、早期診断と併用治療の重要性が強調されている。
pmid-33342340.summary_en: Case report and literature review of sinonasal teratocarcinosarcoma (SNTCS), a rare, highly invasive malignant teratoma in the nasal cavity and paranasal sinuses. A 47-year-old man treated with surgery and radiochemotherapy achieved five-year disease-free survival; review of 107 cases emphasizes importance of early diagnosis and combined treatment.

pmid-33343869.summary_ja: 甲状腺組織を含む稀な卵巣奇形腫（ストルマ卵巣炎）の良性例と悪性例の2症例報告。27歳女性の良性例と68歳女性の悪性例について、診断と治療の課題を検討しています。
pmid-33343869.summary_en: Two case reports of struma ovarii, an extremely rare ovarian teratoma distinguished by thyroid tissue. One benign case in a 27-year-old woman treated with cystectomy and one malignant case in a 68-year-old woman treated with salpingo-oophorectomy; diagnostic and management challenges are discussed.

pmid-33344291.summary_ja: 結腸に発生した性腺外非妊娠性絨毛癌(胚細胞腫瘍)の症例報告で、低分化腺癌と絨毛癌への分化を併せ持つ。腫瘍は低分化腺癌に似ており、腸腰筋膿瘍の形成を伴い、β-hCGは高値であった。
pmid-33344291.summary_en: Case report of extragonadal non-gestational choriocarcinoma with adenocarcinoma and choriocarcinomatous differentiation (germ cell tumor) arising in the colon. The tumor mimicked poorly differentiated adenocarcinoma and was associated with psoas abscess formation; β-hCG was elevated.

pmid-33352104.summary_ja: ブレオマイシン、エトポシド、シスプラチン(BEPレジメン)による化学療法を受けたセミノーマ患者の症例報告。コルチコステロイドに抵抗性のブレオマイシン誘発性肺毒性を発症し、コルチコステロイドとイマチニブの併用療法で改善した。胚細胞腫瘍の化学療法関連合併症の管理例を示している。
pmid-33352104.summary_en: Case report of seminoma patient treated with bleomycin, etoposide, and cisplatin (BEP regimen) who developed bleomycin-induced pulmonary toxicity refractory to corticosteroids. Successfully treated with combination corticosteroid and imatinib therapy, demonstrating management of GCT chemotherapy-related complications.

pmid-33354624.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の発症機序、臨床像、診断および治療法を扱う、医学病理教育のための教育用症例。病理学医学教育の全国標準(PCME)の一部である。
pmid-33354624.summary_en: Educational case designed as a learning tool for medical pathology education covering testicular germ cell tumor pathogenesis, clinical presentation, and diagnostic and therapeutic modalities. Part of the Pathology Competencies for Medical Education (PCME) national standards.

pmid-33363881.summary_ja: 新生児の心膜内奇形腫の周術期管理に関する症例報告。心肺虚脱の危険性に対する体液補充と心肺危機への準備の重要性が強調されています。
pmid-33363881.summary_en: Case report of anesthetic and perioperative management of intrapericardial teratoma in a neonate. The case highlights the importance of adequate volume resuscitation and anticipation of cardiopulmonary collapse during surgical management of teratomas that exert mass effect on cardiovascular and respiratory systems.

pmid-33369685.summary_ja: RCOG、FIGO、ESMO、RANZCOGなど主要な国際医学会の臨床ガイドラインを比較したレビュー。胞状奇胎、侵入奇胎、絨毛癌を含む妊娠性絨毛性疾患の診断と管理について、治療法およびフォローアッププロトコルに関する合意点を整理している。
pmid-33369685.summary_en: Comprehensive comparative review of clinical guidelines from major international medical societies (RCOG, FIGO, ESMO, RANZCOG) on diagnosis and management of gestational trophoblastic disease, including hydatidiform mole, invasive mole, and choriocarcinoma with consensus on treatment modalities and follow-up protocols.

pmid-33380826.summary_ja: 胎児仙骨尾骨奇形腫15症例の臨床的特徴、治療、予後分析。成熟奇形腫、未熟奇形腫、混合胚細胞腫瘍を含む。腫瘍血流、サイズ、組織学的診断と妊娠予後の関連性について論述。
pmid-33380826.summary_en: Clinical analysis of fetal sacrococcygeal teratomas examining diagnosis, imaging features, tumor characteristics (mature, immature, and mixed germ cell tumors), maternal-fetal complications, and obstetric outcomes. Analyzes 15 cases with discussion of correlation between tumor factors and prognosis.

pmid-33393527.summary_ja: 甲状腺組織を含む奇形腫の単胚葉型変異である卵巣甲状腺腫から生じた濾胞癌の症例報告である。成熟奇形腫内に生じた甲状腺型癌という、まれな悪性転化を記述している。組織学的検査および免疫組織化学検査(TTF1陽性)により確認された。
pmid-33393527.summary_en: Case report of follicular carcinoma arising in struma ovarii, a monodermal variant of ovarian teratoma containing thyroid tissue. Describes rare malignant transformation within mature teratoma with thyroid-type carcinoma. Confirmed by histology and immunohistochemistry (TTF1 positive).

pmid-33403226.summary_ja: 新生児の仙骨尾骨奇形腫の症例報告。仙骨尾骨奇形腫は新生児における最も一般的な胎外腫瘍であり、通常全能性細胞から発生。診断と管理上の課題について論述。
pmid-33403226.summary_en: Case report of sacrococcygeal teratoma in neonate presenting with vague gluteal swelling. Sacrococcygeal teratoma is the most common extragonadal neoplasm in the presacral region during neonatal period, typically arising from totipotent cells near the coccyx. Discusses diagnostic and management challenges.

pmid-33408515.summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞におけるSLAMF1とメトトレキサート耐性の関係を調査。SLAMF1はオートファジー活性化を介してMTX耐性を促進。SLAMF1を標的とすることで絨毛癌の化学療法感受性向上の可能性。
pmid-33408515.summary_en: Investigates SLAMF1 protein's role in methotrexate resistance in choriocarcinoma cell lines. Demonstrates SLAMF1-mediated autophagy activation promotes chemotherapy resistance. Proposes targeting SLAMF1 as therapeutic strategy to sensitize choriocarcinoma cells to methotrexate-based regimens.

pmid-33425202.summary_ja: 膣に発生した卵黄嚢腫瘍の極めて稀な症例報告。12才女児が膣出血と会陰部腫瘤で発症。組織診断と免疫組織化学により確定診断。化学療法と手術により良好な治療成績。
pmid-33425202.summary_en: Case report of yolk sac tumor arising in vagina, an extremely rare extragonadal germ cell tumor site. 12-year-old girl presented with vaginal bleeding and perineal mass. Diagnosed by histopathology and immunohistochemistry. Treated per French TGM-95 protocol with chemotherapy and surgery achieving good response.

pmid-33425402.summary_ja: 全奇胎（胎盤絨毛膜疾患）による反復性甲状腺ストームの症例報告。全奇胎はベータhCG過剰産生によりTSH受容体刺激、重症甲状腺機能亢進症をきたす。手術による全奇胎摘出後改善。
pmid-33425402.summary_en: Case report of recurrent thyroid storm caused by complete hydatidiform mole. Gestational trophoblastic disease produces excessive beta-hCG causing TSH receptor stimulation and life-threatening thyrotoxicosis. Patient managed successfully with surgery after diagnosis of complete hydatidiform mole.

pmid-33425527.summary_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫から発生したカルチノイド腫瘍の症例報告。カルチノイドは単一胚葉奇形腫であり神経内分泌分化を示す。成熟奇形腫における上皮成分の悪性化可能性を示す。
pmid-33425527.summary_en: Case report of ovarian carcinoid tumor (neuroendocrine differentiation) arising in mature cystic teratoma in postmenopausal woman. Carcinoid represents a monodermal teratoma variant. Demonstrates malignant potential of epithelial components that can develop within mature teratomas.

pmid-33435656.summary_ja: 肺・縦隔原発の胎外胚細胞腫瘍の症例報告。ベータhCG高値で、絨毛癌症候群予防のため減量BEP化学療法と後腹膜リンパ節郭清術を施行。寛解を達成。
pmid-33435656.summary_en: Case report of extragonadal germ cell tumor with lung and mediastinal involvement and elevated beta-hCG. Treated with reduced BEP chemotherapy to prevent choriocarcinoma syndrome, followed by salvage chemotherapy and retroperitoneal lymph node dissection. Patient achieved disease-free status.

pmid-33447198.summary_ja: 新生児における先天性口腔奇形腫の症例報告。呼吸困難で発症し、複数の口腔奇形腫と口蓋裂を伴った。奇形腫は小児に発症する胎外胚細胞腫瘍である。
pmid-33447198.summary_en: Case report of congenital oral teratoma in neonate presenting with respiratory distress and airway compromise. Describes multiple oral teratomas with cleft palate and bifid tongue. Teratoma represents a type of extragonadal germ cell tumor occurring in pediatric patients with significant anesthetic management challenges.

pmid-33457283.summary_ja: 転移性胚細胞腫瘍における後腹膜リンパ節郭清術の役割についての総説。術式、神経温存手術、術後合併症、および腹腔鏡下手術などの最小侵襲アプローチについて論述。
pmid-33457283.summary_en: Narrative review of retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (RPLND) for metastatic germ cell tumors. Discusses indications, operative techniques including nerve-sparing approaches to preserve ejaculation, morbidity risks, and emerging minimally invasive methods for improved outcomes in germ cell tumor management.

pmid-33468920.summary_ja: 肝十二指腸間膜に発生した成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の極めて稀な症例報告。組織学的に多層扁平上皮と脂腺を含有。主要血管の合併切除なしに切除可能で2年10ヶ月後に再発なし。
pmid-33468920.summary_en: Case report of mature cystic teratoma in hepatoduodenal ligament, an extremely rare extragonadal location. Histology confirmed stratified squamous epithelium, sebaceous gland, and other tissues typical of mature teratoma. Surgical resection achieved safely without major vessel compromise; no recurrence at 2.8 years.

pmid-33468950.summary_ja: 後腹膜腫瘍と卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の同時性病変に対する腹腔鏡手術症例報告。卵巣腫瘍は成熟奇形腫と診断。腹腔鏡下手術による安全な摘出が可能であることが示された。
pmid-33468950.summary_en: Case report of laparoscopic surgery for synchronous retroperitoneal tumor and ovarian mature cystic teratoma. Retroperitoneal lesion identified as diffuse large B-cell lymphoma; ovarian tumor confirmed as mature teratoma. Demonstrates feasibility of minimally invasive resection of mature teratoma.

pmid-33473258.summary_ja: シスプラチン耐性テストステロン胚細胞腫瘍細胞株と感受性細胞株における281遺伝子の発現差を解析。POU5F1やNANOGなど多分化能関連遺伝子が治療応答性予測バイオマーカーとして提案されている。
pmid-33473258.summary_en: Identifies 281 genes differentially expressed between cisplatin-resistant and -sensitive testicular germ cell tumor cell lines. Validates 15 candidate genes involving pluripotency factors and metabolic processes as potential prognostic biomarkers for predicting chemotherapy response in TGCT patients.

pmid-33489542.summary_ja: 真の半陰陽患者に発症したセミノーマの症例報告。組織診断後に除睾術と化学療法を施行。性分化異常患者における胚細胞腫瘍発症は臨床的に重要な現象である。
pmid-33489542.summary_en: Case report of seminoma in patient with ovotesticular disorder (true hermaphroditism). Describes diagnosis on histopathological examination with subsequent orchiectomy and two cycles of chemotherapy. Illustrates rare presentation of germ cell malignancy in disorders of sex development.

pmid-33574796.summary_ja: GPER/GPR30(G蛋白質共役型エストロゲン受容体)が精巣胚細胞がんの病態生理において果たす役割を概説する総説である。セミノーマ細胞におけるエストロゲンシグナル伝達の機序を論じ、GPER/GPR30がセミノーマでは過剰発現している一方、非セミノーマでは過剰発現していないことを示す。さらに、この経路を標的とした治療の可能性についても検討している。
pmid-33574796.summary_en: Reviews GPER/GPR30 G protein-coupled estrogen receptor's role in testicular germ cell cancer pathophysiology. Discusses estrogen signaling mechanisms in seminoma cells, GPER/GPR30 overexpression in seminomas but not non-seminomas, and potential therapeutic targeting of this pathway in TGCCs.

pmid-33575572.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍における融合転写産物検出用のScaRツール開発報告。RCC1-ABHD12BおよびCLEC6A-CLEC4D融合遺伝子がセミノーマと胚細胞癌に高頻度検出される一方、正常精巣には検出されず、TGCT特異的な遺伝的特徴を示す。
pmid-33575572.summary_en: Reports development of ScaR tool for detecting fusion transcripts in testicular germ cell tumors. Identifies RCC1-ABHD12B and CLEC6A-CLEC4D fusions in 9% and 28% of TGCTs respectively, predominantly in seminomas and embryonal carcinomas. These cancer-specific fusions were not detected in normal testis tissue.

pmid-33585206.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の画像診断評価について包括的に概説した総説である。CTが依然として主要な画像診断法である一方、リンパ向性ナノ粒子を用いたMRは後腹膜リンパ節評価において有望とされる。化学療法後の残存病変について、PETはセミノーマでは有用だが非セミノーマでは有用性が示されていないことなど、臨床判断における画像解釈の課題を整理している。
pmid-33585206.summary_en: Comprehensive review of radiographic assessment in testicular germ cell tumors (GCTs). CT remains mainstay diagnostic imaging. MR with lymphotrophic nanoparticles shows promise for retroperitoneal lymph node evaluation. PET-CT useful for post-chemotherapy residual disease in seminoma but not non-seminoma. Highlights challenges in interpreting imaging for clinical decision-making.

pmid-33659208.summary_ja: 精巣精上皮種におけるmiR-483-3pの腫瘍抑制機能の研究。miR-483-3pは精上皮種組織で低下し腫瘍段階と相関。過剰発現は細胞増殖、遊走、浸潤を抑制。KLF9が上流調節因子として機能。
pmid-33659208.summary_en: Study investigating miR-483-3p as tumor suppressor in testicular seminoma via MMP9 targeting. miR-483-3p was downregulated in seminoma tissues and correlated with tumor stage. Overexpression suppressed cell growth, migration, and invasion in TCam-2 cells. KLF9 identified as upstream positive regulator also functioning as tumor suppressor.

pmid-33680279.summary_ja: 30歳男性の臨床病期I・同時性両側精巣胚細胞腫瘍の症例報告。右側は5.5cmの混合型胚細胞腫瘍、左側は1.5cmのセミノーマで、組織型が異なっていた。両側根治的精巣摘除術とBEP化学療法1サイクルを実施した。サーベイランスの遵守不良がリスク因子とされ、4年間のフォローアップで再発の所見は認められていない。
pmid-33680279.summary_en: Case report of 30-year-old man with clinical stage I synchronous bilateral testicular germ cell tumors with different histology: right-sided 5.5 cm mixed GCT and left-sided 1.5 cm seminoma. After bilateral radical orchiectomy and one cycle of BEP chemotherapy (due to poor surveillance compliance as risk factor), patient showed no evidence of relapse after four years follow-up.

pmid-33680389.summary_ja: 27歳男性の両側同時性精巣腫瘍の症例報告。組織型は右がセミノーマ、左がセミノーマ・卵黄嚢腫瘍・胎児性癌から成る混合型胚細胞腫瘍であった。α-フェトプロテインの上昇を認めた。両側精巣摘除術を施行し、BEP化学療法を1サイクル受けた。
pmid-33680389.summary_en: Case report of 27-year-old male with bilateral synchronous testicular tumors with different histology: right seminoma and left mixed germ cell tumor (seminoma, yolk sac tumor, embryonal carcinoma). Elevated α-fetoprotein noted. Bilateral orchiectomy performed. Patient received one cycle of BEP (bleomycin, etoposide, cisplatin) chemotherapy.

pmid-33704177.summary_ja: 318例のGCT化学療法患者中9例の原発性縦隔GCT（PMGCT）についての機関別報告。全例前縦隔腫瘤を呈し精巣病変なし。8例が非精上皮種。1年および5年全生存率はそれぞれ50%および38%で予後不良。
pmid-33704177.summary_en: Institutional review of 9 primary mediastinal germ cell tumor (PMGCT) patients among 318 men treated with chemotherapy for GCTs (1980-2016). All presented with anterior mediastinal mass without gonadal lesion. Eight had non-seminoma; all received cisplatin-based chemotherapy initially. One and five-year overall survivals were 50% and 38% respectively, indicating poor prognosis.

pmid-33776341.summary_ja: 精巣の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の患者において、Zinner症候群(片側性腎無形成、同側の射精管閉塞、精嚢嚢胞の3徴候)が偶発的に発見された症例報告である。Zinner症候群は通常無症状のまま経過する。精巣の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍とZinner症候群の関連は、これまで文献に報告されていない。
pmid-33776341.summary_en: Case report of incidental Zinner syndrome (triad: unilateral renal agenesis, ipsilateral ejaculatory duct obstruction, seminal vesicle cyst) discovered in patient with nonseminomatous germ cell tumor of testis. Zinner syndrome typically remains asymptomatic. This association between Zinner syndrome and testicular NSGCT not previously reported in literature.

pmid-33817740.summary_ja: 外臍部を伴う胎児臍帯未熟奇形腫の症例報告（13週診断）。妊娠終了。病理検査で未熟奇形腫確認、染色体マイクロアレイは正常。臍帯奇形腫を胎児腹壁欠損の鑑別診断に強調。
pmid-33817740.summary_en: Case report of immature umbilical cord teratoma associated with exomphalos diagnosed at 13 weeks gestation. Pregnancy terminated after diagnosis. Pathological examination confirmed immature teratoma with normal chromosomal microarray. Highlights umbilical cord teratomas as important differential diagnosis for prenatally detected abdominal wall defects requiring close fetal monitoring.

pmid-34165105.summary_ja: 若年の未婚女性に生じた、無症状で巨大な卵巣ディスジャーミノーマの症例報告。ディスジャーミノーマは悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の約1/3を占め、妊娠中に最も多く検出される。両側性の浸潤は15～20％。5年疾患特異的生存率は約99％と予後は良好である。患者は卵巣嚢腫摘出術を受けた。
pmid-34165105.summary_en: Case report of large asymptomatic ovarian dysgerminoma in young unmarried woman. Dysgerminomas account for ~1/3 of malignant ovarian germ cell tumors, most commonly detected during pregnancy. Bilateral involvement in 15-20% of cases. Excellent prognosis with 5-year disease-specific survival ~99%. Patient underwent ovarian cystectomy.

pmid-34177060.summary_ja: 胚細胞性精巣がん（GCTC）の治療に関する包括的な総説。GCTCは男性の悪性腫瘍の約1%を占めるが、若年男性で最も多いがんである（ピークは15～35歳）。主な群はセミノーマと非セミノーマ（各約50%）で、治療アプローチが異なる。シスプラチン併用化学療法により、全患者の約95%、進行例の70%以上で治癒が期待できる。
pmid-34177060.summary_en: Comprehensive review of germ-cell testicular cancer (GCTC) treatment. GCTC accounts for ~1% of male malignancies but is most common cancer in younger men (peak 15-35 years). Two main groups: seminomas and non-seminomas (each ~50%) with different treatment approaches. Cure rates ~95% all patients, >70% advanced disease due to cisplatin-based chemotherapy.

pmid-34337478.summary_ja: カナダの集団ベースのデータを用い、1991～2010年に精巣がんと診断された1,950人の生存者を、TCのない男性1,300,295人と比較した研究。TC患者は二次性悪性腫瘍による死亡リスクが高く(HR 1.63)、特に血液腫瘍で顕著(HR 3.86)だった。非セミノーマ患者はCVDによる死亡リスクが、セミノーマ患者は精巣以外の悪性腫瘍による死亡リスクが高かった。長期の治療関連の罹患が重要な懸念であることが示された。
pmid-34337478.summary_en: Population-based study of 1,950 testis cancer survivors versus 1,300,295 non-TC males (1991-2010). TC patients had increased risk of death from secondary malignancies (HR 1.63), particularly hematologic (HR 3.86). Nonseminoma patients at increased CVD death risk; seminoma patients at increased risk from non-testis malignancies. Long-term treatment-related morbidity is significant concern.

pmid-35117608.summary_ja: SEER データベースを用いた5,550例の悪性奇形腫の人口ベース研究（1975-2016）。縦隔悪性奇形腫は他部位より全生存率と癌特異的生存率が悪い。手術は生存を改善。化学療法と放射線療法は予後を悪化させた。
pmid-35117608.summary_en: Population-based SEER study of 5,550 malignant teratoma cases (133 mediastinal, 5,417 other sites, 1975-2016). Mediastinal malignant teratoma had significantly worse overall and cancer-specific survival than other locations. Surgery improved survival; chemotherapy and radiotherapy negatively influenced outcomes. Combined therapies showed worse prognosis than surgery alone.

pmid-35117666.summary_ja: 進行した男性原発性絨毛癌の2症例の報告。縦隔絨毛癌の1例目は化学療法への反応が乏しく、診断から6.5か月後に死亡した。頸部絨毛癌の2例目はペムブロリズマブと化学療法の併用で完全奏効が得られ、36か月時点で無病生存中である。難治性の男性絨毛癌に対し、免疫療法が有益となる可能性を示唆する。
pmid-35117666.summary_en: Two case reports of advanced male primary choriocarcinoma. First patient with mediastinal choriocarcinoma had poor chemotherapy response, died 6.5 months post-diagnosis. Second patient with neck choriocarcinoma achieved complete response with pembrolizumab plus chemotherapy, remaining disease-free at 36 months. Suggests immunotherapy may benefit refractory male choriocarcinoma.

pmid-35117739.summary_ja: STR分析で妊娠性絨毛膜癌と確認された副腎原発絨毛膜癌の症例報告。初期治療失敗後、化学療法と副腎摘出術で完全奏効を達成。STR分析で妊娠性と非妊娠性の鑑別の重要性を示唆。
pmid-35117739.summary_en: Case report of 29-year-old woman with adrenal gestational choriocarcinoma confirmed by STR analysis showing both maternal and paternal genetic markers. Initial curettage and oviduct resection failed to find intrauterine pregnancy. After chemotherapy and adrenalectomy, achieved complete response. Demonstrates importance of STR analysis in distinguishing gestational from non-gestational choriocarcinoma.

pmid-35118299.summary_ja: 10年間に外科的治療を受けた縦隔胚細胞腫瘍の患者16例（男性9例、女性7例）の後方視的コホート研究。年齢中央値は男性で有意に低かった（22歳対38歳）。女性は全例が成熟奇形腫を有し、男性の89%が術前補助化学療法を受けた。全生存率は75%、フォローアップ中央値は36か月であった。
pmid-35118299.summary_en: Retrospective cohort of 16 mediastinal germ cell tumor patients (9 male, 7 female) surgically treated over 10 years. Median age significantly lower in males (22 vs 38 years). All females had mature teratomas; 89% of males received neoadjuvant chemotherapy. Overall survival 75% with median follow-up 36 months.

pmid-28272670.summary_ja: 原発性後腹膜奇形腫は性腺外の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍として稀な疾患である。7か月齢女児の症例で、神経原性組織が優勢な成熟嚢胞性奇形腫が認められ、典型的な奇形腫とは異なる組織像を示し、画像上は副腎腫瘍と紛らわしかった。
pmid-28272670.summary_en: Primary retroperitoneal teratoma is a rare extragonadal nonseminomatous germ cell tumor. This case presents a mature cystic teratoma in a 7-month-old female with predominant neurogenic tissue differentiation, an unusual histological pattern distinct from typical teratoma composition, which mimicked an adrenal tumor on imaging.

pmid-28612626.summary_ja: Currarino症候群患者の仙骨前皮様囊胞の類癌転化症例報告。過去の報告は3例に限定され、遺伝学的症候群での稀な悪性転化を示す。
pmid-28612626.summary_en: Case report of carcinoid transformation of presacral dermoid cyst in patient with Currarino syndrome. Only three prior cases of carcinoid transformation in presacral masses documented, demonstrating rare malignant potential.

pmid-28914675.summary_ja: 卵巣皮様囊胞（成熟嚢胞性奇形腫）内に発生した神経芽細胞腫の初報告例。奇形腫の悪性転化の新たな型を示す。
pmid-28914675.summary_en: First reported case of ganglioneuroblastoma arising within ovarian dermoid cyst (mature cystic teratoma). Represents rare somatic neoplastic transformation within teratoma; expands spectrum of known malignant transformations.

pmid-29140877.summary_ja: 帝王切開後瘢痕から発生した異型性胎盤着床部結節の症例報告。診断基準を提案し、胎盤着床部結節との鑑別を強調。
pmid-29140877.summary_en: Case report and literature review of atypical placental site nodule (APSN), a trophoblastic lesion arising in postcesarean scar. Proposes diagnostic criteria distinguishing APSN from benign placental site nodule and epithelioid trophoblastic tumor.

pmid-29280854.summary_ja: 精母細胞性セミノーマ85例の大規模シリーズ。形態学的スペクトラムと診断的特徴を詳述。通常のセミノーマや悪性腫瘍との鑑別が重要。
pmid-29280854.summary_en: Large series of 85 spermatocytic seminoma cases emphasizing morphologic spectrum, cellular patterns, edema, fibrin rims, and vessel invasion. Important for diagnostic distinction from usual seminoma and other malignancies; typically has better prognosis.

pmid-29320914.summary_ja: 新生児心膜内奇形腫の治療例と38例の文献系統的レビュー。多くが心膜液と水腫を呈したが、大部分が新生児期に生存。
pmid-29320914.summary_en: Case report of early neonatal intrapericardial teratoma treatment with systematic review of 38 cardiac teratoma cases. Most presented with pericardial effusion and hydrops; majority of newborns survived without intrauterine procedures.

pmid-29384436.summary_ja: 卵巣奇形腫を有する若年女性の抗NMDAR受容体抗体脳炎2例の報告。意識変容、けいれん、運動障害を呈した傍腫瘍症候群。
pmid-29384436.summary_en: Reports two cases of anti-NMDAR antibody encephalitis in young adult women with ovarian teratoma. Describes neuropsychiatric and movement disorder presentations. Emphasizes importance of recognizing this paraneoplastic syndrome associated with teratoma.

pmid-29495013.summary_ja: 仙骨尾骨奇形腫妊娠の腫瘍量と胎児体重の比率によるリスク階層化。TFR>0.095で胎児死亡、TFR>0.12で母体手術リスク増加を予測。
pmid-29495013.summary_en: Retrospective analysis establishing tumor volume-to-fetal weight ratio (TFR) thresholds for predicting sacrococcygeal teratoma outcomes. TFR >0.095 predicted poor fetal outcomes; TFR >0.12 predicted increased maternal operative risk, providing important prognostic tool.

pmid-29540256.summary_ja: ルテオリンが卵巣奇形癌細胞PA-1の増殖を抑制し、Bcl-2/Bax経路を介したアポトーシスを誘導することを示した。異種移植モデルで腫瘍増殖を抑制。
pmid-29540256.summary_en: In vitro and in vivo study of luteolin's inhibitory effects on ovarian teratocarcinoma cell line PA-1. Luteolin induced dose-dependent apoptosis via Bcl-2/Bax regulation and suppressed tumor growth in xenograft models, suggesting potential therapeutic application.

pmid-29546798.summary_ja: 新生児の乳児絨毛膜癌が血管腫として誤診され、後に確定診断された症例。β-hCG陽性で血清β-hCG上昇。肝・肺転移を認めた。
pmid-29546798.summary_en: Case report of infantile choriocarcinoma presenting as rapidly growing vascular glabellar mass in male neonate. Initially misdiagnosed as hemangioma; β-hCG immunostaining and elevated serum β-hCG confirmed gestational trophoblastic neoplasia with liver and lung metastases.

pmid-29579225.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマと非セミノーマの分子プロファイル比較研究。テロメア長と遺伝子発現の相違を明らかにし、テロメア関連遺伝子の差異を示した。
pmid-29579225.summary_en: Systematic molecular analysis comparing telomere length and expression profiles in seminoma versus non-seminoma testicular germ cell tumors. Found telomere elongation in NSE and shortening in SE; identified differential telomere-related genes and Yamanaka factors.

pmid-29589985.summary_ja: 28年間にわたり進行性の眼球突出を呈していた31歳男性の、眼窩巨大類皮嚢腫（非ジャーミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍）の症例報告である。画像検査では不均一な充実性・嚢胞性混合病変が認められ、病理組織学的検査で類皮嚢腫と確定した。通常は良性の病変が、異例の巨大な大きさに達していた。
pmid-29589985.summary_en: Case report of giant orbital dermoid cyst (non-germinomatous germ cell tumor) in 31-year-old male with 28-year history of progressive proptosis. Imaging showed heterogeneous mixed solid-cystic lesion; histology confirmed dermoid cyst with unusual massive size.

pmid-29728822.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の化学療法後残存腫瘍に対するロボット支援仙骨外側後腹膜リンパ節郭清の新規手術技法を報告。
pmid-29728822.summary_en: Novel robot-assisted supine extraperitoneal retroperitoneal lymph node dissection technique for post-chemotherapy residual mass in non-seminomatous germ cell tumor. Offers advantages of robotic assistance with supine positioning and minimal bowel handling.
